jobs.title: Program Coordinator – Part-Time
jobs.description:
**Help make one\-on\-one tutoring work for Oakland children.**

Children Rising is hiring several **part\-time Program Coordinators** for the 2026–27 school year to support our literacy, math, and family engagement programs in Oakland elementary schools.

Program Coordinators are at the heart of our tutoring programs. They coordinate weekly tutoring clinics, support trained volunteer tutors working one\-on\-one with students, and help create an organized, encouraging environment where children can strengthen foundational reading and math skills.

If you enjoy working with children, are organized and encouraging, and want meaningful, hands\-on work in Oakland schools, we’d love to hear from you.

**Help make one\-on\-one tutoring work for Oakland children.**

Children Rising is hiring several **part\-time Program Coordinators** for the 2026–27 school year to support our literacy, math, and family engagement programs in Oakland elementary schools.

Program Coordinators are at the heart of our tutoring programs. They coordinate weekly tutoring clinics, support trained volunteer tutors working one\-on\-one with students, and help create an organized, encouraging environment where children can strengthen foundational reading and math skills.

If you enjoy working with children, are organized and encouraging, and want meaningful, hands\-on work in Oakland schools, we’d love to hear from you.

**What you’ll do**

* Coordinate two or more weekly tutoring clinics at Oakland school sites.
* Prepare tutoring spaces and materials so students and tutors are ready to work together.
* Pick up students from their classrooms and bring them to the tutoring clinic.
* Support volunteer tutors with scheduling, coaching, lesson planning, materials, encouragement, and student needs.
* Build positive relationships with students, tutors, families, teachers, and Children Rising staff.
* Monitor student progress and tutor\-student relationships and work with program leadership to address challenges.
* Track attendance and maintain accurate student and tutor records.
* Update program information in Salesforce.
* Collaborate with our FamilyBridge team to help connect tutoring, classroom learning, and support at home.
* Participate in program meetings, staff meetings, and special events as needed.

These responsibilities reflect the core duties in the current Children Rising job description.

**What we’re looking for**

* Two or more years of relevant education experience.
* A demonstrated ability and passion for working with children.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.
* Experience responding constructively to student behavior and learning challenges.
* Comfort with program evaluation, data tracking, and learning new systems.
* Experience working with diverse communities.
* Experience supporting English\-language learners is a plus.
* Understanding of the impact of trauma on early\-childhood learning is a plus.

**Position details**

* Part\-time, approximately **10–20 hours per week** during the academic year.
* Work takes place primarily at Oakland school sites, with some work at the Children Rising office and remotely.
* Starting compensation is **$27/hour**, with the possibility of a higher starting rate based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated skills.
* Requires Live Scan background clearance, negative TB status, a valid driver’s license, and regular access to a car.

**About Children Rising**

Children Rising surrounds Oakland children with caring relationships and educational support so they can build stronger foundations in reading and math and greater confidence in themselves.

Through Succeeding by Reading, Path2Math, and FamilyBridge, students, families, volunteer tutors, schools, and community partners work together as part of a larger circle of care.

Job Types: Part\-time, Full\-time

Pay: From $27\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Application Question(s):

* Are you willing to complete Live Scan background clearance and provide verification of negative TB status? (Yes / No)
* Are you available to work approximately 10–20 hours per week, primarily during weekday school hours at Oakland school sites? (Yes / No)
* Do you have at least two years of experience working in education, tutoring, youth development, or a related field? (Yes/No)

Education:

* Associate (Required)

License/Certification:

* Driver's License (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Process Improvement Consultant III
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**  

  

Delivers, executes, and sustains process improvement (PI) engagements including kaizen. Serves as a consultant to stakeholders and process owners to drive process improvements. Supports strategic planning and prioritization of process improvement initiatives. Serves as an advocate for continuous improvement by keeping abreast of industry practices, standards, and benchmarks. Participates in change management activities associated with process improvement and performs data analyses to support process improvement initiatives.

 **Essential Responsibilities:**  

  

* Pursues effective relationships with others by proactively providing resources, information, advice, and expertise with coworkers and members. Listens to, seeks, and addresses performance feedback; provides mentoring to team members. Pursues self\-development; creates plans and takes action to capitalize on strengths and develop weaknesses; influences others through technical explanations and examples. Adapts to and learns from change, challenges, and feedback; demonstrates flexibility in approaches to work; helps others adapt to new tasks and processes. Supports and responds to the needs of others to support a business outcome.
* Completes work assignments autonomously by applying up\-to\-date expertise in subject area to generate creative solutions; ensures all procedures and policies are followed; leverages an understanding of data and resources to support projects or initiatives. Collaborates cross\-functionally to solve business problems; escalates issues or risks as appropriate; communicates progress and information. Supports, identifies, and monitors priorities, deadlines, and expectations. Identifies, speaks up, and implements ways to address improvement opportunities for team.
* Delivers, executes, and sustains process improvement (PI) engagements including kaizen by leveraging the appropriate methods and tools to ensure the development of stakeholder capabilities for process change and improvement; applying data\-driven PI principles, tools, and problem\-solving methods including Lean/Six Sigma concepts and techniques; building high performance team capabilities to achieve real time business results; developing process architecture and recommendation documents, including presentations, process maps, supporting metrics, business requirements and related impact analyses; and presenting results and recommendations as appropriate.
* Serves as a consultant to stakeholders and process owners by providing consultation to stakeholders and teams to drive process improvements; contributing to the development of management systems to sustain process changes; supporting the development of stakeholder process improvement leadership competencies; providing training and guidance to stakeholders; and providing ongoing coaching to build a continuous improvement mindset, and build capabilities that drive results.
* Supports strategic planning and prioritization of process improvement initiatives by defining, developing, and evaluating performance metrics, standards, and methods to establish process success; collaborating with multiple stakeholders, often with competing/conflicting objectives, to ensure cohesive and reachable metrics; and managing assigned initiatives to ensure delivery of measurable results and alignment with strategic objectives.
* Serves as an advocate for continuous improvement by keeping abreast of industry practices, standards, and benchmarks; attending and participating in roadshows, conferences, and speaking events; contributing to the ongoing enhancement of process improvement practices, standards, and methods across KP; and serving as an advocate to ensure continuous learning and improvement is championed as a people strategy.
* Participates in change management activities associated with process improvement by engaging stakeholders to obtain support and buy in for changes; collaborating with management, project champions, and process owners to align process improvement initiatives with business objectives; using appropriate change management methods and approaches; and ensuring stakeholders embrace a change management mindset, and understand initiative intent and purpose.
* Performs data analyses to support process improvement initiatives by using appropriate data analysis tools and approach to assess system or process performance; deploying suitable data gathering and analysis methods (e.g., process observation, hard data, etc.); defining data requirements and obtaining customer agreements, including customer requirements as appropriate; conducting analyses and performing experimental tests; and identifying risks through data\-driven analysis.

 **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: (Core)*** Ambiguity/Uncertainty Management
* Attention to Detail
* Business Knowledge
* Communication
* Critical Thinking
* Cross\-Group Collaboration
* Decision Making
* Dependability
* Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Support
* Drives Results
* Facilitation Skills
* Health Care Industry
* Influencing Others
* Integrity
* Learning Agility
* Organizational Savvy
* Problem Solving
* Short\- and Long\-term Learning \& Recall
* Teamwork
* Topic\-Specific Communication

 **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: (Functional)*** Applied Data Analysis
* Business Acumen
* Business Process Improvement
* Emotional Intelligence
* Managing Diverse Relationships
* Service Focus
* Written Communication

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

  

* Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, Health Care/Public Health Administration, Behavioral/Social/Computer Science, Liberal Arts, Mathematics, or related field and Minimum three (3\) years experience in process improvement, consulting, project management, or a directly related field OR Minimum six (6\) years experience in process improvement, consulting, project management, or a directly related field.

 **Preferred Qualifications:*** Process improvement cert

jobs.title: Patient Navigator
jobs.description:
Involves providing non\-clinical support, guidance and assistance for patients and families as they navigate through complex healthcare environments. Primary goals are to increase patient satisfaction, and to optimize care and outcomes. Acts as a communication liaison to understand the patient's non\-clinical individual needs, expectations, and concerns. Guides the patient and family to a broad range of services, amenities, and information to promote healing and ensure satisfaction with the patient care experience.


**DEPARTMENT DESCRIPTION:**

The Behavioral Emergency Response Team (BERT) is UCSF Benioff Children's Hospitals' pediatric behavioral health crisis service, providing rapid assessment, crisis intervention, risk evaluation, and disposition planning for children and adolescents experiencing behavioral health emergencies in the Emergency Department and on inpatient units. BERT partners closely with Emergency Medicine, inpatient medical teams, nursing, security, and Psychiatry to determine the appropriate level of care, including inpatient psychiatric hospitalization when clinically indicated. BERT operates as part of the broader Behavioral Health Crisis Services program, alongside the Crisis Response Bridge Clinic, Psychiatry Consultation\-Liaison, and Code CARE, together providing a continuum of crisis assessment, stabilization, and follow\-up care. Services are trauma\-informed, culturally responsive, and grounded in principles of equity and recovery.


  
**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum of 2\+ years of relevant experience
* Strong interpersonal and customer service skills. Ability to communicate and resolve issues effectively with a diverse population of patients, staff and physicians.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills. Ability to develop solutions and recommend changes and follow through with implementation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Windows\-based software including Microsoft word, Excel, Outlook. Knowledge of computer systems and software used in functional area.
* Ability to work calmly and effectively under time pressure in a fast\-paced, high\-acuity pediatric behavioral health environment.
* Comfort and persistence with high\-volume telephone and fax\-based coordination with external hospitals and receiving facilities
* Ability to accurately review clinical documentation (labs, H\&P, medication lists) for completeness prior to transmission to a receiving facility
* Understanding of HIPAA and patient privacy requirements as they relate to transmitting clinical information between facilities.
* Ability to work collaboratively as part of an interdisciplinary crisis team, including BERT clinicians, nursing, and medical teams; skill in building and maintaining working relationships with external community providers and programs.
  

**PREFERRED:**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
* Bi\-lingual
* Knowledge of the pediatric behavioral health continuum of care, including inpatient psychiatric admission criteria, IOP/PHP, residential treatment, and outpatient therapy and psychiatry resources, along with the regional landscape of receiving facilities and community providers. Knowledge of medical terminology sufficient to review labs and clinical documentation.
* Prior experience with inpatient psychiatric placement, bed\-finding, or hospital\-to\-hospital transfer coordination.
  

**LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS:**

* Bi\-lingual

  
**About UCSF**  

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate\-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10\-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.  

  

**Pride Values**  

UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .  

  

In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here .  

  

Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide.  

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**  

The University of California is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected status under state or federal law.  

  

**Salary Information**  

The final salary and offer components are subject to additional approvals based on UC policy.  

  

Your placement within the salary range is dependent on a number of factors including your work experience and internal equity within this position classification at UCSF. For positions that are represented by a labor union, placement within the salary range will be guided by the rules in the collective bargaining agreement.  

  

To learn more about the benefits of working at UCSF, including total compensation, please visit: https://ucnet.universityofcalifornia.edu/compensation\-and\-benefits/index.html

jobs.title: Operations Manager – Commercial Landscaping
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking an energetic and experienced Operations Manager specialized in Commercial Landscaping to work alongside the owner and take charge of client accounts, estimating, and project delivery.

You'll have ownership over how jobs are sold, priced, and run. The right person can grow into a general manager role.

We are looking for a candidate to foster a motivated workforce dedicated to transforming outdoor spaces into vibrant, sustainable environments. We are growing an installation division to compliment our maintenance work for major municipal and private clients across the Bay Area.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to influence project success from planning through execution while maintaining safety standards and operational efficiency.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage key client relationships, including property managers, owners, and public agencies
* Lead the proposal process: gather input from crew leads and subs, build the estimate, and put together the final proposal
* Own pricing and quoting in Jobber software
* Run projects from award to closeout: scheduling, crews, subs, budget, and change orders
* Supervise crew leads and set priorities for the field
* Source plants, materials, and equipment, and negotiate with vendors
* Manage our nursery and plant inventory
* Oversee HR: hiring, onboarding, timekeeping, employee records, and certified payroll on public jobs
* Track job costs and margins, and report to the owner
* Help improve how we operate: systems, processes, and standards

**Skills**

* 5–7\+ years in commercial landscape, construction, or property maintenance, including at least 3 years managing projects or accounts
* Strong plant knowledge, especially Bay Area plant material
* A track record of estimating and winning work
* Experience supervising crews or field leads
* Comfortable with Jobber or similar software plus Claude/AI and Excel
* Clear writer with good judgment, organized, and able to handle several jobs at once
* Valid CA driver's license and a clean driving record
* Spanish is a plus
* Experience with public agencies, prevailing wage, or HR is a plus
* Landscape contractor (C\-27\) license or certifications (CLT, ISA, QAL) are a plus

Send your resume and a short note about a project or account you managed: the scope, the budget, and how it turned out.

Join us as an Operations Manager to shape beautiful outdoor environments through your leadership expertise!

Pay: From $60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Manager, Sales Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



Our sales and partner management teams are the heart and soul of DoorDash, enabling us to sign and partner with top restaurants across the country to drive revenue and help our partners operate and grow their businesses. As DoorDash grows both in scale and breadth of offering, the strength of our sales engine and organizational structure must grow with it.


**About the Role**
------------------



As the Manager of Sales Strategy \& Operations for Sales Tooling, you will be the core DRI for DoorDash's third\-party (3P) technology ecosystem. You will play a pivotal role in executing against top company business objectives by owning the 3P portfolio of our centralized Sales tooling operation. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Sales Tooling, you will manage spend tracking and license optimization across the 3P budget, ensuring that every tool in our stack directly contributes to sales productivity and operational efficiency.

  


**Strategic Ownership \& Governance:**


* Oversee the end\-to\-end strategy and execution of DoorDash's 3P sales tooling portfolio.
* Act as a thought partner on "build vs. buy" decisions as it relates to our 3P vs 1P stack of sales tools.
* Operate and continuously improve the tooling governance process (intake, scoring, SLAs, and routing to Legal, Security, and Procurement) to eliminate redundant "shadow" procurement across lines of business.
* Run structured tool evaluations, make scale or sunset recommendations to the governance council, and execute approved procurement and decommissioning.


**Cross\-Functional Partnership:**


* Gather and synthesize requirements from Sales teams to shape tool selection and feature asks.
* Partner with GTM Technology \& Product to ensure all 3P solutions align with technical requirements and architectural standards.
* Work closely with Revenue Operations to measure and report on the sales productivity impact of all tooling investments.


**Vendor \& Lifecycle Management:**


* Act as the main point of contact for 3P sales tooling partners, holding vendors accountable to roadmaps that resolve existing challenges and implement enhancements.
* Serve as the central DRI for tooling licensing, access management, and permissioning to accelerate decision\-making and reduce operational friction.


**Execution \& Enablement:**


* Partner with Enablement to drive adoption and best practices for 3P tools across sales teams, and track adoption and sentiment.
* Develop a centralized repository for tooling documentation and best practices to resolve current information silos.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will be driving…**
----------------------------------------------------------------------


* **Tooling Optimization:** Drive the evaluate, renew, and retire decisions that move us toward fewer, better tools and a 1P\-first stack where possible.
* **Governance in Motion:** Optimize and oversee tooling governance council cycles and decision calendar running, ensuring fiscal discipline and eliminating redundant "shadow" procurement.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with GTM Technology, Product, Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, and the Sales Analytics AI pod to align technical requirements with business goals and productivity outcomes.
* **Tooling Optimization and ROI:** Analyze usage data and performance metrics to derive actionable insights, identifying trends and providing recommendations to evolve or decommission tools to maximize ROI.
* **Sales Productivity Strategy:** Collaborate with Sales leads across all lines of business to identify friction points and implement 3P or AI\-enabled solutions that accelerate the sales cycle and improve rep efficiency.
* **Vendor Roadmap Influence:** Be the key point of contact for your 3P vendors, providing structured feedback and holding them accountable to committed roadmaps and SLAs.

**We're excited about you because you have…**
---------------------------------------------


* A bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience in Sales Operations, GTM Technology, or Sales Strategy, ideally in a fast\-paced tech or e\-commerce environment.
* Experience managing SaaS tools and vendor relationships, with exposure to renewals and contracts in partnership with Procurement and Legal.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to distill technical tooling challenges into clear business cases for leadership and the tooling governance council.
* The ability to navigate large datasets to measure tooling adoption and business impact.
* Demonstrated experience in driving operational rigor and governance in a decentralized environment.
* **An Architect at Heart** – You think in systems, not just features; you treat every broken process as a build opportunity and every data gap as a use case waiting to be deployed.
* **Entrepreneurial** – You have a bias toward action, an ownership mentality, and the ability to thrive in a constantly changing environment.
* **Gritty** – You are willing to roll up your sleeves to map complex workflows, diagnose gaps, and do whatever it takes to make our tooling stack successful.
* **A Relationship\-Builder** – You can influence and motivate stakeholders at all levels, from technical engineers to frontline sales managers.
* **Operational \& Rigorous** – You independently translate high\-level strategy into actionable project plans with strict attention to detail and efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 6\+ years in Sales Operations, GTM systems and tooling, or Sales Strategy, ideally supporting a sales tech stack; tech or marketplace experience preferred.

Where state and federal laws/regulations allow, accountable for performing day\-to\-day non\-clinical pharmacy operations, administrative activities; Ensures efficient pharmacy workflow and a positive patient experience. Serves as a full\-time certified pharmacy technician. Responsible for operating pharmacy systems to obtain patient and drug information and process prescriptions. Responsible for the selection, scheduling, and development of pharmacy technician personnel. Leads training, coaching, and performance management of pharmacy technicians. Makes decisions regarding performance management including discipline and termination.
  

  

**Customer Experience**

Resolves customer complaints, helps respond to customers’ requests in a timely manner and answers non\-clinical questions to ensure a positive customer experience. Models and shares customer service best practices.
* Develops strong relationships with customers by anticipating customer needs and proactively offering services to provide the best experience possible when using the pharmacy. Enhances customer experience by increasing focus on healthcare services.

**Operations**

Completes patient and physician calls under the supervision of a pharmacist (where allowed by law). Under the supervision of a pharmacist assists with healthcare service offerings including administering vaccines, health screenings, and any health services allowed by law.
* Within the guidelines of authorized company policies, state and federal laws/regulations, exercises independent judgment to delegate, direct, and assign non\-clinical work in the pharmacy. Ensures tasks are completed on\-time and holds others accountable for efficient workflow.
* At the direction of the Pharmacy Manager or pharmacist, prepares, and files reports and records required by the company and various government agencies.

* Under the direction of the pharmacist, exercises independent judgment to ensure compliance and execution of all business administrative activities and pharmacy inventory management tasks that do not require pharmacist licensure. Manages annual inventory preparation.
* Accountable for completion of non\-clinical patient calls.
* Drives new technology/ process roll out, champions change and engages team around action planning. Assures proper operation and maintenance of pharmacy department equipment. In collaboration with Pharmacy Manager, responsible for recordkeeping and ensuring security safeguards are in\-place.
* Under supervision of the pharmacist, strictly adheres to the Walgreen Co. policy regarding Good Faith Dispensing during all applicable prescription\-dispensing activities and understands their role in ensuring that the elements of Good Faith Dispensing are met.

jobs.title: Alameda Assistant Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About America West Medical Transportation, Inc.**

  

At America West Medical Transportation, we are more than a transportation service; we are a community partner dedicated to improving lives and helping individuals thrive. By embracing the spirit of community service and giving, we can create a healthier, more connected society.

  

We are hiring drivers to transport wheelchair patients or stretcher patients in specially equipped vehicles.

  

This fast\-paced and rewarding role is perfect for a self\-starter who is looking to build their resume by working closely with the immediate team leader.

  

For more information about America West visit: **https://www.america\-west.com/**

 **Locations/Counties we serve****: Alameda, Contra Costa, Los Angeles, Riverside, Sacramento, San Francisco, Santa Clara, Solano, Sonoma, San Jose, etc.**

 **Core Values**

**Commitment to Customers** \- We continually earn the privilege to care for our patients. It is at the forefront of everything we do. And no matter the role you have at the company, we are each other’s customers.

**Respectful** \- We respect each other and achieve together what no individual can do alone.

**Dependability** \- We are committed to exceptional service delivery, on time and following up on what must be done.

**Integrity** \- We are vigilant and committed to safety and preparedness in the fulfillment of our duties.

**Accountability** \- We take ownership for what we do and take pride in how we do it.

  

Assistant Operations Manager

### **Position Overview**


The **Assistant Operations Manager (AOM)** plays a vital leadership role in directing daily transportation operations to ensure the safe, punctual, and high\-quality transport of all program participants. Reporting directly to the Operations Manager, the AOM oversees driver performance, monitors fleet dispatch, and supports regulatory compliance while fostering a compassionate service environment. This position requires hands\-on leadership, strong logistics capabilities, and a minimum of **one year of experience working with elderly individuals**.

 **Work Location:** Field Operations – Alameda *(Occasional overnight travel required)*

 **Key Tasks and Responsibilities**

#### **1\. Team Leadership \& Staff Management**

* Support the Operations Manager in conducting annual and periodic driver performance evaluations.
* Provide continuous coaching, oversee driver field protocols, and assist in managing personnel issues or corrective action documentation.
* Promote high standards of safety, professional conduct, and patient\-centered service across the driver team.

#### **2\. Dispatch \& Logistics Coordination**

* Collaborate with the Transportation Coordinator to review daily route schedules for maximum efficiency and coverage.
* Monitor real\-time transit status, route adjustments, and schedule adherence to ensure timely arrivals and departures.

#### **3\. Participant \& Stakeholder Engagement**

* Represent the transportation department in required PACE interdisciplinary team (IDT) meetings, staff briefings, and quality improvement committees.
* Build strong, professional relationships with participants, families, healthcare providers, and senior center administrators.
* Promptly investigate and resolve participant grievances, conducting service recovery calls as appropriate to maintain high service satisfaction.

#### **4\. Fleet Operations \& Compliance Management**

* Assist in maintaining an operational fleet of lift\-equipped vans, ADA\-accessible minibuses, and ambulatory vehicles.
* Ensure precise management of transportation logs, fuel card tracking, preventative maintenance schedules, and mileage records.
* Uphold strict organizational policies, safety standards, and state/federal regulatory guidelines.
* Assist in organizing quarterly driver safety training sessions and facilitate necessary retraining programs.
* Oversee accurate, timely data entry within the FileMaker management system.

#### **5\. Operational Support \& Emergency Response**

* Serve as a back\-up driver during peak service demand, emergency coverage needs, or staffing shortages.
* Support process\-improvement initiatives and contribute to strategic operational goals assigned by leadership.

jobs.title: Operations Manager, AV Projects
jobs.description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data\-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.



As an **Operations Manager, Autonomous Vehicle Projects** on Via's Operations team, you are the force that keeps our services running reliably for the communities that depend on them. This is a high\-ownership role where you'll lead daily operations, optimize accessible transit networks, and support initiatives for Via's growing portfolio of autonomous and specialized Wheelchair Accessible Vehicle (WAV) fleets.


**This is a field position with an expectation that you will be onsite at local services several days per week. There will also be monthly travel to services located across the United States.**


**What You'll Do:**


* Run the daily onsite operations of our service, ensuring our fleets operate smoothly to provide riders with safe, reliable, and fully accessible transportation.
* Make informed, real\-time decisions regarding fleet availability, WAV compliance, rider accessibility needs, and unexpected issues—stepping in quickly to ensure continuously excellent, dependable service.
* Turn rider, mobility\-advocate, and community feedback into tangible operational improvements, addressing accessibility friction points and collaborating with internal teams to enhance the WAV rider experience.
* Use data and technology to analyze ridership trends, service performance, and fleet utilization, spearheading operational solutions that maximize transit efficiency and rider independence.
* Act as the operational bridge between local partners, safety drivers, third\-party operators, and Via central teams to elevate accessible mobility standards across all markets.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for Via's AV partners and local operators, maintaining proactive, ongoing communication to deliver on service goals and resolve operational issues as they arise.
* Travel to key markets to lead driver onboarding and specialized WAV safety/securement training, while establishing strong operational relationships with local disability advocate groups and transit partners.


**Who You Are:**


* Excited to bring about the future of transit and the opportunity to travel
* Operationally experienced, with a background in people management, logistics, customer service, or process\-oriented work (experience with paratransit, Non\-emergency Medical Transport, or WAV fleets is a strong plus).
* Relationship\-oriented, earning trust from riders, accessibility advocates, teammates, and external partners through empathetic, clear communication and follow\-through.
* Hands\-on and proactive, eager to understand the end\-to\-end WAV rider journey firsthand and solve mobility challenges right where they happen.
* Tactical and strategic, capable of triaging live operational issues while building long\-term processes that safeguard service quality and accessibility compliance.
* Mission\-driven, deeply motivated by expanding equitable transit access and transforming how communities move.
* Based in LA or Bay Area, able to be on\-site and in\-office when needed.


**Compensation and Benefits:**


* Final salary will be determined by the candidate's experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable.
* Salary Range: $70,000–$90,000 / per year.
* We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans and 401K matching.


There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of inclusive public mobility. Ready to join the ride?


*Via is an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager- AI Learning Operations
jobs.description:
**We Are:**


At Udacity (a part of Accenture), we aim to bring accessible, engaging, and highly relevant education to the world. We believe that education is not limited to four years or four walls, it’s a lifelong pursuit. Technology is advancing rapidly; there is a growing skills gap between jobseekers and career opportunities, and between an enterprise’s strategies and employee’s skill to execute. Udacity is dedicated to closing these gaps. To do this, we're rethinking how education is made and delivered by empowering our students to advance themselves personally and professionally.

 **The Work:**

**Senior Program Managers** **for Learning Operations** plan and run the programs that deliver each pod's roadmap. They own the plans, timelines, dependencies, and coordination that turn a pod's intent into delivered learning, keeping content and video work sequenced so parallel work lands together. They track commitments against delivery, surface slippage early, clear blockers, and communicate status to pod members, Video Production team, and Learning Experience leadership. They run the operating rhythm for the programs they own, planning cadences, stand\-ups, and reviews.

  

The **Senior Program Manager** will own the largest and most cross\-cutting programs, including leadership of key initiatives within the **AI Pod and across the Learning Experience organization**. The role will establish delivery standards for the PMO, drive strategic cross\-functional initiatives, and provide people leadership to one Program Manager who reports to them.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* Plan and drive programs end\-to\-end: scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, and delivery against the roadmap.
* Track commitments against delivery, surfacing slippage early, and driving recovery.
* Coordinate across pods (content, video, architecture) so parallel work lands together.
* Manage communication with internal ALV stakeholders.
* Clear blockers and manage risks and escalations to keep programs moving.
* Communicate clear, timely status to pod members, Video Production team, and LX leadership.
* Run the operating rhythm: planning cadences, stand\-ups, release readiness, and reviews for the programs they own.
* Manage process improvement and strategic initiative workstreams.

  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 4 years of program and project management experience
* Bachelor's degree

 **Professional Skills Requirements:**

* Experience within the EdTech industry
* Awareness of adult learning theory and principles
* Experience with AI tooling for planning, status, and reporting work

 **Professional Skills Requirements:**

* Ability to manage programs involving interdependent workstreams, including dependency mapping and risk tracking
* Deep reporting discipline, including how to structure status so slippage shows up early.
* Drives delivery amid ambiguity; makes calls and unblocks without waiting for perfect clarity.
* Anticipates slippage before it becomes a miss; stays organized and proactive.
* Communicates and influences across pods, functions, leads, and stakeholders.
* Manages and grows people, sets clear expectations, gives constructive, actionable feedback, and nurtures development.
* Sees the pattern behind repeated delivery problems and fixes it at the process level

jobs.title: Program Manager, Safeguards Workforce Operations
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



Anthropic’s Safeguards Enforcement team detects and mitigates misuse of Claude, and much of that work depends on people: a growing human review workforce made up of full\-time staff, contractors, vendors and BPO partners. As that workforce scales across a widening range of harm areas, the programs that bring people in, give them the right access, and roll them off cleanly have to keep pace.



As Program Manager for Safeguards Workforce Operations, you’ll own those programs end to end. You’ll run onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning and access provisioning for every worker type we use, working hands\-on with the requests themselves while you build the processes that make them repeatable. You’ll partner with Enforcement leads to turn shifting priorities into capacity plans, and carry those plans through with our vendor partners. Because this role supports every Safeguards Enforcement program, you’ll also connect the dots across Anthropic, working with IT, People Operations, Security, Contingent Workforce, Human Data Operations and other teams running scaled human review to streamline practices and keep standards consistent.



This is a role for someone who likes fixing broken things at speed. The landscape moves quickly, priorities change often, and the work is an even mix of direct execution and program building.


**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Own the workforce lifecycle for contractor, vendor and BPO reviewers: onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning and access provisioning
* Triage and execute inbound requests for new or changing vendor, BPO and contractor capacity
* Turn ad hoc or broken processes into scalable ones, with clear owners, service levels and a system of record
* Partner with IT and Security on access governance: least\-privilege provisioning, timely revocation and regular access reviews
* Build and maintain capacity plans with Enforcement leads, translating review demand into workforce needs and adjusting as priorities shift
* Work with Safeguards vendor management to hold partners accountable to capacity and onboarding commitments
* Align practices with Human Data Operations and other teams running scaled human review, and help them streamline their own workflows
* Help define the long\-term workforce strategy for Safeguards Enforcement

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------


* Have personally run onboarding, offboarding, access and device provisioning for contractor, vendor or BPO workforces — doing the work, not only overseeing it
* Have operated scaled human review programs with vendors or BPOs, such as trust \& safety, content moderation or data annotation operations
* Have taken a broken or ad hoc process, made it scalable, and brought other teams along in adopting it
* Understand the fundamentals of capacity planning: how volume, handle time, quality targets, ramp and attrition turn into workforce needs
* Exercise sound judgment on access and permissions, and know when to bring in IT or Security
* Move quickly and stay effective when priorities change and information is incomplete
* Build alignment through direct partnership with the teams you depend on

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------


* Owned a vendor or BPO relationship directly, including service levels and business reviews
* Built formal capacity models for review or operations workforces
* Supported workforces across more than one enforcement or harm area
* Hands\-on experience with device management and identity and access tooling
* Worked through a period of hypergrowth where programs had to mature alongside the organization
The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.



For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.


Annual Salary:


$245,000 \- $285,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------


**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience


**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience


**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position


**Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.


**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.


**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. jobs.title: Customer Operations Support Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.  

Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
Responsibilities:
**THE ROLE:**  

Customer Operations Account Manager is responsible for operations between AMD and its customers. They build strong and sustainable relationships at operational and managerial levels within both the Customer’s and AMD’s organization. The Customer Operations Account Manager leverages these relationships to manage expectations, improve operations, and resolve order, supply, delivery, forecast and other operational issues. They work to achieve organizational goals. **RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Executes timely/ongoing review of customer backlogs and collaborates with stakeholders to resolve (e.g., factory, finance, sales, and customers)
* Manages business through all stages of the product lifecycle (NPI, EOL)
* Manages inventory and DOI (Days of Inventory) to prevent incurring inventory cost to AMD)
* Manages Demand vs Supply profiles for AMD direct customers or distribution channels
* Monitors the consumption rate and ordering patterns to perform standard demand/supply analysis
* From forecast understanding and maintenance, effectively manages on\-time revenue forecasting as assigned
* Identify and manage key internal and external strategic relationships at multiple levels of management to ensure business continuitng
* Drive projects and processes of identified importance within the organization and provide consultative advice to management, including business partners
* Work collaboratively within the team to share best practices and remove obstacles for all
* Develop self, adopt new tools and processes to achieve goals, create new ways to enhance the organization’s capability
* Enable effective and efficient service through operational excellence and customer collaboration
* Provide leadership and collect feedback in the implementation of new processes in support of the strategy
* Engage with customers through quarterly business reviews and operational meetings
* Provide guidance and support on operational issue resolution
* Support customer operations through a high\-level understanding of business processes and procedures

 **QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIRED SKILLS:**  

* Possess understanding of business strategy and the ability to identify areas for process improvement
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to implement solution
* Ability to write executive communications
* Strong oral and presentation skills, and can discuss operational concepts with customer, management and team
* Demonstrated use of AI Tools
* Ability to manage conflict internally and externally
* Experience in developing and strengthening customer relationships
* Strong analytical skills required, with the ability to manage cross functional dependencies
* Ability to deal with uncertainty
* Strong Excel, PowerPoint and Power BI skills
* Strong Supply Chain knowledge
* Project management experience

 **EDUCATION:*** Bachelor's degree and/or equivalent industry\-related experience

 **LOCATION:*** San Jose, CA

 **This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.**

jobs.title: Program Manager Evaluation & Learning
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------



The Program Manager of Evaluation \& Learning is a core member of CCSCC's Organizational Effectiveness team, responsible for leading CCSCC's outcomes measurement and continuous improvement work across all CCSCC programs.



This role builds and maintains the systems, tools, and culture that allow the agency to understand whether programs are producing desired outcomes, communicate results to funders and the Board, and use data to improve decision\-making.



The Program Manager partners closely with program leadership, IT/CIS staff, and accreditation or compliance leads to ensure that data collection, measurement, and reporting are embedded in daily operations.



This is a strategic and hands\-on role responsible for developing evaluation frameworks, creating reporting infrastructure, analyzing data, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Outcomes Measurement \& Evaluation Strategy**


* Lead the design and ongoing refinement of an agency\-wide outcomes measurement framework, including logic models and theories of change.
* Collaborate with internal teams to create, implement, review, and use theories of change, program models, journey maps, and other strategy and evaluation tools.
* Define meaningful, measurable outcomes and process indicators.
* Collaborate with outside partners when appropriate, including research institutions and evaluation partners.
* Design, implement, and oversee evaluation plans for individual programs, including data collection methodologies, measurement protocols, sampling, and analysis methods.
* Co\-design and lead evaluation of the Vision 2030 Strategic Plan and other strategic initiatives.
* Establish and measure baseline KPIs and monitor progress across the organization.
* Conduct research and analysis to identify and implement best practices in evaluation and outcomes measurement.

### **Training \& Capacity Building**


* Train program leadership to run reports, analyze data, assess outcomes, and develop meaningful narratives.
* Design and facilitate training sessions on evaluation and learning topics, including logic models, measurement frameworks, data interpretation, and visualization.
* Create and deliver evaluation and learning onboarding training for program leadership staff.
* Foster a culture where data informs program design and continuous quality improvement.

### **Data Systems, Analysis \& Reporting**


* Analyze program activity, outcome, and impact data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities.
* Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports for staff, executive leadership, the Board, and funders.
* Lead creation and validation of agency\-wide reports, including accreditation and annual reporting requirements.
* Translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives for non\-technical audiences.
* Partner with IT/CIS and program teams to ensure data systems support consistent and reliable reporting.
* Identify and resolve data quality issues, workflow gaps, and integration needs.
* Provide technical support and guidance related to data collection and management tools.
* Maintain documentation of data definitions, workflows, and reporting processes.

### **Cross\-Program Collaboration \& Community Engagement**


* Partner with compliance and quality assurance staff to understand reporting and outcome requirements.
* Support standardization of measurement practices across program areas while accommodating program\-specific needs.
* Lead referral tracking and process\-mapping efforts that intersect with outcomes measurement.
* Coordinate with accreditation leads to ensure measurement practices meet external standards.
* Develop research protocols and engagement strategies that involve community members, donors, and funders.
* Conduct literature reviews and research to inform program development and organizational strategy.
* Represent CCSCC in meetings and presentations with internal and external stakeholders.
* Support agency\-wide strategic planning through data and evaluation expertise.

### **Staff Supervision \& Development**


* Supervise, coach, and develop Data Analyst(s), interns, and other assigned staff.
* Manage hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management activities.
* Provide ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
* Conduct regular supervision and team meetings.

### **Financial Management \& Fund Development**


* Manage assigned Evaluation \& Learning budgets and resources.
* Collaborate with program and development leaders to identify funding opportunities.
* Support grants and contracts through timely completion of deliverables and reporting.

### **Funder \& External Reporting**


* Prepare outcome and impact data for grant reports, site visits, and public\-facing communications.
* Support program leadership in creating compelling, data\-informed narratives.
* Ensure evaluation methods and reporting comply with funder and accreditation requirements.

### **Policy Development \& Implementation**


* Develop and improve policies and procedures that support high\-quality service delivery.
* Collaborate with agency leadership on communications and strategic planning initiatives.
* Inform community partners about gaps, barriers, and opportunities identified through evaluation efforts.

**Qualifications**
------------------


### **Required**


* Bachelor's degree in Public Health, Social Work, Public Policy, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* 3 to 5\+ years of experience in program evaluation, data analysis, or outcomes measurement.
* Experience developing logic models, theories of change, and evaluation frameworks.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis skills.
* Experience with Power BI, SQL, reporting tools, or business intelligence platforms.
* Experience leveraging AI\-assisted technologies to support reporting, analysis

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations, Office of the CCO
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



The Office of the Chief Commercial Officer is a small team that works directly with our CCO, go\-to\-market leadership, and company leadership on Anthropic’s highest\-priority commercial initiatives. We take on problems that do not sit cleanly inside one team, such as standing up a program that spans Product, Finance, Legal, and Sales, or preparing the material our executives and Board use to make decisions. Our commercial business is growing faster than its operating processes can be built, so a growing share of the job is stepping into gaps and running something important, while making sure other teams are building the capabilities to permanently own.



You will own workstreams end to end. One week that means running the go\-to\-market side of a pressing situation, from the communications plan for customers and account teams to the daily readout for executives. Another week it means building the analysis behind a resourcing decision or a new program and writing it up for the CCO. This is an internal role. You will report to the CCO’s chief of staff, and you will have an unusually broad view of how the company makes decisions.


**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------


* Drive priority go\-to\-market initiatives from plan to delivery, removing blockers, escalating early, and connecting the right people across teams at the right time
* Build the analysis, draft the document or deck, and turn input from many teams into a recommendation executives can act on
* Prepare content for the CCO and leadership team, including weekly staff meetings, updates to the Office of the CEO, Board materials, and leadership offsites
* Track the go\-to\-market organization’s top priorities and keep a current view of status, owners, and risks
* Act as a bridge between go\-to\-market and Product, Finance, Legal, Safeguards, and Research, so that what account teams hear from customers reaches product decisions and those decisions reach account teams in a usable form
* Step in where something important has no clear owner, run it until it has a permanent home, and hand it over cleanly
* Close out same\-day executive requests quickly and to a high standard

**You may be a good fit if you:**
---------------------------------


* Have 4\+ years of experience in management consulting, strategy and operations, a chief of staff team, or a similarly rigorous environment working with senior executives
* Structure ambiguous problems well and get to a clear recommendation
* Can get to a number yourself in a spreadsheet, in SQL, or with Claude, check it against a second source, and explain where it came from
* Write and speak clearly and briefly for executive audiences
* Are as willing to maintain the tracker and chase the last open items as to write the strategy
* Are comfortable with significant autonomy and with priorities that shift on short notice, pay close attention to detail, and know when to escalate
* Build trust quickly with senior people across the company who are short on time
* Use AI tools as a core part of how you work
* Care about Anthropic’s mission and about getting safe, useful AI to customers

### **Strong candidates may also have**


* Experience in technology, SaaS, or enterprise software, or exposure to go\-to\-market strategy, sales operations, or customer success
* Experience running a product launch, a program office, or another cross\-functional effort with many owners and a fixed date
* Familiarity with how large enterprises buy and adopt technology, including security, legal, and procurement review

Annual Salary:


$190,000 \- $270,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------


**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience


**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience


**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position


**Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.


**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

**Rasmussen Construction \| Novato, California**  
**Salary: $110,000–$170,000 annually, based on qualifications**

Rasmussen Construction is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to independently lead exceptional residential projects and become a fundamental part of our team.

Our company combines the technical capability and modern project management systems needed for highly complex construction with the warmth and personal attention of a compact office. Clients come to us for our craftsmanship and integrity. They stay with us because of the relationships we build and the service we provide.

The role oversees planning and execution of physical security system projects—including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, perimeter protection, and supporting infrastructure. It requires strong technical knowledge, disciplined project management, and the ability to coordinate across Corporate Security, IT, and business partners. The PM follows IT/CSD PMO standards, tools, and templates to ensure consistent, compliant, and high\-quality project delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**  
Project Planning \& Execution

* Develop and manage project plans, schedules, and resource allocations using approved IT/CSD PMO methodologies and templates.
* Conduct site assessments to validate design requirements, installation conditions, and risk factors.
* **Coordinate installation of access control, CCTV, alarms, intercoms, and related low voltage systems.**
* Manage subcontractors, technicians, and vendors to ensure adherence to scope and standards.
* Oversee procurement of materials, equipment, and permits required for installation work.
* Ensure all project documentation aligns with PMO expectations, including charters, risk logs, communication plans, and closeout packages.

**Leadership \& Quality Control**

* Lead on site operations, ensuring safety compliance, quality workmanship, and efficient workflow.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and provide guidance to installation teams.
* Conduct inspections, testing, and commissioning of installed systems.
* Maintain accurate documentation, including as built, change orders, and progress reports, using PMO approved formats.

**Client \& Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and internal partners throughout project execution.
* Provide structured status updates, dashboards, and reporting consistent with IT/CSD PMO communication standards.
* Manage expectations around timelines, deliverables, and technical requirements.
* Facilitate handoff to support teams after project completion.

**Budget \& Risk Management**

* Track project budgets, labor hours, and material costs to ensure financial performance.
* Identify scope changes and prepare change order documentation.
* Maintain risk and issue logs in alignment with PMO processes.
* Mitigate project risks through proactive planning and issue resolution.

**Required Qualifications**

* \+7 years of experience managing physical security or low voltage installation projects.
* Strong knowledge of access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, and related hardware/software.
* Experience with access control platforms such as AMAG, Software House, Genetec, or similar systems.
* Ability to read construction drawings, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications.
* Proficiency with project management tools and documentation practices aligned with PMO standards.
* Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to job sites.
* Strong communication, leadership, and problem solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications such as PMP, PSP, CPP, or manufacturer specific credentials (AMAG, Genetec, Avigilon, etc.).
* Experience working with general contractors, integrators, or enterprise security teams.
* Familiarity with OSHA safety standards and job site compliance requirements.
* Background in construction management, including experience coordinating trades, understanding construction sequencing, or working within general contractor environments.
* Background in electrical systems or low voltage trades or prior experience working for a physical security integrator.

**Success Indicators**

* Consistent use of IT/CSD PMO tools, templates, and governance processes.
* Projects delivered on time, within budget, and to quality standards.
* Strong relationships with clients, subcontractors, and internal teams.
* Accurate documentation and consistent communication.
* Safe, efficient, and well\-coordinated installation operations.

Pay: $75\.00 \- $80\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Project Manager - Service
jobs.description:
The Service Project Manager (SPM) role involves overseeing multiple project lifecycles, from initial cost estimation to completion, for HVAC/plumbing installations, service projects, and large\-scale repairs. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in HVAC system operations, strong project management expertise, and the ability to ensure cost\-effective solutions while maintaining high\-quality standards.


**Responsibilities**

* Analyze project requirements and customer needs to develop accurate cost estimates for HVAC service work, including repairs, replacements, and retrofits.
* Review drawings, specifications, and other documents to determine project scope and material requirements.
* Collaborate with service technicians, project managers, and sales teams to ensure estimates align with operational capabilities, and customer expectations.
* Actively manage/mentor support personnel under your direct report (if applicable).
* Obtain and evaluate multiple vendor quotes for equipment, materials, and subcontractor services to ensure cost\-effective solutions.
* Prepare comprehensive proposals that outline labor, materials, and overhead costs, ensuring alignment with company pricing strategies and industry standards.
* Communicate with customers to clarify project details, answer questions, and provide recommendations to optimize system performance and cost efficiency.
* Track and manage bid deadlines, revisions, and approvals, ensuring timely and accurate submission of estimates.
* Oversee post\-estimate project handoff, providing clear scope, schedule \& budget details to field personnel and service teams.
* Manage HVAC service projects from planning to completion, ensuring on\-time and on\-budget delivery.
* Coordinate with labor force leadership to ensure seamless project execution.
* Monitor project progress, managing any challenges to maintain efficiency and quality standards.
* Manage multiple projects and bid opportunities simultaneously.
* Utilize company CRM, bid, and project management platforms.
* Create a detailed schedule that aligns with customer expectations, equipment lead times, and field team availability.
* Communicate with customers throughout the project lifecycle, providing updates, ensuring satisfaction, and addressing concerns.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations, industry standards, and company policies.
* Oversee procurement of materials, equipment, and labor resources for assigned projects.
* Track project costs and manage profitability, adjusting as necessary to stay within budget.
* Maintain accurate documentation, including contracts, change orders, and project reports.
* Prepare required closeout package.
* Stay informed about industry trends, new technologies, and best practices to improve service operations.
* Coordinate with Area Supervisors and Foremen to schedule projects, maintenance, and repairs efficiently.
* Drive personal sales goals.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering (mechanical, industrial, etc. ), Construction Management, or related field experience.
* 5\-7 or more years work experience project engineering in HVAC, MEP, or construction.
* Extensive knowledge of HVAC systems, plumbing, ductwork, piping, refrigeration, and energy efficiency solutions.
* Deep understanding of HVAC and plumbing systems, service processes, and industry standards.
* Digitally savvy, including excellent PC application skills and the ability to quickly learn numerous custom software applications.
* Proficiency in estimating and project management software (e.g.,Procore, Bluebeam, Fast Pipe, \& Fast Duct).
* Familiarity with HVAC load calculations and system design.

**Skills**

* Excellent communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to clearly convey information to customers, technicians, vendors, and management.
* Active listening to understand client needs and field concerns.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong written communication for proposals, reports, and documentation.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Conflict resolution skills to handle workplace challenges.
* Ability to negotiate contracts, pricing, and timelines with vendors and subcontractors.
* Ability to review performance and identify improvement strategy.
* Eagerness to learn, take initiative, and grow professionally within the field.
* Ability to travel occasionally to project sites and work in a team environment.
* Delegation and accountability to ensure efficiency in project execution.
* Persuasive communication to secure approvals and sell service solutions.
* Ensuring accuracy in cost estimates, documentation, and compliance with regulations.


An effective and successful Service Project Manager is a highly organized and detail\-oriented professional who excels in overseeing HVAC service projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. They possess a strong combination of technical knowledge, leadership skills, and customer service expertise.

jobs.title: Senior UX Program Manager, Discover and Explore
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of program management experience within design or UX organizations.
* Experience with UX related projects and UX design, user research, or user centered development tools and methodologies.
* Experience in consumer product organizations.
* Experience managing and scaling horizontal programs across cross\-functional teams.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with the product development life\-cycle.
* Experience analyzing data and leveraging insights to drive strategy.
* Experience managing risks (e.g. operational, product, team health).

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." UX Programs \& Operations drives projects by increasing communication, streamlining the UX design process, and fostering a culture of user\-centered development. You will join our multi\-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, to create industry\-leading products based on user insights.  

  

As a UX Program Manager, you will combine expert project management with a passion for user experience to improve the design of products used by billions. Your role is to plan projects, define milestones, assess risks, create actionable insights, and ensure deadlines are met. You will harmonize the work of various UX disciplines and cross\-functional partners to drive team objectives and create innovative experiences.



As a UX Program Manager across both the Agentic and Discover and Explore UX pillars (DEUX), you will partner with UX Research and cross\-functional leads to scale impactful programs, land insights into product strategy and roadmaps and establish clear team operational rhythms.


In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Provide leadership and operational excellence across UX teams to deliver the highest level of trust\-building and strategic counsel through all project interactions, while building strong collaborative relationships with appropriate stakeholders across program work.
* Develop business cases and engagement with partners on continuous improvements and optimizations, creating measurable, scalable, and repeatable processes/tools that drive seamless cross\-functional collaborations/handoffs.
* Run and implement analytical efforts for broader or cross\-functional projects, programs, and strategies.
* Contribute to the definition, integration and reporting of key UX metrics that drive a culture of user\-centered development based on program needs and stakeholder input.
* Manage large, complex programs while turning chaos into an efficient organization.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Veolia has acquired Clean Earth. As Clean Earth completes its integration into Veolia, recruiting and hiring for this role is being managed in partnership with the Clean Earth talent acquisition team.


Veolia in North America is the top\-ranked environmental company in the United States for three consecutive years, and the country’s largest private water operator and technology provider as well as hazardous waste and pollution treatment leader. It offers a full spectrum of water, waste, and energy management services, including water and wastewater treatment, commercial and hazardous waste collection and disposal, energy consulting and resource recovery.


Veolia helps commercial, industrial, healthcare, higher education and municipality customers throughout North America. Headquartered in Boston, Veolia has more than 10,000 employees working at more than 350 locations across North America.

 **Job Description**  

The Onsite Project Manager will work full\-time at a customer location, with responsibility to supervise and coordinate all activities for the receipt and shipment of hazardous waste materials in accordance with applicable Federal, State, and local regulations and company policies, practices and procedures. This position will execute environmental compliance tasks to support the customer’s environmental plans, permits and programs. The primary responsibilities will be management and disposal of hazardous and non\-hazardous wastes.

* Acts as daily point of contact with customer and outside entities for environmental compliance activities
* Monitor waste accumulation areas, assisting as needed with identification, segregation, profiling, labeling and staging
* Assist with waste characterization of various waste streams
* Supervise, plan and schedule all work activities related to receipt and shipping of waste ensuring internal deadlines are met
* Work with on\-site teams daily to monitor waste and recycling programs and maintain swaps and pickups as needed.
* Prepare and provide of customer data, metrics and/or reports as required
* Internally support and monitor customer requirements, to ensure Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s) are met/exceeded
* Facilitate and conduct compliance inspections at the customer location and implement corrective actions based on results of compliance inspections
* Coordinate incoming waste and outbound loads including managing paperwork
* Conduct Safety Meetings to ensure that all employees comply with all job safe operating procedures including equipment maintenance.
* Ensure a clean and orderly work area is maintained at all times, proper chemical storage, proper labeling and handling techniques, and proper use of personal protective equipment
* Provide production reports to management
* Supervise the direct shipping, receiving, packaging, and processing of hazardous waste materials in compliance with standard operational procedures and regulatory requirements
* Supervise sampling for waste stream identification and perform spot testing to assure safe and appropriate consolidation of waste streams
* Supervise segregation, transfer and compacting procedures according to company policies, job safe practices, and quality assurance guidelines, and correct any deficiencies
* Maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements
* Report and respond to plant emergencies as needed in accordance with the Contingency Plan.
* Makes recommendations and/or approvals on salary adjustments, promotions, transfers, and dismissals within their assigned areas.
* Promotes Safety and Security initiatives across the entire team within their assigned areas.
* **Performs other related duties and/or project work as required or requested.**

**Work Environment**

* Willingness and ability to work in a hands\-on manner to execute key initiatives and activities.
* Must be willing and able to abide by Clean Earth’s Core Values and Code of Conduct.
* Required to wear company\-provided personal protective equipment including eye protection, foot protection, hard hat, Tyvek coveralls, and respirator.
* Willingness and ability to travel via automobile, commercial airline and other public transportation as needed.

  

**Qualifications** **Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in an Environmental/Science or Business\-related field

**Experience:** (*Required minimum of years of relevant experience.)*

  

* Minimum 2 years of relevant industry experience with hazardous waste
* Minimum 3 years of experience in a business or project management\-based role
* Minimum 2 years of managing an operations team.
* 40\-hour Hazwoper and 8\-hour refresher certification

**Skills**: ***(The skills listed are the abilities and knowledge required to perform the job effectively******.)***

* Knowledge of RCRA, DOT, OSHA and DEA Regulations as they relate to waste characterization and the transportation of hazardous waste
* Prior experience with DOT shipping, packaging, and labeling requirements for hazardous waste
* Prior experience reading and interpreting signs, labels, waste documents, manifests, procedures, and regulations
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint

  

**Additional Information** **Starting salary \- $95,000 \- $95\.000**


Benefits: Comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, commencing no later than January 1, 2027, benefits package will include participation in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement.
