jobs.title: Admissions & Programs Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**POSITION OVERVIEW:**


We have an exciting full\-time opportunity for an **Admissions \& Program Operations Coordinator** at El Chante, our licensed 20\-bed residential substance use treatment program serving adult men in Oakland, Alameda County.


This role serves as the primary administrative liaison for all admissions into the residential Substance Use Disorder (SUD) program. This position is responsible for coordinating referrals, admissions, discharges, bed management, census reporting, and client appointment scheduling while ensuring compliance with agency, county, and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with the Clinical Program Manager, SUD Counselors, Resident Monitors, referral partners, county partners, medical and housing partners, and agency leadership, the Coordinator helps ensure seamless client movement through the program while maximizing residential capacity and supporting high\-quality service delivery. This collaboration ensures timely admissions, efficient bed management, effective communication, and a coordinated client experience from referral through discharge.


This is a full\-time, non\-exempt position working 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. The successful candidate will uphold and champion the agency's mission, vision, and values while contributing to a collaborative, inclusive, and client\-centered work environment.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Admissions/Intake Coordination:**
===================================

* Serves as the central point of contact for all referrals and admissions into the residential program.
* Receive and coordinate referrals from all approved referral sources.
* Schedule client intake appointments based on bed availability and program capacity.
* Confirm admission dates and times with referral partners.
* Coordinate client transportation and drop\-off times to El Chante, as appropriate.
* Communicate admission instructions to referral sources, clients, and family members when appropriate.
* Monitor the intake schedule to ensure efficient utilization of available beds.
* Collaborate with the Clinical Program Manager and clinical staff regarding admission priorities and clinical considerations.

**Resident Census and Discharge Management:**
=============================================

* Maintains accurate and up\-to\-date information regarding all client admissions and discharges.
* Tracks all scheduled admissions.
* Monitors anticipated discharge dates.
* Coordinates discharge information with internal staff and referral partners.
* Updates admission and discharge logs.
* Communicates changes in bed availability to appropriate stakeholders.
* Maintains accurate census information to support operational planning.

**Bed Management and Census Reporting:**
========================================

* Maintain accurate daily census information and complete required reporting related to residential capacity.
* Completing daily bed surveys.
* Maintaining the Daily Bed Day Sheet.
* Tracking occupied and available beds.
* Monitoring program census and bed utilization.
* Ensuring bed tracking documentation is accurate and submitted within required timeframes.
* Working with leadership to maximize occupancy while maintaining appropriate clinical placement.

**Client Scheduling and Administrative Coordination:**
======================================================

* Manage the daily administrative schedule for residential clients to ensure appointments are coordinated and communicated effectively.
* Coordinate and maintain schedules for:
* Court appearances.
* Medical appointments.
* Primary care visits.
* Dental appointments.
* Specialty medical appointments.
* Medication Assisted Treatment (MAT) clinic visits.
* Behavioral health appointments.
* Other approved external appointments.
* Communicates daily schedules with Resident Monitors, SUD Counselors, and the Clinical Program Manager to support transportation planning, clinical programming, and continuity of care.

### **Administrative Support Responsibilities**

* Provide timely, professional administrative support during scheduled hours, including monitoring and responding to phone calls, email, Slack, and stakeholder inquiries.
* Serve as a primary administrative point of contact for El Chante, providing information to clients, referral partners, community agencies, and other stakeholders and supporting positive community relationships.
* Support admissions and census management, including responding to referrals, maintaining intake and census records, preparing admission packets, coordinating communication related to admissions, transfers, and discharges, and maintaining referral and tracking systems.
* Maintain accurate program, client, staff, and reporting records in systems including Smart Care, Clinician’s Gateway, Salesforce, Paycom, Google Drive, and other applicable databases. Generate required reports and support billing, DATAR, Medi\-Cal eligibility, service\-hour, bed\-day, and other contract reporting requirements.
* Maintain accurate and compliant client and personnel documentation, including charts, licenses, certifications, TB records, training records, staff IDs, NPI/CAQH information, and system access. Ensure documentation meets agency, contract, HIPAA, and regulatory requirements and coordinate with HR and QA as needed.
* Support staff onboarding and ongoing administrative needs, including system access, required training and certifications, Clinician’s Gateway authorizations, and training on internal systems and procedures.
* Coordinate and track facility operations, maintenance, supplies, deliveries, mail, faxes, equipment, technology, and maintenance requests to support a safe, organized, and fully operational residential environment.
* Support the therapeutic milieu by engaging appropriately with residents and assisting program staff with administrative and operational needs as appropriate.

jobs.title: Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY:**


Sierra Circuits is a Silicon Valley\-based leader in printed circuit board manufacturing and assembly, specializing in high\-quality, quick\-turn and complex prototypes. With over 35 years of experience, Sierra provides a seamless, end\-to\-end PCB solution—from design and fabrication to assembly and testing—all under one roof at its state\-of\-the\-art facilities in Sunnyvale, California. Sierra Circuits is committed to supporting engineers and designers through extensive educational resources. The company offers free online tools such as the Stackup Designer, Impedance Calculator, Material Selector, and BOM and DFM Checkers, along with technical blogs, webinars, design guides, and its SierraConnect community forum. Sierra Circuit serves all industries including aerospace, defense, medical, automotive, and telecommunications, building PCBs to the highest industry standards, and keeping innovation at the forefront of everything we do.

 **SUMMARY OF JOB FUNCTION:**


The "Quality Manager” is responsible for overseeing all aspects of quality control within a printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturing facility, ensuring that all production processes adhere to strict quality standards, implementing continuous improvement initiatives, and maintaining compliance with industry regulations, by leading a team of quality inspectors and engineers while collaborating closely with other departments to deliver high\-quality PCBs consistently. **RESPONSIBILITIES AND ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* **Quality Management System (QMS) Oversight:** Develop, implement, and maintain a robust QMS system aligned with industry standards, including documentation, procedures, and quality metrics to monitor and improve PCB production processes.
* **Quality Control Inspections:** Lead a team of quality inspectors to conduct thorough inspections at various stages of PCB manufacturing, including raw materials, in\-process checks, and final product testing, identifying and addressing quality issues promptly.
* **Process Improvement:** Analyze quality data to identify trends and areas for improvement, implement corrective actions, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize production processes and minimize defects.

jobs.title: GCP Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III), you will support Public Sector customers with cloud adoption, operational planning, technical issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination. Working alongside senior team members, you will help maintain account health and coordinate activities across customer and delivery partner teams. You will contribute to reliable, secure cloud outcomes in complex public\-sector environments. This remote role is available to candidates who can work from within the continental United States.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/21/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III) on the AI \& Engineering team, you will be responsible for:
  

* Coordinate technical activities across assigned customer workstreams and track customer issues, risks, dependencies, action items, and upcoming milestones.
* Collaborate with client Support, Product Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and customer escalations.
* Support customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, and operational readiness activities.
* Prepare materials for technical reviews, quarterly business reviews, and customer meetings; document customer needs and communicate product feedback to client teams.
* Recommend Google Cloud practices that improve adoption, reliability, security, and performance; escalate complex technical or customer issues to the Senior Technical Account Manager.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**

We tailor our delivery approach to each client's priorities, operating environment, and transformation goals.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree or 12\+ years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, software development, or technical consulting.

**Work you'll do/Responsibilities**  

  

The Senior Technical Account Manager leads the technical relationship with strategic Google Public Sector customers. This role owns cloud adoption planning, operational health, executive engagement, and complex escalations while coordinating across Google product, engineering, support, and delivery teams. The successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Lead multiple technical workstreams across complex public\-sector customer environments.
* Serve as the primary trusted technical advisor for customer leaders and executives.
* Develop account\-level cloud adoption plans, operational strategies, and technical roadmaps.
* Lead quarterly business reviews, executive sessions, and technical planning meetings.
* Coordinate critical launches, product releases, capacity planning, and high\-priority customer events.
* Direct complex escalations involving Google Support, Product Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering.
* Advocate for customer requirements and influence product improvements, features, and fixes.
* Identify risks proactively and establish clear plans for resolution.

* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines

**The Team**  

  

AI \& Engineering leverages cutting\-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology \& data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required**  

* 8\+ or more years of customer\-facing cloud, technical consulting, support, or transformation experience, including at least four years supporting Google Cloud implementations or programs.
* Experience leading complex cloud programs, executive relationships, critical launches, and technical escalations.
* At least 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with modern software\-development practices, microservices, distributed systems, and APIs
* Executive\-level communication, influence, problem\-solving, and client\-management skills.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $137,500 to $229,100\.

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

This position is aligned with the Project Delivery Model. To view the associated benefit package, please reference this document USBenefitsJourneyProjectandCenterTAM

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager, Mid-Market
jobs.description:
**About Hyperbound**
--------------------


Deals are messy. Multiple stakeholders, hours of calls, and endless emails. At Hyperbound, we're building the AI Agent that will help sales teams untangle that mess.


Hyperbound is the Revenue Activation Platform: an agentic OS for sales that connects what happens to what should happen next.  

  

We came out of YC S23 and went viral with Voice Agents that reps could call to put their skills to the test. Today, we’re building AI that understands sales conversations, coaches in real time, reasons across deals, and takes action to move them forward.


We are trusted by companies like LinkedIn, Amazon, Bloomberg, Supabase, Monday.com, Notion, and Vanta. We raised a $15M Series A in October 2025, grew ARR 5× over the past year, and are growing nearly 20% month over month.

**About the role**
------------------


You'll own a book of 25 to 40 mid\-market customers ($20k to $100k\+ ARR) and be their day\-to\-day owner at Hyperbound. Your job is to get them live, get their reps using the product.

**What we need from you**
-------------------------

* **Technical depth**: You can debug, trace and reproduce a bug. You go to product or engineering when a problem is below the UI, not because you didn't want to look.
* **Relationship instinct**: You know the key people at every account, they know you, and they message you before they message anyone else. You understand what each customer is trying to fix and you build the plan around that.
* **Ownership**: When something goes wrong, you name the problem, and start solving it. You only pull in more people if required.
* **Conviction**: You push back. When a customer wants to skip the rollout plan, run the wrong cadence, or launch to the whole sales org on day one, you tell them why it won't work and sell them on the approach that will. Customers respect solutions that are sold to them, not handed over. You own the implementation and the outcome, not just the setup.

**Highly preferred**
--------------------

* Background in sales enablement, revenue enablement, or GTM ops. You've rolled out a tool or a methodology to a sales team before and know what it takes to get reps to actually use it.
* Experience implementing or administering Hyperbound or a similar sales coaching platform.

**What your regular Thursday looks like:**
------------------------------------------

* **Implementation**: Own the project plan from kickoff to first live cohort. Rollout design, integrations setup, SSO and SCIM, admin training, launch date.
* **Adoption**: Regular check\-ins, usage reviews, feature demos, and behaviour\-change plays that get reps practising and managers coaching.
* **First\-line technical support**: Discovery on the call, reproduce the issue, file a clean ticket. Solve what can be solved in the UI or a playbook yourself.
* **Voice of the customer**: Own feedback from your accounts and make sure it reaches the product.
* **Health monitoring**: Watch active users, caller counts, and implementation milestones so you act on a slipping account weeks before the renewal conversation, not during it.
* **Commercial signals**: Spot expansion and renewal risk, log it, and hand it to the account manager who owns pricing and paper.
* **Responsiveness**: Fast on Slack, tickets, and email.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* A tag\-team job. You go to customer meetings alone. Bringing a second person is the exception.
* A sales job. Retention comes first. Expansion signals get logged and handed over, not chased. A commercial role. You don't price, negotiate, or own renewal paper. You will be paired with an expansion Account manager who will take care of that.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Comfortable with the technical side: reading logs, reproducing bugs, working through configuration, and explaining a technical issue clearly to both a customer and an engineer. You don't need to be an engineer.
* You broadly understand how a sales team runs: quotas, onboarding, coaching cadences.
* You remove blockers yourself rather than routing customers to another team.
* You can run around 40 accounts and treat them differently on purpose.

**Interview Plan**
------------------

* 30 min call with James, Recruiter
* 30 min call with Keshav, Product Lead
* Take home exercise (1\-3 hours)
* Take home exercise review call (45 min)
* Final interview with Co Founders and team

**Compensation and Benefits**

* $130K\-$160k OTE
* Series A equity
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* Free lunch and dinner in the office
* Commuter benefits


We move fast, from first conversation to offer in 1\-2 weeks

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



The Outside Account Management team at DoorDash partners with restaurant merchants to help them grow simply and profitable on the platform. Our mission is to support merchants throughout their journey – ensuring a positive experience while also helping them unlock meaningful growth opportunities. We work closely with merchants to understand their goals, solve operational challenges, and recommend growth strategies that fit their business – balancing thoughtful partnership with commercial impact.


**About the Role**
------------------



As a **Strategic Partner Manager II (SPM)**, you will own and grow relationships with a portfolio of SMB restaurant partners, operating with a high degree of autonomy and strategic judgment. You'll lead complex, high\-impact partnerships focused on driving long\-term growth, profitability, and retention for merchants on the DoorDash platform.



In this role, you'll move beyond day\-to\-day account management to guide more strategic merchant conversations—helping partners think holistically about growth, operations, and how to scale their business with DoorDash. You'll proactively adapt account plans as opportunities and challenges emerge, identify and address risks early, and consistently drive measurable outcomes across your book of business.



Beyond your own accounts, you'll play an influential role across the team — serving as a voice of the merchant internally, shaping cross\-functional initiatives, and sharing best practices that elevate how DoorDash partners with restaurants at scale.



You'll report to a regional manager within Outside Account Management. We expect this role to be flexible, with time split between traveling to merchants and additional flexibility to work remotely from home or a DoorDash office.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* **Own and grow strategic partnerships:** Manage a portfolio of SMB restaurant partners, consistently driving measurable growth, retention, and satisfaction
* **Lead advanced merchant strategy:** Conduct high\-impact business reviews focused on larger\-scale growth strategies, profitability, and long\-term success
* **Operate autonomously:** Proactively adjust account plans and growth strategies as merchant needs, performance, and market conditions evolve
* **Identify and mitigate risk:** Anticipate detractors, address challenges early, and implement solutions to protect merchant health and performance
* **Drive expansion and optimization:** Recommend and sell DoorDash products that support merchant growth, efficiency, and brand perception
* **Influence cross\-functionally:** Partner with Product, Operations, Sales, and other teams—driving action and outcomes without relying on manager escalation
* **Represent the merchant internally:** Surface meaningful merchant insights each quarter to inform product improvements, GTM strategy, and internal initiatives
* **Elevate the team:** Share best practices, provide feedback on decks and negotiation strategy, and support the development of Partner Managers

**We're excited about you because you have…**
---------------------------------------------


* **4\+ years of experience** in account management, customer success, or post\-sales roles with increasing scope and autonomy
* Proven track record of driving measurable growth and retention across the majority of a book of business
* Strong executive presence with the ability to command a room, influence without authority, and deliver compelling presentations
* Deep understanding of the restaurant and hospitality industry, including merchant P\&L and unit economics
* Advanced analytical skills, including maintaining complex spreadsheets and performing data analysis using tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, Tableau, or Sigma
* Strong knowledge of third\-party delivery platforms, logistics, and multi\-sided marketplaces
* Ability to synthesize data, industry trends, and merchant insights into clear, actionable recommendations
* Collaborative mindset with experience serving as a trusted partner and informal mentor within a team

**About DoorDash**
------------------



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  

  

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.


**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------



We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

$71,200\.00 \- $117,100\.00

The Service Support Manager serves as a technical authority, subject matter expert, and Field Service representative for an assigned subset of product lines, working as part of a team of Service Support Managers supporting the broader portfolio. The role owns complex technical escalations and provides technical leadership across the product lifecycle, from new product introduction and service readiness through ongoing field support and continuous improvement.


The Service Support Manager connects global Field Service teams with Engineering, Product Management, Operations, Quality, Technical Support, and other internal partners to resolve technical issues, translate field needs into action, and maintain the technical service capability and institutional knowledge required to sustainably support assigned product lines globally. This includes ensuring engineers have the technical knowledge, documentation, training, tools, procedures, and support strategies required to effectively support assigned products worldwide.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own technical support and escalations for assigned product lines, supporting field investigations, root cause identification, and timely resolution of complex or urgent issues.
* Represent Field Service in new product introductions, product changes, and ongoing product development to ensure serviceability, field readiness, and continuity of support.
* Develop and maintain standardized service documentation, technical resources, training, and certification programs in partnership with field specialists and instructional design, including supporting controlled quality documentation as required .
* Support global Field Service regions by connecting regional needs with internal teams, driving technical and operational issues toward resolution, and communicating relevant product and production changes back to the field.
* Monitor field performance, complaints, escalations, and recurring technical issues, representing the voice of the customer and Field Service to drive product, process, documentation, and training improvements.

Customer service or customer\-facing experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated technical depth in troubleshooting complex instrument systems, including the ability to independently analyze field symptoms and data, isolate likely failure mechanisms, develop or evaluate diagnostic approaches, and drive issues to root cause and resolution.
* Knowledge of ProteinSimple instrumentation, service workflows, and field support practices is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge of CRM databases and Microsoft Office applications, with the ability to quickly apply new tools to technical communication, documentation, data analysis, and customer support.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical information into clear direction for field teams and cross\-functional partners.

* ### **We foster a culture of empowerment and innovation, where employees feel valued and encouraged to bring their new ideas to the table.**

jobs.title: Clinical Study Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at\-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at\-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.


We are seeking a Clinical Trial Operations Associate to join us in our mission to make brain monitoring easily accessible, interpretable, and actionable. In this role, you will collaborate with clinical research sites, project teams, and internal stakeholders to support the deployment of Beacon's devices in clinical studies. This role focuses on study startup, site management, and live\-study monitoring, ensuring the highest quality standards and compliance with regulatory requirements.

This role is fully remote anywhere in the Pacific or Mountain Timezones in the U.S. and will require up to 5% travel. Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first\-class remote work experience, but we also have in\-person office hubs available located in Boston, New York, and Paris.

**What success looks like**
* Collaborate with project teams to support study startup activities.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clinical sites, ensuring smooth operations and clear communication.
* Provide training to research sites on the use of Beacon's devices and study protocols, ensuring proper device usage and data collection.
* Monitor project progress, ensuring adherence to timelines, protocols, and quality standards.
* Maintain compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines, and regulatory standards.
* Address operational issues promptly, escalating through tools like Zendesk and Asana for resolution.
* Provide actionable feedback from research sites to inform improvements in devices and workflows.


**What you will bring**
* 2\-4\+ years of experience in clinical project management or clinical operations roles.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, additional languages are a bonus.
* Proactive mindset with the ability to identify priorities and anticipate challenges.
* Meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in data collection and reporting.
* Familiarity with GCP, ICH guidelines, and clinical research regulatory requirements.
* Desire to learn more about analytics, statistics, machine learning, and clinical trials.
The salary range for this role is $65,000 – $85,000\. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self\-service mindset, and \- most of all \- a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

jobs.title: Tech Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Bizzaly**

Bizzaly helps small businesses make technology and AI work for them, without the jargon. Our clients include local small businesses across the Bay Area. Many are experienced professionals who are great at their work but overwhelmed by software, subscriptions, and the pace of change in AI. We assess their technology, recommend the right tools, and set everything up so it simply works.

**The role** We're looking for a patient, practical tech professional to handle the hands\-on side of our client work. Our team runs client relationships, business analysis, and training. You'll be the person who makes the recommended changes happen. This is a flexible, project\-based role with room to grow as Bizzaly grows.

**What you'll do**

* Set up and configure business tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, password managers, cloud storage, and backups
* Migrate email, files, and accounts from old systems to new ones
* Connect business apps so they share information (accounting, project management, scheduling, CRM)
* Set up AI tools and help configure simple automations
* Walk clients through their new setup in plain, friendly language
* Document what you set up so our team and clients can refer back to it
* Flag anything outside our scope, such as networks, servers, or hardware, so we can refer it to a partner

**What we're looking for**

* 3\+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, or small\-business technology setup
* Hands\-on experience with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 administration
* Strong security habits, including careful handling of client access and data
* Willingness to learn about new software and tools that small businesses use
* Patience and warmth with non\-technical people. This matters as much as technical skill.
* Reliability and clear communication about timelines
* Ability to travel to client offices in the South Bay occasionally

**Nice to have**

* Experience with small\-business software such as QuickBooks, Gusto, or industry tools (Revit, Bluebeam, real estate CRMs, construction software)
* Experience with automation tools like Zapier or Make
* Comfort using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT

**Why work with us**

* Flexible schedule that fits around other work, retirement, or family
* Meaningful work helping local business owners
* A small, supportive team where your input shapes how we work
* Opportunity to grow into a larger role

Pay: From $40\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sunnyvale, CA 94087

jobs.title: Customer Operations Specialist, Payments
jobs.description:
**Customer Operations Specialist, Payments**
--------------------------------------------

**Role in one line:** Resolve the customer problems that cross payments, disputes, cancellations, audits, and insurance operations before they become repeat calls or unresolved risk.


A payment does not reconcile. A customer raises a dispute. A cancellation notice conflicts with the account record. An audit creates a question nobody can answer from one screen. You establish the real state, speak with the customer, and carry the issue to a documented resolution.


Harper's systems can surface records and prepare routine service work. This role handles the customer problems that still require judgment, persistence, and direct communication across payments and insurance operations.

**Why now**
-----------


Harper serves a growing base of small businesses across many carriers, payment paths, and policy workflows. Routine requests belong with Customer Service. This specialist owns the harder cases that cross systems or require reconciliation across finance, insurance, and service records.


You own payments and disputes, plus the related cancellations, audits, insurance questions, phone work, and complex service problems that often arrive with them. The job is broad because the customer's problem rarely respects one system boundary.

**What you own**
----------------

* **Resolve payment questions.** Trace the payment question through the available records and identify the current state, amount, owner, and next action.
* **Work disputes end to end.** Establish the issue, gather the source records, explain the current state, coordinate the required review, and record the final outcome.
* **Handle cancellation complexity.** Read the full event chain, including notices, effective cancellations, reinstatements, and rescissions, before telling a customer what is true.
* **Support audits.** Help customers understand the audit request, identify the records needed, and route licensed or specialized questions to the correct owner.
* **Answer general insurance questions within authority.** Explain process and recorded facts clearly. Escalate coverage advice and licensed decisions rather than guessing.
* **Talk to people.** Use the phone when a live conversation will resolve confusion faster than another automated message.
* **Reconcile across systems.** Compare the customer record, payment record, policy record, communications, and external confirmation before closing a case.
* **Own the next action.** Keep one named owner, one current state, and one promised update point until the issue is complete.
* **Find the repeated cause.** Flag patterns that should become a permanent product, process, training, or finance fix.

**What resolved means**
-----------------------

* Cases preserve the customer's question, the amount or policy involved, the records checked, the owner, and the next action.
* Payment conclusions name the evidence and the account or transaction they belong to.
* Disputes end with a recorded resolution, customer notification, and any required financial or policy correction.
* Cancellation answers reflect the latest event in the chain, not the loudest notice.
* Repeat contacts decline because the underlying issue was resolved and explained clearly.

**Who thrives here**
--------------------

* You have worked in payments, disputes, cancellations, audits, insurance service, or another high\-volume problem\-solving environment.
* You can read several systems without losing the customer's question.
* You are calm and direct with people who are frustrated or confused.
* You document facts carefully and distinguish a missing record from a missing real\-world action.
* You know when to keep investigating and when to escalate.
* You are comfortable with phone work throughout the day.
* You are based in Atlanta or San Francisco, or ready to relocate to one of those offices.

**Who should not apply**
------------------------

* You want a back\-office role with no customer conversations.
* You close cases when you transfer them.
* You infer payment, cancellation, or coverage from one status field.
* You avoid difficult conversations or detailed reconciliation.
* You need a remote or hybrid default.

**Benefits**
------------


Harper offers health, dental, and vision insurance. Office\-specific benefits will be set by working location.

**How to apply**
----------------


Send your resume and a short example of a customer problem that crossed several systems or teams. Explain how you established the real state, what you told the customer, and how you proved the issue was resolved.


Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.title: Business Operations
jobs.description:
**About HUD**
=============


HUD is building infrastructure to create RL training data and evals for frontier AI agents, as well as a marketplace to sell these to frontier labs through the HUD marketplace. Our platform is used by frontier labs, Fortune 500 companies, and startups. We’ve raised $16M from top VCs and were YC W25\.

**About the role**
------------------


We’re looking for a Business Operations generalist to help build and run HUD’s operating systems. You’ll work closely with our Chief of Staff and founders across hiring, finance, marketing and events, and cross\-functional special projects.


This role is an exceptional learning opportunity for an early\-career generalist who already has some early\-stage startup experience. The work is both extremely fast\-paced and extremely wide\-ranging, giving this person unique access to every part of the company. The Chief of Staff is also personally committing to mentoring this person for success at HUD and beyond.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**This role is intentionally broad and will change depending on the company’s needs,** but the focus of your first 3\-6 months may include (but are not limited to):

* Co\-own hiring and people operations with the Chief of Staff, including recruiter management, feedback tracking, work trial management, and onboarding
* Own day\-to\-day finance operations including transitioning payroll providers, expense tracking, invoice management, and vendor payments
* Own or support cross\-functional projects with the Chief of Staff and founders, turning open\-ended business questions into clear recommendations and scalable systems
* Draft public\-facing content such as case studies, blog posts, social media posts, partnership announcement, etc.
* Plan and run events including community gatherings to team offsites
* Miscellaneous operations \- everything from notarizing documents for our Singapore entity to onboarding a fractional general counsel
* Active but thoughtful use of AI to enable and automate all of the above

**Experience**
--------------

**You may be a good fit if you have:**

* 3–4 years of experience, including 2 years in management consulting (MBB or top\-tier boutique) and 1–2 years at an early\-stage startup in business operations or strategy and operations
* Demonstrated experience taking ambiguous projects from initial problem structuring through implementation, with an eye on building scalable systems instead of point solutions
* Strong organization and attention to detail, with the judgment to prioritize competing demands and keep commitments on track
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills—**please link a writing sample**
* High agency balanced with good judgement on when to ask for more input or help to get things done on time
* Comfort moving between strategic questions and everyday operational work, and learning unfamiliar parts of the business quickly

**Strong candidates may also have:**

* Experience using AI to automate workflows, not just for research or summarization
* Built a system or process from scratch and iterated it as the company grows
* Experience working with technical teams or ability to learn technical topics quickly at a conceptual level
* Comfort working with leadership internally and externally, and confidence in voicing your thoughts in such rooms—especially in dissent

*We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.*

**Team \& company details**
---------------------------

* **Team Size**: \~25 people currently, mostly full\-time in\-person, but some remote.
* **Our team:** Our team includes 4 International Olympiad medalists (IOI, ILO, IPhO), serial AI startup founders, and researchers with publications at ICLR, NeurIPS, etc.
* **Company stage:** We have 8 figures in funding and are scaling profitably and quickly to meet very strong demand.

**Logistics**
-------------

* **Employment**: Full\-time.
* **Location**: **San Francisco office only for this role.**
* **Visa Sponsorship**: We provide support for relocation and visas for strong full\-time candidates to the US or Singapore.
* **Timeline**: Applications are rolling. The process is 2 technical interviews and a 2\-3 day work trial.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation
* 100% covered top\-of\-the\-line medical, dental, and vision from Blue Shield of CA (US employees)
* Lunch and dinner when you’re in the office (in\-office employees)
* Company\-wide holiday break (Christmas Eve to New Year’s Day) on top of PTO and paid holidays
* Other perks including an Equinox membership, 401k, and commuter benefits (US employees)
* Unlimited\* access to tokens for ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, etc. \**By unlimited, we mean no one on our token usage leaderboard has ever hit a limit. So we have no idea what the limit is.*


Due to high volume, we may not actively respond to every application, but feel free to contact us at recruiting@hud.so or elsewhere if we missed your application!

jobs.title: Revenue Enablement Manager - GTM
jobs.description:
**Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.**



More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it's because they are employed by a company that doesn't offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium\-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.



We're a high\-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.


**About the role**



As Human Interest scales for its next phase of significant growth, we're looking for an imaginative, adaptable, and results\-oriented **Revenue Enablement Manager**. This pivotal role exists to design, implement, and manage comprehensive enablement programs that empower our GTM Sales teams to work seamlessly, operate more efficiently, and drive predictable revenue.



In this role you will thrive on cross\-functional collaboration, working closely with sales leadership, marketing, product, and other key stakeholders to deliver essential content, cutting\-edge tools, and impactful training. Your efforts will directly translate into accelerated sales cycles, boosted quota attainment, and a more efficient, high\-performing sales organization within our fast\-paced SaaS environment. This is more than just a support role; it's a chance to strategically empower our front lines and drive significant business growth. Given our rapid pace (i.e., 24,791 mph), you'll need to thrive amidst constant change while consistently delivering successful, high\-quality outcomes.



This role reports to the Manager, Revenue Enablement (Sales).


**What you get to do every day**


### **Content and Program Excellence**


* **Discover needs and create** dynamic, internal training content that encompasses Onboarding, Continue Education, and Ad Hoc requests so sales professionals reach their goals through strategic learning programs. Ensure alignment with Revenue organization KPIs are consistently prioritized in development, implementation, and outcomes measures for all enablement training initiatives.
* **Strategic training deployment** and modality for training. The strategic selection of training modalities is paramount, as the delivery method significantly impacts content comprehension and application. We meticulously determine the most appropriate approach—such as instructor\-led (in\-person or virtual), eLearning, job aids, manager\-directed, asynchronous learning, microlearning, simulations, or blended approaches—based on the specific learning objectives and target audience.
* **Optimizing our Learning Management System** (LMS) for robust tracking and reporting is crucial for monitoring individual and team progress. It is important to note that Enablement does not just "check the box" when developing and deploying training, Enablement is focused on driving outcomes.
* **Leverage AI** to revolutionize sales enablement by transforming programs into a proactive and hyper\-personalized, "just\-in\-time" holistic environment. Identify ways to automate mundane tasks for increased efficiency, providing enhanced, data\-driven training, and offering predictive insights for strategic decision\-making within the programs you oversee. Ultimately utilize AI to empower sales teams to be more effective, close more deals, and drive significant revenue growth.

### **Impact Measurement \& Continuous Improvement**


* **Evaluate program performance** and provide precise, actionable feedback to Sales leaders and Managers. You will establish clear criteria for successful training completion and conduct robust assessments to effectively measure employee progress and make data\-driven decisions for immediate or long\-term iterations. Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of enablement initiatives. Track, analyze, and report on the impact of enablement programs on sales metrics (e.g., win rates, sales cycle length, quota attainment, pipeline velocity).
* **Drive deliverables through the finish line** ensuring the consistent provision of top\-tier content and experiences. This requires maintaining rigorously updated deliverables with firm, adhered\-to deadlines. Manage short\- and long\-term content builds and updates under the direction of Enablement leadershipSuccessfully meeting these deadlines needs strong stakeholder communication and management skills to foster accountability among contributors and meticulously align all content with critical business objectives.
* **Proactively communicate** with both Sales and Enablement leaders and stakeholders to ensure content, programs, training sessions are aligned with strategic business needs. Champion enablement methods and approaches to drive desired outcomes, along with asking questions and seeking to understand how training or change will affect the audience and daily roles.

### **Drive Team Success and Values**


* **Prioritize collective success** by consistently aligning individual contributions with overarching team objectives.
* **Strategically contribute to sustained growth** by focusing on long\-term impact rather than immediate, short\-term solutions.
* **Execute all tasks with attention to detail**, demonstrating an unwavering commitment to delivering high quality content, and resulting in minimized spelling, grammar, design, or communication errors.
* **Achieve superior training outcomes**, consistently securing 80% or higher in all formal trainer performance observations.
* **Foster a culture of seamless collaboration** by effectively communicating and partnering with all enablement team members to achieve our collective goals.
*

jobs.description:
**We are:**


Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI\-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations. We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human \+ AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.  

This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

 **You are:**


An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and thrive in cross\-functional delivery teams. You have supported business development and are ready to take on more. You bring intellectual curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the Life Sciences industry.

  

The Learning \& Development Partner designs and delivers role\-specific training for redesigned roles within the pod's functional scope. This role builds the training curriculum, coordinates delivery alongside each AI release, and measures learning effectiveness to ensure the organization is ready to operate in new ways.

 **The work:**

* Design and deliver role\-specific training for redesigned roles within the pod's functional scope
* Build the training curriculum and coordinate delivery alongside each new technology and AI agent release
* Translate process and role redesigns into practical, accessible learning content for functional audiences
* Measure training effectiveness and learner adoption — adjust curriculum based on feedback and adoption data
* Collaborate with the Workforce Design Lead and change management team to align training with the overall change plan.
* Travel varies by client needs and could be up to 80%

  

**Here’s what you need:**

  

Candidates must have at least 5 years of combined experience in the following:

  

* Instructional design, curriculum development, or enterprise learning in a consulting or corporate environment
* Designing role\-based training programs for technology or process transformation programs
* Experience with digital training delivery platforms and learning management systems (Cornerstone, Workday Learning, or equivalent)
* Ability to translate technical process and role changes into practical, accessible learning content for non\-technical audiences
* Experience measuring training effectiveness with data\-driven curriculum refinement

 **Bonus points if you have:**

  

* ATD, CPTD, or equivalent instructional design certification
* Experience using AI\-generated content tools to accelerate training curriculum development and personalization
* Background in Life Sciences regulatory or compliance training design
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled learning platforms and adaptive learning technologies
* Experience coordinating training delivery across multiple simultaneous technology releases

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!

About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Constructor is the next\-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. jobs.description:
**About the job**

**Title:** Senior Operations Project Manager

**Industry:** Power Distribution / Electrification / Critical Infrastructure Equipment

**Segments:** Data Centers, Hyperscalers, Utilities, Power Generation

**Location:** Remote (U.S.) \| Travel as Needed (up to 25%)

**Compensation:** Competitive Base Salary \+ Performance Bonus\[KK1]

**Reporting Manager:** Director, Project Management

**About PDM**

PDM is one of the fastest growing manufacturers in the electrical power industry. PDM delivers mission\-critical, utility\-grade products across industry sectors powering the modern world, including **HV/MV/LV transformers,** **circuit breakers, gas\-insulated switchgear, and other transmission\-grade equipment** to a global portfolio of customers. PDM’s essential solutions support the backbone of **data centers, AI hyperscalers, utilities infrastructure, power generation, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, and the oil \& gas infrastructure**. With explosive growth in AI and demand for power, this is a career\-defining opportunity to contribute to a growing global market with long\-term momentum.

**Position Overview**

We are hiring a Senior Operations Project Manager to bridge the gap between customers, commissioning teams, design engineers, factory operations, and field service partners. As the Senior Operations Project Manager, you will support the sales team in facilitating customer solutions and lead the execution of complex electrical distribution projects for data centers, hyperscalers, oil \& gas, clean power, and other industrial clients.

This is a customer\-facing operations role where you will execute timelines, track and communicate progress using project management methodologies, identify and mitigate risks, coordinate startup and after\-sales services, manage project budgets, and maintain project stakeholder alignment throughout the equipment lifecycle. Ideal for someone who is process driven and thrives on clarity, communication, and fast\-moving infrastructure environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Act as the primary liaison between customer stakeholders, internal PDM stakeholders, factory teams, logistics teams, and field service partners.

· Track project schedules, KPIs, changes, risks, budgets, and approval timelines.

· Lead project kickoff and stakeholder governance meetings.

· Manage the execution of technical efforts in the field.

jobs.title: Creative Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.


At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.


This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------



Leads the systems, governance, planning, and insights that enable the creative organization to operate effectively at scale. Owns intake, prioritization, capacity and resource planning, workflow governance, reporting, process design, and operational health. Partners with creative leadership to align resources with business priorities, improve how work moves through the organization, and build scalable practices that increase speed, visibility, accountability, and creative impact. Transforms reactive request management into a transparent, strategic, and scalable operating model.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------


* Own enterprise creative intake and set briefing, categorization, prioritization, and readiness standards so requests arrive with sufficient context, scope, and strategic clarity.
* Define pathways for planned, reactive, executive, innovation, and special\-initiative work; assess readiness, close information gaps, and improve submission quality before scoping or assignment.
* Maintain visibility into capacity, workload, utilization, project mix, skill demand, and constraints across internal teams and external partners; forecast needs using pipeline, priorities, seasonality, campaign calendars, and enterprise initiatives.
* Identify staffing gaps, bottlenecks, and over\-allocation risks before delivery is affected, informing staffing, contractor, agency, and headcount decisions.
* Evaluate demand with creative leadership based on strategic value, effort, priorities, and capacity, while providing portfolio visibility across current and upcoming work.
* Facilitate tradeoffs across campaigns, executive and reactive requests, brand initiatives, and capability\-building work; guide decisions to start, pause, accelerate, outsource, or decline work and align resources to highest\-impact priorities.
* Own the operating model from intake and scoping through assignment, production, review, approval, delivery, and measurement; define stages, roles, decision rights, handoffs, review cycles, escalation paths, and governance standards.
* Drive consistent use of work\-management tools, intake systems, dashboards, and processes while clarifying requirements and reducing friction across creative teams, stakeholders, agencies, PMO, and partner functions.
* Build dashboards and reporting on demand, project mix, throughput, cycle time, workload, utilization, velocity, and bottlenecks, giving leaders clear visibility into capacity, operating health, and tradeoffs.
* Track trends and define KPIs linking operations to creative effectiveness and business impact, using insights to guide staffing, partner strategy, prioritization, process improvement, speed, quality, clarity, and scale.
* Design, document, and improve workflows, SOPs, governance, briefs, review practices, and operating cadences; remove redundant work, unclear ownership, unnecessary approvals, and process gaps.
* Lead improvements that increase velocity, reduce rework, and strengthen stakeholder experience; communicate changes, drive adoption, and establish scalable practices for planned and reactive work.
* Configure tools to support the operating model and provide team and leadership visibility; identify opportunities for automation, templates, improved reporting, and workflow simplification.
* Partner with technology and operations teams to improve adoption, data quality, and system effectiveness, and set standards for tracking work, resources, timelines, and project metadata.
* Advise creative leadership on structure, resource planning, workload forecasts, agency and contractor strategy, future operating models, business cases, staffing recommendations, and capability planning.
* Identify recurring demand patterns requiring new roles, process or scope changes, or alternative partner models, and clarify how organizational design choices affect capacity, velocity, quality, and business impact.
**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------


* 7\+ years in creative or marketing operations, PMO, resource management, agency operations, or related operational leadership.
* Experience building and scaling processes in creative, marketing, brand, or content organizations.
* Strong knowledge of creative workflows, intake, resource and portfolio planning, and delivery governance.
* Experience with dashboards, KPIs, reporting, capacity models, and workflow or collaboration tools.
