Rothe is seeking a Project Manager specializing in Data Management and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to provide remote project management support for the Chief Data and Artificial Intelligence Office in support of the NASA Enterprise Multimedia and Integrated Technical Services (eMITS) contract. eMITS is the Agency’s enterprise\-level contract creating and delivering multimedia and technical communications through the use of the internet, digital platforms, and IT management for NASA’s Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) and Office of Communications (OCOMM). From photographing rocket launches and recoveries, to producing engaging videos, to information technology management, to using social media to share NASA’s message, eMITS integrates services for NASA IT and provides NASA’s communication to the outside world. Come join us in support of NASA’s mission to inspire the world through information and discovery.


**Job Description:**


Provide comprehensive programmatic, strategic, and technical support to the Chief Data Officer (CDO), Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer (CAIO), and broader CDAIO teams. The role spans policy development, governance, data/AI strategy execution, workforce training, and multi\-center coordination to advance NASA’s Data Strategy and AI maturity.


**Functional Responsibilities:**


Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:


Policy, Governance, and Compliance


* Lead development, coordination, and implementation of data and AI policies, including governance standards, metadata and classification frameworks, interoperability models, and compliance enforcement mechanisms.
* Conduct policy gap assessments, manage exception processes, monitor compliance, and support consensus\-building across NASA centers and external partners.


AI and Data Risk Management


* Develop and maintain AI risk assessment methodologies aligned with NIST AI RMF, including bias testing, safety validation, and ongoing performance monitoring for deployed models.
* Identify risks, create risk statements, mitigation plans, and impact analyses.


Strategic Planning \& Inter\-Organizational Coordination


* Facilitate inter\-organizational planning and coordination to meet federal requirements and support NASA’s Data Strategy, Data Action Plan goals, and enterprise milestones.
* Provide project and program management support aligned with IT, data, and AI domain knowledge, applying cost/schedule/performance metrics.


Training, Workforce Development \& Media Support


* Develop and coordinate training materials, briefings, and workforce development strategies to improve NASA\-wide proficiency in AI and data competencies.
* Assess workforce skill gaps and produce tailored curricula and career progression maps for data/AI roles.


Data Management \& Technical Architecture


* Implement enterprise\-level data management practices such as ontologies, taxonomies, knowledge graphs, metadata standards, and interoperability frameworks.
* Promote responsible, ethical, secure, and transparent adoption of AI capabilities.


Stakeholder Engagement \& Working Groups


* Facilitate and support agency\-wide boards, working groups, and governance bodies such as ITSB, EDWG, AISB, and AISWG.


General Support Services


* Provide strategic advisory, content development, governance support, communications coordination, and continuous service improvement across CDAIO initiatives.


Remote, hybrid, and onsite positions, the employee bears travel costs to the nearest NASA Center for badging and the issuance of NASA IT equipment.


For a Remote or Hybrid position, the employee must have a reliable internet connection and be able to VPN into the NASA network to conduct work.


**Education and Experience:**


Minimum Education: BA BA/BS Data Science, Information Management, Business Administration, or a related field.


Minimum Experience: 8 years


**Minimum Qualifications:**


* 8\+ years of project management experience.
* 6\+ years of experience in data governance, data management, or a related field, preferably within a federal or large organizational setting.
* Provide expert strategic vision and management services informed by industry best practices to guide efficient and effective data management and AI adoption.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Knowledge of AI and data governance and risk frameworks.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to provide IT clarification as it relates to AI.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Proficient in M365
* Jira
* Microsoft Purview
* Collibra, Informatica, etc.
* Strategy Management
* Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) Certification (desired, not required)
* ITIL Certification (desired, not required)
* Microsoft Project (desired, not required)
* Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, OneNote, OneDrive), SharePoint, and Box.


Rothe is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.


Rothe participates in E\-Verify.

jobs.title: Drinking Water Project Manager | Ownership Opportunity
jobs.description:
Woodard \& Curran is an employee\-owned engineering, science, and operations firm dedicated to clean water, a safe environment, healthy communities, and happy people. We foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that supports professional growth, flexibility, and meaningful work, empowering our employees to make a lasting impact on our clients, communities, and the planet. **What's in It for You?**  

**Lead impactful drinking water projects while building your ownership legacy.**  


Woodard \& Curran is seeking a dynamic, detail\-oriented, and client\-focused Drinking Water Project Manager to join our growing Water Team. This is an exciting opportunity for a licensed Professional Engineer with drinking water infrastructure experience who is passionate about delivering meaningful projects, building strong client relationships, and helping communities solve complex water challenges.  


We are primarily seeking candidates located in Florida, where you will support the continued growth of our drinking water practice. We are also open to highly qualified candidates located in California or Georgia who can support regional clients and projects.  


In this role, you will partner directly with municipal clients to evaluate, plan, design, and deliver a variety of drinking water infrastructure projects. You will work closely with our Technical Managers and multidisciplinary teams to successfully execute projects involving water treatment facilities, transmission and distribution systems, storage infrastructure, master planning initiatives, regulatory compliance programs, and capital improvement projects.  


Our team consists of engineers, scientists, and design professionals dedicated to delivering innovative clean water solutions. You'll have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across the country while contributing to projects that make a lasting impact on communities.  


To support the successful addition of top talent, we are offering a competitive sign\-on bonus and employee ownership opportunities for qualified candidates seeking a long\-term leadership role within our employee\-owned firm.  


At Woodard \& Curran, ownership is more than a benefit. It is an opportunity to directly contribute to and share in the success of the company while helping shape the future of our growing drinking water practice.

**Why Woodard \& Curran?**
* Employee ownership opportunities
* Competitive sign\-on bonus
* Flexible remote work environment
* Opportunity to lead high\-profile drinking water projects
* Influence the growth and direction of a thriving drinking water practice
* Collaborate with industry\-leading drinking water experts
* Strong culture focused on technical excellence, innovation, and employee development
* Clear path for continued leadership growth and increased responsibility
* Opportunity to help expand our presence in key growth markets

  


**Who We Are Looking For**

We are seeking a technically focused, detail\-oriented, and client\-focused Professional Engineer who is passionate about delivering innovative drinking water solutions and helping communities solve their most complex water challenges.  


As a Project Manager, you will partner with municipal clients to develop, design, and deliver a variety of drinking water projects throughout Florida and other key growth markets. Working closely with Technical Managers, engineers, scientists, and design professionals, you will help lead the successful delivery of multiple projects while coordinating directly with clients and internal teams.  


The ideal candidate will be technically focused, with solid experience evaluating, planning, designing, and constructing drinking water systems. Familiarity with a broad range of drinking water challenges related to master planning, treatment facilities, and distribution systems is preferred.  


In collaboration with Technical Managers and national drinking water experts, you will oversee project scope, schedule, budget, and client communications while supporting marketing initiatives, proposal development, and strategic growth efforts within the drinking water practice.  


This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys leading projects, building strong client relationships, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, mentoring emerging professionals, and helping grow a successful and sustainable water practice.  


**Location: Remote \| Florida Preferred**

We recognize that top drinking water talent can make an impact from anywhere. While Florida is the preferred location, we are also open to exceptional candidates located in California or Georgia.  


Candidates should have the ability to support regional clients, participate in occasional travel for project delivery and business development activities, and collaborate with colleagues across our national water practice.  


**Travel**

Up to 20% Travel

Travel may include client meetings, project site visits, business development activities, industry conferences, and collaboration with Woodard \& Curran teams throughout the region.  


**Join a Firm Where Your Expertise Matters**

If you are a licensed Professional Engineer with drinking water infrastructure experience and are looking for a career\-defining opportunity that combines project leadership, ownership potential, professional growth, and meaningful client impact, we invite you to explore a future with Woodard \& Curran.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Scheduler)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**



We are an international group of consultants united in the goal of helping our customers revolutionize their approach to engineering problems with the use of digital technologies. Combining automation and software development with “traditional” engineering, the companies we work with are able to obtain visibility into their own operations and control.


**Who We’re Looking For**



Though over 1,600 strong (and growing!), Radix operates like anything but a large company. When you join our company, you will help us:



 The Project Planner will work closely with program, project, and sites teams. The focus will be on transforming roadmaps with milestones and deliverables for \~ 21 workstreams into site level schedules and oversee the execution of the site activities. The Project Planner will need to be able to organize working sessions to develop plans per site, create the activity schedule for each site, create the RAID log for each site, build resource capacity reports and develop rollup reports to monitor progress of the site and it workstreams. Once the plan is established, the professional will need to support the execution by establishing reoccurring meetings to gather updates on progress of the planned schedule, follow up on actions, issues, decisions, and update risk related to the work.


**Responsibilities:**


* Create, update, and maintain project schedules using management tools.
* Structure activities, milestones, dependencies, and critical path, evaluating the impacts of changes.
* Perform capacity planning and resource leveling, proposing scenarios when necessary.
* Monitor work items with teams and consolidate status and deadlines.
* Identify and communicate schedule risks and mitigation recommendations.
* Generate Gantt charts and schedule reports for stakeholders and governance rituals.
* Create and manage RAID logs (Risks, Actions, Issues, Dependencies).
* Coordinate between site and central project teams, ensuring alignment of priorities and milestones.
* Organize and facilitate project meetings and workshops.
* Consolidate and provide regular status reports to stakeholders, highlighting achievements, challenges, and upcoming priorities.


**Eligibility Requirements:**


* 5\+ years of project coordination or project management experience, ideally within Oil \& Gas or a similar industrial environment.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, comfortable working with engineers, technicians, and leadership skills.
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, Smartsheet, or similar).
* Good understanding of digital transformation initiatives and comfort with technical conversations.
* Change management or stakeholder engagement experience is a strong plus.
* English fluency (written and spoken) is required; other languages are a plus


 **It's a plus if you have:**


* PMP certification (or equivalent).

jobs.title: Marketing Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours.**  

  

**Who We Are**  

Marketbridge partners with leading B2B brands to create unified Go\-to\-Market® systems that connect strategy, AI, creativity, activation and measurement. With a team of 350\+ across North America and Europe, Marketbridge supports clients worldwide, ranging from Fortune 1000 enterprises to venture\-backed, high\-growth companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, industrial and consumer sectors. For more information, please visit www.marketbridge.com and follow www.linkedin.com/company/marketbridge/. **Who We're Looking For**


We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Project Coordinator to join our Workflow and Project Management team. This role is ideal for an energetic problem\-solver and strong communicator who thrives in a fast\-paced advertising or marketing agency environment.


As a Project Coordinator, you will support the planning and delivery of integrated marketing projects, working closely with teams across Client Success, Strategy and Media, Creative, and Marketing Technology and Operations. You will help keep projects organized, timelines on track, and stakeholders informed while ensuring teams have the information and resources needed to produce high\-quality work.


The successful candidate is detail\-oriented, dependable, and comfortable managing multiple projects and shifting priorities. You anticipate needs, follow through on commitments, and approach challenges with curiosity and a solutions\-oriented mindset. You are eager to learn new technologies, strengthen your project management capabilities, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our processes. Experience supporting B2B marketing programs is an asset.

 **Responsibilities**

**Project Coordination**

* Coordinate the planning, scheduling, resourcing, and execution of a variety of integrated marketing initiatives.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, task assignments, status reports, meeting notes, and other project documentation.
* Monitor project progress, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables to help ensure work is completed on time, within scope, and in alignment with the approved brief.
* Anticipate potential project issues and roadblocks, communicate concerns promptly, and partner with project leads to support timely resolution.
* Assist with the preparation of project estimates and track project hours, budgets, and scope against approved plans.
* Work with Client Success and strategy teams to ensure project briefs are complete, requirements are clearly defined, and timelines are achievable.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to ensure they have the direction, information, and resources needed to complete their work successfully.
* Help manage changes to project scope, schedules, or deliverables and ensure updates are clearly documented and communicated.
* Support project closeout activities, including confirming deliverables, organizing final files, and documenting key learnings.

**Workflow Management**

* Support established project management processes and help ensure they are followed consistently across assigned projects.
* Maintain project information, documentation, and workflows within the appropriate systems and tools.
* Identify potential process gaps or inefficiencies and recommend opportunities to improve how work is planned and delivered.
* Help coordinate resources and priorities across teams, escalating scheduling conflicts or capacity concerns as needed.

**Communication and Collaboration**

* Communicate project goals, priorities, responsibilities, deadlines, and status updates clearly and consistently to internal stakeholders.
* Facilitate or support project meetings, including preparing agendas, documenting decisions, and tracking follow\-up actions.
* Build positive and collaborative working relationships across teams and functions.
* Escalate risks, delays, and competing priorities to the appropriate project or account lead in a timely manner.

 **Qualifications**

* At least 1 year of related project coordination, project management, account management, or marketing operations experience, preferably within an advertising or marketing agency.
* A post\-secondary degree in business, marketing, communications, project management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands, adapt to changing requirements, and remain composed in a deadline\-driven environment.
* Experience coordinating multiple projects and collaborating with cross\-functional teams within established timelines and budgets.
* Familiarity with integrated marketing programs, including creative, digital, media, and marketing automation deliverables.
* Experience using project management or workflow platforms (ie: Asana, Workbook, ClickUp, Scoro, etc.)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across different teams and levels of the organization.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills, with strong attention to detail.
* A collaborative, solutions\-oriented approach and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Familiarity with project briefs, timelines, budgets, resource schedules, milestones, risks, and deliverables.
* A demonstrated commitment to accountability, follow\-through, and continuous learning.
* Experience supporting B2B marketing programs is an asset.
* CAPM or another relevant project management certification is an asset but not required.

 **Our Culture**


Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and global brands in redefining how they go to market.


How we work together matters just as much as the work itself. Our values shape how we operate day to day. **Be Kind** means treating teammates with respect and showing up for one another. **Be Open** reflects how we collaborate, share perspectives, and give clear, honest feedback

jobs.title: Odoo Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are an Official Odoo Partner and Odoo Accounting Expert Partner, providing ERP implementation, migration, customization, and support services to clients across Manufacturing, Retail, Construction, Utilities, Services, and Outdoor Recreation. We've been an exclusive Odoo implementation and customization partner since 2015, and we're growing fast. We're looking for a Project Manager who can run multiple concurrent ERP engagements with minimal oversight, protect project margin, and keep clients confident and informed from kickoff through go\-live.

**What You'll Do**

● Own the full project lifecycle for multiple concurrent Odoo implementation, migration and service engagements — from kickoff through go\-live and stabilization

● Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, managing day\-to\-day communication, status updates, and expectations

● Identify scope expansion the moment it appears, communicate write up details of tasks and client needs and communicate that to our developer team and oversee the work to ensure that it meets the client needs.

● Coordinate with developers and technical staff to translate business requirements into actionable, tasks — without directing technical implementation decisions yourself

● Track hours, budget, and milestones against the Statement of Work; flag at\-risk timelines and margin issues early

● Facilitate discovery, design confirmation, UAT, and Go\-Live Acceptance Checklist sign\-off with clients

● Distinguish between billable enhancements and no\-charge defects, and hold that line consistently with clients

● Designate and formally introduce a secondary PM for each assigned client to ensure continuous coverage

● Provide clear, professional written documentation of every scope decision, timeline change, and client agreement

● Escalate unresolved issues or at\-risk relationships to executive leadership with a clear recommendation, not just a status report

**What You Bring**

● 3\+ years of Odoo project management experience in ERP implementation, migrations and service work.

● A current Odoo Certification preferred but not required, Direct experience managing Odoo projects required. Unfortunately experience with another major ERP platform such as NetSuite, SAP, Dynamics, Epicor is not a substitute for Odoo ERP experience.

● Proven ability to manage scope discipline — recognizing scope creep, pricing it, and getting client sign\-off without damaging the relationship

● Strong working knowledge of core ERP business processes: sales, inventory, accounting, manufacturing, and CRM workflows

● Excellent spoken English along with excellent written and verbal communication skills is required

● Highly organized, self\-directed, and comfortable managing multiple client engagements simultaneously in a remote environment

● Experience with formal Go\-Live acceptance, UAT coordination, and change order/SOW documentation processes

● PMP, CSM, or other formal project management certification a plus, but not required

**Required**

● Background in a Odoo software consultancy or implementation partner (rather than an internal in\-house PM role)

● Familiarity with Odoo data migration projects and legacy system transitions

● Experience managing projects in Odoo ERP platforms

● You must reside inside the USA and speak fluent english

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you currently reside inside the USA and are you able to work USA based business hours?

Experience:

* Odoo: 3 years (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

License/Certification:

* Odoo Certification (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Viresco is looking for an Implementation Manager who can lead projects from planning through completion, coordinate teams, and help ensure successful delivery of company initiatives.

Successful implementation requires strong organization, communication, and the ability to bring people, processes, and resources together. The Implementation Manager will help turn plans into action while ensuring projects stay aligned with goals, timelines, and expectations.

What you'll be responsible for

* Manage implementation projects from initial planning through completion
* Coordinate timelines, priorities, resources, and project milestones
* Work with internal teams, partners, and stakeholders to ensure successful delivery
* Identify project risks, challenges, and opportunities for improvement
* Track progress and provide updates to leadership and project teams
* Create and maintain project documentation, reports, and process records
* Support onboarding, deployment, and operational transitions
* Help improve workflows, systems, and implementation processes
* Coordinate meetings and ensure action items are completed
* Ensure projects are delivered on schedule and meet quality expectations
* Collaborate across departments to resolve issues and keep initiatives moving

What we're looking for

* Experience in implementation, project management, operations, client delivery, or process improvement
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
* Comfortable coordinating cross\-functional teams
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through
* Experience with project management tools and business systems is helpful
* Industry\-specific experience is helpful, but not required

You don't have to come from the same industry.

Someone who has managed implementations, client launches, operational projects, system rollouts, business improvements, or complex service deliveries may already have many of the skills needed for this role.

We're looking for someone who can take ideas and plans and turn them into organized, successful outcomes through strong coordination, communication, and execution.

Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $82,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Controls Program Manager (Remote Eligible, U.S.)
jobs.description:
Vernova Purpose
  

  

GE Vernova is accelerating the path to more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy, while helping our customers power economies and deliver the electricity that is vital to health, safety, security, and improved quality of life. Are you excited at the opportunity to electrify and decarbonize the world?
  

  

What impact you’ll make
  

  

As a member of the Gas Power Controls Program Management Office (PMO) team, you will be responsible for leading and facilitating the execution of New Product Introduction (NPI) engineering development programs through all phases of the Gas Power product life cycle. As a key leadership position within the organization, this role is essential for effective operation through active management of project execution, risks and mitigations to meet our commitments to the business, while maintaining critical business metrics to ensure quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of our NPI deliverables.
**Job Description**
===================


**Essential Responsibilities**

  

  

* Provide program management execution for assigned projects in accordance with GE Gas Power Program Managers Standard Work procedure.
* Create and maintain internal and external project schedules.
* Validate proper resource assignment and manage spending per the plan.
* Guide internal and external execution teams through the NPI Development Process, assuring the proper adherence to engineering policies and procedures.
* Coordinate activities between engineering sub\-functions to ensure all project deliverables are met on time, complete, properly tested, and documented.
* Actively manage program risks and mitigations to avoid execution misses.
* Communicate program status and issues to the engineering and commercial stakeholders.
* Provide regular spending status and projections to the Business Operations and Quality teams.

Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. -------------------------


We are seeking a highly motivated **Senior Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives** to lead the day\-to\-day execution, coordination, and rollout of multiple AI agents and human\-AI workflows across the enterprise. Reporting to the Director, Strategic Initiatives (AI Transformation), this role turns transformation strategy into disciplined delivery: building and maintaining integrated plans, driving cross\-functional workstreams, managing risks and dependencies, and ensuring each AI\-enabled workflow moves from pilot to production with the training, controls, and measurement needed to sustain it. The successful candidate will be an organized, hands\-on project leader who thrives in ambiguity, communicates crisply across technical and operational audiences, and keeps complex, parallel implementations on schedule.

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Lead day\-to\-day execution of AI\-enabled workflow implementations, managing project plans, deliverables, and dependencies across multiple parallel initiatives.
* Partner cross\-functionally to lead the operationalization of AI agents and human\-AI operating models, ensuring a sequenced rollout plan with appropriate stage gates, go/no\-go criteria, and monitoring and oversight.
* Lead change management strategy and execution, ensuring end\-user readiness and adoption activities, including standard operating procedures, job aids, training sessions, and communications.
* Define and track AI agent implementation performance, adoption, operational outcomes, and key success metrics; provide leadership reporting and recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions, escalating concerns and recommending mitigation strategies to keep initiatives on track.
* Facilitate project meetings, status reviews, and working sessions; drive accountability for action items, decisions, and deliverables across stakeholders.
* Collaborate with legal, compliance, and the business to ensure projects adhere to governance, compliance, privacy, security, and responsible AI requirements.
* Capture lessons learned and drive continuous process improvement across future AI agent implementations.

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Healthcare Administration, or related field.
* 5\-7\+ years of project management experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing cross\-functional, technology\-enabled implementations and process improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities in a fast\-moving environment.
* Proficiency with project management tools and methodologies (Agile, waterfall, or hybrid), including planning, risk and issue management, and status reporting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear documentation and present status, risks, and recommendations to both operational and technical audiences.
* Experience defining and tracking KPIs to monitor delivery progress, adoption, and business outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Project management certification (PMP, CAPM, Agile, SAFe, or equivalent).
* Change management training or certification (Prosci, CCMP, or equivalent).
* Experience supporting implementations of generative AI, machine learning, automation, or intelligent workflow solutions.
* Healthcare, payer, provider, utilization management, or regulated industry experience preferred.
* Experience with process mapping, workflow design, or operational process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent).

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

* Opportunity to drive impactful AI initiatives in a rapidly evolving industry.
* Collaborative environment with cross\-functional teams, including data science, product, engineering, and operations.
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for professional growth.

  

If you are passionate about the application of AI in healthcare and want to play a pivotal role in shaping AI\-driven transformation, we'd love to hear from you!

* Represents and leads the study team to design, develop and deliver the clinical study to agree upon timelines.
* Leads planning and communication with cross\-functional teams to ensure proper execution and conduct of the clinical trial; generates quality clinical data.
* Serves as primary contact and resource for CRO and vendor personnel in overarching functions as well as team members in parent company.
* Provides oversight and management of CROs, consultants and vendors.
* Oversees and monitors the management of clinical studies ensuring they are conducted in compliance with the agreed study plans through regular CRO and/or investigator site contact.
* Monitors progress of clinical activity and reports on the progress of assigned clinical trials including budget and timelines.
* Monitors the status of clinical data collection of assigned clinical trials.
* Prepares potential investigator site lists and assists with their evaluation for inclusion in the study.
* Prepares and reviews study\-related documents when required.
* Reviews and approves study\-related plans generated by CROs and vendors, and ensures the documentations are in accordance with GCP regulatory requirements and consistent with the protocol for assigned studies.
* Participates in the review and finalization of clinical study\-related documents such as protocols, protocol amendments, clinical study reports (CSRs), regulatory submissions and other publications as required.
* Participates in meetings – i.e. Study Team Meetings, Investigator Meetings, Monitors’ workshops and CRO Training.
* Reviews correspondences and monitoring reports relating to the studies.
* Prepare and deliver program/study updates.
* Coordinates the delivery of clinical trial supplies in collaboration with CRO and other team members.
* Monitors budget for clinical study, and review budgets and contracts with CROs, vendors and investigator sites (as applicable) in collaboration with Finance and Legal team.
* Requests and critically evaluates proposals and change orders from CROs, vendors and investigator sites (as applicable).
* Provides input into contracts, work orders and/or change orders.
* Manages escalation of study related issues and communicates as appropriate with management and other R\&D functions.
* Ability to anticipate potential study issues and to prepare contingency plans with minimal oversight.
* Ensures assigned studies adhere to all applicable regulations and requirements.
* Provides input as the subject matter expert for the assigned studies during regulatory inspections.
* Establish collaborative and productive relationships with parent company, internal/external partners and relevant affiliates.
* Evaluates issues found in clinical studies, communication and oversight of CROs and vendors, and suggests and implements solutions and mitigations as required.
* Evaluate CRO and vendor performance and support the improvement initiatives.
* Participate in the preparation, review, updating and training of SOPs.
* Maintain knowledge of oncology therapeutic area, current medical practice and pharmaceutical regulations in order to ensure best practice across all activities.
* May Mentor other team members.
* Perform other duties as requested by the senior management.

**Professional Experience / Qualifications:**

* BS or MS in a related life science discipline is preferred.
* Minimum of 3 years of industry experience in clinical drug or program development or equivalent academic experience in clinical trials.
* Proven leadership skills, executive presence, maturity, emotional intelligence, and written/oral communication skills.
* Demonstrated skills working within a matrix environment.
* Ability to work collaboratively with others within and external to the company, including investigators, CROs, vendors and team members in parent company in Japan.
* Interpersonal skills and influence to accomplish work without formal authority and to ensure optimal team performance.
* Thorough understanding of the oncology arena.
* Strong experience facilitating project team meetings, cross\-functional communication and decision making, and ensuring alignment with internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to establish priorities, schedule and meet deadlines.
* Sound judgment, problem solving, leadership, and collaboration in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions to problems.
* Familiarity with the design and conduct of clinical trials and project management in relevant therapeutic areas.
* Experience evaluating outcomes of clinical trials and basic knowledge of clinical trial outcome standards.
* Strong analytical skills with a data driven approach to planning, executing, and problem solving.
* Working knowledge of current global regulatory requirements and guidelines for clinical trials.

 **Travel Requirements:**


Primarily remote role with periodic on\-site meetings in office. Must be able to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

Fast\-paced environment handling multiple demands is involved. Must be able to exercise appropriate judgment

#### **About Artisight**



Artisight transforms hospital operations with its Smart Hospital Platform, helping health systems reduce costs, improve efficiency, and enhance patient care. Guided by deep clinical expertise and powered by NVIDIA GPUs, Artisight's voice\-activated sensors and computer vision technology enable real\-time observation, virtual nursing, and automated documentation directly in the EHR. The platform integrates seamlessly with existing workflows to reduce staff burden, accelerate patient throughput, and improve safety. More than 400 hospitals across 30 health systems trust Artisight to deliver measurable results, including cutting patient falls by over 50%, reducing nurse turnover, and saving millions annually.

#### **About the Role**



We're seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead technology deployment and professional services projects across Artisight's healthcare engagements and professional services business. You'll own projects from initiation through closeout, leading cross\-functional teams to deliver on time, within budget, and within scope. Projects may include healthcare technology deployments, site readiness assessments, network infrastructure surveys, structured cabling, equipment installation, testing and validation, system upgrades, and decommissioning.



This isn't a hands\-on engineering or field technician role, but you'll bring enough technical fluency to lead technical teams with credibility. This role reports to the Director of Technical Delivery, is remote with travel to client sites, and requires U.S. work authorization.


**This role is a 40 hour/week, remote contractor, based in the U.S., and requires U.S. work authorization.**

* Track ship dates and delivery windows with OEMs and distributors and flag schedule risks early
* Act as the primary coordination point across OEMs, electrical contractors, equipment suppliers, and logistics providers so equipment is procured, delivered, and installed on schedule

* Identify ways to streamline vendor coordination and BoM confirmation for future site rollouts

* 2–5 years of project management or project coordination experience, ideally in data center, IT infrastructure, construction, or technology deployment
* Direct experience working with OEM vendors, equipment suppliers, or manufacturers, including reviewing BoMs and confirming delivery timelines

* Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders

jobs.title: Implementation Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Latent Health**
-----------------------


Latent Health is redefining how healthcare systems unlock the power of clinical data. Through our AI\-powered platform, we streamline clinical workflows, reduce clinician burden, and improve health system efficiency. We partner with leading hospitals and health systems to deliver fast, reliable, and high\-impact implementations that transform patient care.

**Role Overview**
=================


The **Implementation Project Manager** is responsible for leading end\-to\-end onboarding and deployment projects for health systems adopting Latent’s platform. You’ll drive timelines, coordination, communication, and successful activation across clinical, IT, integration, and operational stakeholders.


This role requires exceptional organization, customer\-facing presence, and the ability to operate in the dynamic environment of a high\-growth healthcare SaaS startup. You will ensure customers go live efficiently, achieve measurable value quickly, and are set up for long\-term success.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Project Leadership \& Customer Delivery**

* Lead full\-cycle implementation projects – from kickoff through go\-live and stabilization – across a portfolio of health system customers.
* Build and manage detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, and risk logs.
* Facilitate cross\-functional meetings with customer IT, clinical operations, and technical teams (e.g., data integration, SSO, EHR workflows).
* Serve as the primary project point of contact, ensuring exceptional communication and alignment across all parties.

### **Technical Coordination**

* Coordinate collection and validation of required technical inputs (integration specifications, data feeds, configuration requirements).
* Partner with Latent engineering, product, and clinical teams to ensure smooth handoffs and timely execution.
* Understand and translate technical requirements to non\-technical stakeholders (and vice versa).
* Monitor progress of integrations (e.g., Epic, Cerner, Meditech) and escalate blockers proactively.

### **Operational Excellence**

* Own project documentation, including requirements tracking, decisions, status updates, risk mitigation plans, and post\-go\-live handoff materials.
* Build repeatable processes and contribute to the evolution of Latent’s implementation playbooks and best practices.
* Track and report project KPIs (e.g., activation timelines, milestone adherence, customer readiness).
* Ensure clean transition to Support teams post\-implementation.

### **Customer Relationship \& Change Management**

* Build trusted relationships with clinical and operational leaders at customer sites.
* Guide customers through workflow adoption, training readiness, and change\-management planning.
* Ensure customer stakeholders understand project expectations, responsibilities, and timelines.
* Drive customer accountability to keep projects on track and on time.

**Qualifications**
==================

### **Required**

* 3\-7 years of project management experience in healthcare, SaaS implementations, or health IT.
* Strong understanding of healthcare environments – clinical operations, IT workflows, data integrations.
* Proven ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication, meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to drive accountability and navigate competing priorities.
* Experience with project management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, Smartsheet, Monday.com).
* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

### **Preferred**

* Experience implementing solutions with EHR systems (Epic, Cerner, Meditech).
* PMP, CSM, or other project management certification.
* Background in clinical workflow optimization or healthcare operations.
* Prior experience in Series A\-C SaaS or health\-tech companies.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**
===================================

* Customers consistently launch on time, on budget, and with high satisfaction.
* Clear, proactive communication minimizes surprises and escalations.
* Implementation cycles shorten over time due to improved processes and customer readiness.
* Cross\-functional teams view you as a trusted coordinator and problem\-solver.
* Customers transition seamlessly to Customer Success with strong early adoption signals.

**Why Latent Health**
=====================

* Mission\-driven team transforming healthcare through cutting\-edge AI.
* Fast\-growing environment with opportunities for career growth.
* Deep collaboration across clinical, technical, and product teams.
* A chance to make a real impact on clinician workflows and patient outcomes.

  

Compensation Range: $115K \- $175K

jobs.title: Contract Service Delivery Trainer
jobs.description:
OneSource Virtual (OSV) has worked exclusively with Workday customers since 2008 to deliver compliant, in\-tenant technology and expert services to automate the administrative, transactional tasks of payroll, taxes, earned wage access, accounts payable, and benefits. With over 1,500 customers, 92% retention, and $225\+ billion in treasury movement annually, OSV helps organizations maximize their Workday investment and operate it with confidence. Payroll, benefits, and finance solutions — all in one place.

**\*This is a Temporary/Seasonal Contract role expected to last approximately 3 months or longer\***

 **Job Profile Summary**


The Contract Service Delivery Trainer is responsible for designing and delivering job\-specific onboarding and readiness training with a concentrated focus on Workday and OSV’s BPaaS systems and processes. This is a defined\-term engagement to support a hiring surge. The successful candidate is adept at translating complex payroll operations into clear, actionable training for everyone from entry\-level coordinators to seasoned payroll managers. Delivery offerings include role\-based curriculum, sandbox\-based hands\-on practice, virtual instructor\-led sessions, and post\-go\-live hyper\-care support.

 **Essential** **Functions/Duties/Responsibilities**

*Other duties may be requested and/or assigned within the scope of the contract term.*

* **Training Needs Assessment –** Confer with Lead Trainer, Service Delivery leadership, and subject matter experts to identify development needs and priorities specific to Payroll (US/Global).
* **Curriculum Development –** Design and develop training curricula, course materials, and learning assets using instructional design best practices.
* **Sandbox Environment Management –** Set up and maintain Workday training environments to support realistic, hands\-on practice without disrupting live production data.
* **Training Delivery –** Lead engaging virtual ILT sessions for diverse audiences, including payroll processors, specialists, and seasonal employees; incorporate microlearning where appropriate.
* **Evaluation \& Optimization –** Assess training effectiveness via surveys and knowledge checks.
* **Administration –** Coordinate training schedules, registrations, and invites for the duration of the contract; maintain training records and rosters, and hand off documentation at contract end.

 **Qualifications and Experience**

* 3\+ years specializing in Workday Payroll training or system administration
* Deep understanding of Workday business processes (BPs), security groups, and reporting structures related to payroll
* Experience with gross\-to\-net calculations, tax compliance, year\-end processing, wage garnishments, and multi\-state/global payroll compliance
* Fast learner able to acclimate quickly to a new tenant, team, and payroll policy set within a compressed contract timeline
* Ability to manage multiple training deliverables independently with limited guidance and minimal ramp\-up support
* Excellent public speaking, facilitation, and written communication skills; patience with non\-technical learners

 **Preferred Certifications**

* Workday Pro (Payroll or HCM)
* Certified Payroll Professional (CPP)

  

\#LI\-REMOTE


You are encouraged to learn and share ideas when you join the OneSource Virtual team. We reward innovative thinking, fresh perspectives, creative collaboration, and hard work. As an organization experiencing routine strategic growth, we are always on the lookout for intelligent, talented, and forward\-thinking professionals to join our team. OSV employees enjoy a values\-based culture, upward mobility, and professional development with opportunities of all kinds.

jobs.title: TA Operations Coordinator (Contract)
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**  

  

Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody. Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.  

  

BlinkRx is the world's first pharma\-to\-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world\-class support on this first\-of\-its\-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can't afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn't have the medication in stock.  

  

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

**About the Role**
==================



We are looking for an experienced Recruiting Coordinator ready to take the next step into Talent Acquisition Operations. This is a short\-term contract role supporting a high\-volume hourly hiring initiative. You will work closely with our TA Ops team, gaining hands\-on exposure to systems, reporting, and operational workflows that go beyond traditional coordination. If you are detail\-oriented, process\-minded, and looking to broaden your scope within the recruiting function, this role is a strong fit.


**What You'll Do**
==================


* Review offer letters for accuracy prior to distribution, ensuring compensation, title, start date, and other details align with approved requisition data
* Manage the offer approval workflow, routing documents to the appropriate stakeholders and tracking status through to completion
* Send offer documents to candidates via DocuSign and monitor for completion
* Maintain and update recruiting and headcount reports in Google Sheets to reflect current pipeline and offer activity
* Support ad\-hoc requests from the TA Ops team as needed throughout the engagement

**What We're Looking For**
==========================


* 3\+ years of experience as a Recruiting Coordinator or in a similar talent operations\-adjacent role
* Strong attention to detail, particularly around offer data accuracy and compliance with approval workflows
* Comfortable working in Greenhouse for requisition and offer management
* Proficient in Excel and/or Google Sheets for maintaining and updating reports
* Experience with DocuSign or Adobe Sign for document routing and e\-signature workflows
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment
* Interest in growing into a TA Operations function — exposure to reporting and systems work is a plus

**Details**
===========


**Type:** Contract (short\-term through end of year)


**Location:** Remote


**Hours:** 20\-30 hours per week

**Why Join Us:**  

  

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross\-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

jobs.title: Implementation Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
**Elevate Patient Financial Solutions** has an exciting career opportunity available as an Implementation Enablement Specialist. This position will be remote based. The Full Time schedule for this role will be 8 AM\-5 PM, Monday\-Friday with flexibility as needed.
**Job Summary**  

The Implementation Enablement Specialist is responsible for the documentation, standardization, and continuous improvement of the processes used by the Implementation team. This position partners directly with the VP of Implementations to advance department\-wide initiatives, support technology build\-outs, and maintain consistent operating standards across every stage of the implementation lifecycle. This role designs and maintains workflow automations, owns the standardization of client data to ElevatePFS data values, and develops the reporting that gives implementation leadership visibility into capacity, go\-live progress, and delivery quality. The position is internal facing and requires strong prioritization skills, advanced proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and SharePoint, experience with monday.com, and familiarity with AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot or Claude.
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**  

* Build, standardize, and maintain SOPs, playbooks, and templates across all service lines and each stage of the implementation lifecycle.
* Define and document cross\-team handoffs and go\-live readiness standards so that all teams operate from a consistent understanding of the process.
* Maintain a single, current source of truth for implementation processes and reference materials.
* Own the standardization of client data points to ElevatePFS standard data values, and build and maintain the automations that support that mapping.
* Design and maintain workflow automations, including monday.com boards and automations, file routing, and reconciliations, that reduce manual effort for the delivery teams.
* Evaluate repetitive, manual tasks across the department and determine which should be converted into documented, automated processes.
* Design and maintain dashboards and recurring reporting covering pipeline\-to\-capacity, go\-live and transition tracking, and quality and training trends.
* Analyze trends and surface risks or bottlenecks to implementation leadership with clear, decision\-ready recommendations.
* Translate delivery team pain points into concrete process, tooling, or automation improvements and coordinate their rollout.
* Develop onboarding materials and internal reference documentation to support the enablement of new implementers.
* Lead recurring reviews of implementation processes to identify and eliminate inefficiencies.
* Prioritize improvement initiatives by business impact and manage them from concept through documented, adopted change.
* Administer the EPIC access agreement process company\-wide, from submission through documentation retention, and recommend improvements to that workflow.
* Own the high\-level monday.com boards that support department reporting and data analysis.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications and Requirements**  

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities.
* Bachelor's degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
* Three or more years of experience in process improvement, operations, business or data analysis, or implementation and project support; healthcare revenue cycle management or a related field preferred.
* Demonstrated experience documenting processes and developing SOPs, playbooks, or operating standards.
* Advanced Excel skills, with the ability to build reports and dashboards and translate data into clear, actionable insight.
* Experience with workflow and automation tooling such as monday.com or Power Automate, with a demonstrated record of automating manual work.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and SharePoint; experience using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot or Claude preferred.
* Experience with data mapping, standardization, and cross\-system reconciliation preferred.
* Familiarity with reporting and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, and with light scripting or no\-code automation, preferred.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to influence and coordinate across teams without direct authority.
* Highly organized and self\-directed, with the ability to manage multiple improvement initiatives simultaneously and exercise independent judgment in setting priorities.
* Remote and Hybrid positions require home internet connections that meet the company's upload and download speed criteria.


**Benefits:**
  

ElevatePFS believes in making a positive impact not only within our industry but also with our employees –the organization’s greatest asset! We take pride in offering comprehensive benefits in a vast array of plans that contribute to the present and future well\-being of our employees and their families.
* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* 401K (100% match for the first 3% \& 50% match for the next 2%)
* 15 days of PTO
* 7 paid Holidays
* 2 Floating holidays
* 1 Elevate Day (floating holiday)
* Pet Insurance
* Employee referral bonus program
* Teamwork: We believe in teamwork and having fun together
* Career Growth: Gain great experience to promote to higher roles

The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training. This pay scale is not a promise of a particular wage.
The job description does not constitute an employment agreement between the employer and Employee and is subject to change by the employer as the needs of the employer and requirements of the job change.

jobs.description:
**Job Title**

**Electrical Installation Project Coordinator**

**Company**

Faith Pro Service (FPS)

**Job Type**

Part\-time / Contract / Full\-time

Entry to Mid \- level / Operations / Electrician Coordination / Customer Support / Field Service Coordination / Project Management

**Location**

Remote

**About Faith Pro Service**

Faith Pro Service is a national backup power installation service network that helps manufacturers, distributors, resellers, and customers complete residential backup power installations with confidence. As an authorized Anker SOLIX partner, FPS supports installation coordination for systems such as Anker SOLIX power stations and battery backup solutions.

Our team manages the installation process from customer intake to electrician coordination, scheduling, site assessment follow\-up, permitting support, installation updates, and final quality verification. We work with licensed electricians and installation partners to make each project clear, organized, compliant, and professionally completed.

This role is part of our operations team and plays an important role in making sure customers, electricians, and partners stay aligned from the beginning of the order to final job completion.

**Role Overview**

As an Electrical Installation Project Coordinator, you will help manage residential backup power installation projects from initial customer intake to final completion. This role focuses on customer communication, electrician coordination, project follow\-up, documentation, and helping ensure each installation moves forward smoothly.

The ideal candidate will have an electrical engineering, electrical technology, construction, or field service background. Experience working with electricians or electrical contractors is strongly preferred. Experience preparing or supporting electrical drawings and permit\-related documents is a plus, but not required.

This role is a strong fit for someone who understands basic electrical concepts, communicates clearly with both customers and electricians, and can stay organized while managing multiple installation projects.

**What You Will Do**

* Manage assigned installation orders from initial assignment to job completion.
* Contact electricians to confirm availability, scheduling, estimates, permits, and installation progress.
* Communicate with customers and answer questions about the installation process.
* Explain which electrician will be handling the installation and help coordinate next steps.
* Follow up with both customers and electricians until the installation is fully completed.
* Track job status, notes, documents, photos, and completion forms in our internal system.
* Help make sure required documents, permits, photos, and completion information are collected properly.
* Escalate issues when customers or electricians need additional support.
* Maintain professional, clear, and patient communication with all parties.

**What You Need to Succeed**

We are looking for someone who is:

* Patient, responsible, and detail\-oriented.
* Ability to communicate clearly with both customers and electricians.
* Able to follow up consistently without dropping tasks.
* Willing to learn about home electrical installations and backup power systems.
* Organized and able to manage multiple jobs at the same time.
* Professional, polite, and calm when handling customer questions or job delays.
* Hardworking and dependable.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in electrical engineering, electrical design, electrical technology, construction, or a related technical field.
* 2\+ years experience in managing and coordinating electrical projects, or experience working as an electrical engineer, electrical designer, field engineer, permit coordinator, or electrical project assistant.
* 1\+ years experience in customer service, scheduling, coordination, or administrative work.
* Experience preparing electrical drawings or permit documents for residential or light commercial electrical projects.

**Requirements**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Reliable follow\-through and attention to detail.
* Comfortable using online tools, forms, spreadsheets, and basic CRM/project tracking systems.
* Ability to work independently and keep tasks moving.
* Willingness to learn technical installation details over time.

**What You Will Learn**

* Field service operations and installation coordination.
* Customer communication and issue resolution.
* How residential backup power and electrical installation projects are managed.
* How to work with electricians, customers, and internal teams.
* Real\-world operations experience in a growing service business.

**Compensation**

$19 \- $25/hr

Compensation will be based on experience, availability, and role scope.

Performance\-based bonus may be available based on individual performance, job completion quality, follow\-through, and business needs.

Pay: $19\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Sales Specialist, Client Services
jobs.description:
### **About JECT**


JECT is a medical aesthetics brand specializing in cosmetic injectables and medical\-grade skincare. We offer a curated menu of services in a warm and inviting environment with safety and results as our utmost priority. Our mission is to make these services accessible and mainstream. JECT has locations in New York, Florida, California, and New Jersey with additional locations in the works.

### **Description**


JECT is looking for a Sales Specialist to own the new\-client journey from first contact to return visit. You'll respond to inbound leads, guide consultative conversations that uncover what each client is looking for, book the appointment, and follow through so a first visit becomes a lasting relationship. As a member of the Client Services team, you'll also handle inbound client communication and share schedule coverage with the CS team. This is a sales role, measured by sales results, with a hospitality soul.

### **JECT's Core Values**

**Specialized:** JECT sets the industry standard for medical aesthetics. Our providers are all board\-certified medical professionals that specialize in aesthetics, with extensive professional experience. All providers complete JECT Academy, an innovative and rigorous aesthetics training program that encompasses all relevant aspects of the field.

**Personalized:** JECT consistently goes above and beyond to provide our patients with a personalized experience and unparalleled results. We specialize in full face consultations that consider a holistic and multifaceted treatment approach. Our priority is development of individualized treatment plans reflective of our expertise and our client's aesthetic goals.

**Welcoming:** At JECT, we pride ourselves on approachability and providing our patients comfort and ease throughout the entirety of their experience. We get to know our clients on a personal level and take the time to discuss their goals, questions, and concerns. The JECT environment feels warm and inviting, while also conveying to the client that they're in the best of hands.

**Collaborative:** As one of the fastest\-growing aesthetics businesses in the industry, our team is made up of the best and the brightest. We build upon our collective knowledge to ensure patient safety and the best results for our clients. We uplift one another and cultivate a supportive environment that encourages growth on both the individual and company level.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Lead Conversion — The Core of the Role**

* **Speed to lead.** Accountable for the response rate and response time on all inbound leads across text, phone, email, and web form.
* **Pipeline ownership.** Accountable for pipeline integrity in HubSpot, moving every lead deliberately through each pipeline stage. The pipeline is always current and always accurate.
* **Outreach strategy.** Accountable for designing and running the follow\-up strategy for leads that don't convert on first contact, including sequencing, messaging, and channel, and for revising it with the Director of Client Services based on performance.
* **Reactivation.** Accountable for structured re\-engagement of aged and closed\-lost leads, and of segments matched to active promotions. This is a pipeline of several hundred new inquiries a month plus a substantial back catalog.
* **Consultation and conversion.** Accountable for converting qualified leads into booked appointments through consultative conversation, including treatment and provider recommendations, pricing discussions, and objection handling.
* **Booking retention.** Accountable for the booked\-to\-completed rate, including recovery of cancellations and no\-shows.
* **Reporting and analysis.** Accountable for weekly reporting on pipeline performance, and for working with the Director of Client Services to diagnose where the funnel is underperforming and recommend changes.

**Client Services \& Hospitality**

* Handle inbound calls, texts, and emails from existing clients alongside the Client Services team, including scheduling, rescheduling, questions, and service recovery.
* Look for the opportunity inside every service conversation: the client who should be on a membership, the client overdue for a treatment, the client who mentioned a friend.
* Resolve issues with judgment and warmth, escalating appropriately and documenting accurately in Zenoti and HubSpot.
* Maintain a high standard of hospitality in every interaction. Clients should feel known, not processed.

**Team \& Standards**

* Model the sales\-forward approach for the Client Services team and share what's converting.
* Partner with Practice Managers, providers, and Marketing on lead flow, promotions, and campaign follow\-through.
* Contribute to scripts, objection handling, and outreach templates as the program evolves.

### **Qualifications / Skills**

* 3\+ years in a sales, patient coordination, membership, or consultative selling role; medical aesthetics, luxury retail, hospitality, fitness, or wellness experience preferred.
* Motivated by conversion, not only by being helpful.
* Builds their own approach rather than working a task list, and can explain why it works.
* Genuinely comfortable asking for the appointment, discussing price, and following up more than once without being pushy.
* Excellent written communication. Much of this role happens over text, and tone is everything.
* Organized and self\-directed in a remote environment.
* Comfortable in a CRM. Experience with HubSpot and Zenoti (or similar booking software) is a strong plus.
* Discreet, warm, and confident serving an elevated clientele.
* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Ability to work nights and weekends.

**Benefits \& Perks**


We invest in our team with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, your future, and your life outside of work:


* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

jobs.title: Bilingual Account Manager (Spanish)
jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote, based in MST or PST  
**Compensation:** $5,000/month base with a target total earnings of $6,500–$7,500/month, and uncapped variable compensation.

Metabolic Supply Group (MSG) is building a marketplace that connects healthcare providers with pharmacy partners and gives clinics a simpler way to source the products they need. We bring pharmacy relationships, ordering support, and dedicated account management together so providers can spend more time running their practices and caring for patients.

We’re growing quickly, and the people joining us now will help shape how we serve clinics and scale the business. You’ll work closely with the team, take ownership of meaningful relationships, and see the direct impact of your work on our customers and our growth.

**About the Role**

You’ll own an assigned portfolio of clinic accounts and be their primary contact for ongoing support and growth. Through proactive outreach and consistent follow\-through, you’ll help clinics become regular ordering partners, deepen existing relationships, and re\-engage inactive accounts.

You’ll work closely with sales, pharmacy operations, and administrative support to keep accounts moving, from the initial handoff through ongoing ordering and issue resolution. This role combines relationship management, commercial responsibility, and hands\-on coordination.

Professional fluency in English and Spanish is required. Based in the Mountain or Pacific time zone is preferred, complementing the geographic reach of our accounts.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Own your clinic relationships.** Build relationships with providers, practice managers, and clinic staff, developing a clear understanding of each account’s needs, ordering patterns, and growth opportunities.
* **Drive repeat orders and profitable growth.** Proactively engage clinics, identify opportunities to expand their use of approved products and services, and follow through on those opportunities.
* **Activate and re\-engage accounts.** Help newly assigned clinics begin ordering and reconnect with dormant or declining accounts to understand barriers and recover business.
* **Support the ordering experience.** Assist with order placement, answer account questions, and keep clinics informed about open requests and next steps.
* **Coordinate issues through resolution.** Work with pharmacy operations and pharmacy partners to address fulfillment and service concerns while remaining accountable for clinic communication and follow\-through.
* **Manage clear account handoffs.** Partner with sales to ensure newly assigned accounts have complete information, clear ownership, and a smooth transition into ongoing account management.
* **Communicate approved offerings.** Share product information, pricing, and promotions; follow established pricing and margin guidelines; and escalate questions that require additional expertise or approval.
* **Maintain accurate account information.** Document contacts, account activity, ordering history, follow\-ups, and outstanding issues in company systems.
* **Coordinate account support.** Use shared communication channels, collaborate with administrative support, and help clinics adopt portal\-based ordering.
* **Provide visibility into your portfolio.** Share account performance, growth opportunities, retention risks, and issues requiring attention.

**What You Bring**

* Professional fluency in English and Spanish, written and spoken.
* Two or more years of account management, customer success, or client relationship experience preferred.
* Healthcare experience strongly preferred, particularly in clinics or healthcare technology. Experience working with pharmacies or providers a plus.
* Ability to build strong relationships, identify growth opportunities, and retain accounts.
* Clear communication, strong organization, and reliable follow\-through.
* Comfort using CRM systems and digital tools to manage account activity.
* Independent judgment and ownership of account performance, including revenue and profitable growth.

**What Success Looks Like**

Your clinics know who to contact and trust you to follow through. Newly assigned and inactive accounts become consistent ordering partners. Your portfolio grows profitably, account risks are identified early, and clinic issues receive timely attention.

We’ll evaluate success through repeat ordering, account activation and reactivation, retention, portfolio revenue and profit, responsiveness, and accurate account documentation.

**Commission Structure**

The role offers a base of $5,000 per month, with target total earnings of $6,500–$7,500 per month through base and performance\-based variable compensation. Variable earnings are uncapped, giving you the opportunity to increase your compensation as you grow your assigned portfolio.

Pay: From $5,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote
