jobs.title: Patient Intake Specialist and Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Intake Specialist and Care Coordinator plays an integral role in our patients' healthcare journey. They are the first point of contact for our patients and help set the tone for their care experience. They work seamlessly with our physicians to make sure that every patient has access to the highest quality of care, regardless of location, socioeconomic status, or technological literacy.


### **About MD Ally**


MD Ally is a 9\-1\-1 Telehealth solution that enables greater connectivity between public health \& safety and the broader healthcare ecosystem. Our solutions allow dispatchers and first responders to transfer non\-emergency callers from 911 to virtual care instead of dispatching valuable, emergency resources.
### **Description**


Looking for a role where you can be instrumental in changing healthcare and deliver best\-in\-class patient care and outcomes? A company that believes you are part of the solution and values your input when solving complex problems? A place where you are recognized and rewarded for your work? Then look no further \- MD Ally is YOUR company.

  

Our mission at MD Ally is to revolutionize emergency healthcare by seamlessly integrating creative telehealth solutions into the 911 response system and creating a healthcare landscape where telehealth interventions become an integral part of emergency response to reduce the cost of care and improve overall outcomes.

  

The Intake Specialist and Care Coordinator plays an integral role in our patient’s healthcare journey. They are the first point of contact for our patients and help set the tone for their care experience. They work seamlessly with our physicians to make sure that every patient has access to the highest quality of care, regardless of location, socioeconomic status, or technological literacy.

  

How you contribute to our mission

* What you bring to the team:
* Bring an unrelenting desire to deliver excellent customer service with every patient interaction.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly explain the onboarding process and ensure patients are successfully connected to our telehealth platform.
* Accurately collect and input patient demographic information, insurance details, and other relevant data into electronic health records (EHR) systems.
* Verify and update patient information to maintain the accuracy and completeness of the patient’s medical records.
* Collaborate with healthcare providers and administrative staff to complete onboarding workflows and address any patient concerns or special requirements.
* Educate patients on how to access our patient portal and other technology tools to enhance their MD Ally experience.
* Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, such as the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), and maintain the confidentiality and security of patient information.
* Communicate effectively with patients and/or their family members to enable them to successfully navigate in\-network and community resources identified within their after\-visit summary (AVS) care plans.
* Recognize and escalate complex issues to the appropriate personnel for resolution when necessary.
* Required 3\-5 years experience as a medical receptionist, healthcare call center representative, 911 dispatcher or similar
* Additional certificate or degree in healthcare administration preferred.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a healthcare team and collaborate with other administrative and clinical staff.
* Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
* Excellent customer service skills to create a positive experience for patients and their families.
* Ability to handle inquiries, complaints, and difficult situations with professionalism and empathy.
* Proficiency in using computer systems and electronic health record (EHR) software.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to navigate, collect and input patient information accurately into various software applications.
* Familiarity with basic medical and insurance terminology to understand and accurately document patient information.
* Sensitivity to diverse patient populations and the ability to interact respectfully with individuals from various backgrounds.
* Highly motivated self\-starter with a strong attention to detail and innate drive to achieve or surpass organizational KPIs and goals.
* Willingness and ability to adapt to changes in process, technology, or responsibilities within the startup landscape.


#### **Salary**


$19 \- $22 per hour

jobs.title: Lead Equity Program Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

This role is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end administration, governance, and strategic evolution of the company’s Management Equity Program (MEP). The Lead Equity Program Manager serves as the central owner of equity compensation operations, partnering with senior leadership, private equity sponsors, and external vendors to ensure accuracy, compliance, and clear communication of equity value. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and is critical to scaling equity programs in a private equity environment.


Responsibilities:
**Equity Program Administration (30%)**

* Own full lifecycle of equity programs including grant planning, allocation modeling, issuance, and ongoing administration.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with private equity sponsor expectations.
* Drive timely, error\-free execution of all grant\-related activities.

**Vendor Management \& System Oversight (15%)**

* Serve as primary relationship owner for Equity Shift.
* Oversee system configuration, data integrity, reporting outputs, and service delivery.
* Establish and monitor SLAs and performance standards.

**Equity Agreements \& Governance (15%)**

* Lead development, tracking, and governance of all equity documentation.
* Maintain centralized repository with strong version control and audit readiness.
* Ensure consistency across grant documentation and amendments.

**Legal \& Compliance Coordination (10%)**

* Partner with external legal counsel on plan interpretation and documentation.
* Ensure compliance with plan rules, regulatory requirements, and equity practices.
* Support executive compensation governance, including documentation, approvals, and audit readiness.

**Executive \& Sponsor Engagement (15%)**

* Translate complex equity and executive compensation concepts (e.g., vesting, MOIC, pay mix) into clear, actionable insights.
* Partner with executives and sponsors on equity strategy and executive compensation decisions.
* Develop executive\-ready materials, including scenario analysis, grant recommendations, and value narratives.

**Executive Compensation \& Long\-Term Incentive Strategy (15%)**

* Support design and evolution of executive compensation programs, including equity and performance\-based LTI.
* Lead executive compensation modeling (e.g., dilution, MOIC outcomes, grant sizing, payout scenarios).
* Prepare Compensation Committee and Board materials, including analysis, benchmarking, and presentations.

**Key Deliverables**

* 100% accurate and timely issuance of equity grants.
* Centralized governance framework and documentation repository.
* Standardized reporting (grant status, vesting, scenarios).
* Improved vendor performance and SLA adherence.
* Executive\-ready communication materials explaining equity value.
* Executive compensation modeling and scenario analysis supporting grant design and decision\-making.
* Board\-ready materials clearly articulating equity value and performance alignment.
* Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
* Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
* Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.


This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.


Qualifications:
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, HR, Business, or related field required.
* Advanced degree or certification (e.g., CCP) preferred.

**Experience**

* 8\+ years in compensation, with significant focus on equity/long\-term incentive programs.
* Experience in private equity\-backed or publicly traded environments strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing equity vendors and legal coordination.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**

 **Required**

* Deep expertise in equity compensation structures and administration.
* Strong analytical capability (modeling, scenario analysis).

**Preferred**

jobs.title: Sr. Enablement Partner
jobs.description:
**About us**  

HighLevel is an AI\-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150\+ countries, fueling community\-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.  

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.  

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2\.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250\+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long\-term scalability.  

  

**Our people**  

With over 2,000 team members across 10\+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote\-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.  

  

**Our impact**  

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1\.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.  

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
**Who You Are:**


* You have worked inside an affiliate, partner, or channel program — not just adjacent to one. You understand how affiliates think, what motivates them, and what causes them to disengage.
* You are a builder and a coach first. You get energy from watching a manager's conversation quality improve week over week — not from presenting to executives
* You write playbooks from scratch, design onboarding sequences, and build call frameworks that real people actually use.
* You are data\-aware. You can read an Olive AI dashboard, spot a no\-show pattern, and connect it to a coaching intervention.
* You are willing to travel and show up in person. This role requires event attendance, in\-person affiliate relationship building, and on\-site team sessions.
* You have an existing network in the affiliate, partner, or digital marketing ecosystem. You know people. You bring contacts.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**



HighLevel's affiliate channel is one of the most important growth levers in the business, servicing thousands of affiliate partners, a top\-performing endorsed tier, and a team of Affiliate Managers working daily to move partners from sign\-up to their first trial and beyond.



We are building the enablement infrastructure to match the scale of this channel. The Affiliate Enablement Manager will be the first dedicated resource for the affiliate org who is leveraging their extensive enablement background to equip our internal team first, then extend that excellence to the affiliate experience.



This is a build role. You will be creating the foundation of knowledge and growth for the entire affiliate organization from the ground\-up while collaborating with senior affiliate leadership. If you thrive in fast\-moving environments, have a background in partnerships, affiliate programs, or channel sales enablement, and believe that great coaching and onboarding are revenue levers, not overhead — this role is for you.



You will:


* Own onboarding for every new affiliate manager joining the affiliate team, resulting in time\-to\-first\-activation results amongst growing affiliate managers and “exams” to ensure proficiency is maintained across the entire organization
* Build a structured learning path: what does an affiliate manager need to know in their first 7 days, 30 days, and 90 days? Own the content, the sequence, and the checkpoints.
* Own a continuous, always\-on enablement cadence for existing AFMs — not just new hires — so product knowledge and call quality stay current as the team and the platform both grow.
* Create and maintain a centralized internal resource hub — an always\-current repository of playbooks, SOPs, and tools that every AFM can access in seconds.
* Design and own the structured onboarding experience for all new affiliates outside the endorsed tier
* Build and maintain the product knowledge baseline, establishing what a “qualified affiliate manager” knows about the product, the program, and strategies about our top affiliates
* Collaborate with Affiliate Partner individuals to build lifecycle communication sequences (email, SMS, in\-app) that guide new affiliates from sign\-up through first trial
* Work cross\-functionally to ensure that the process for new affiliates is constantly being optimized for broader team goals
* Provide reports for senior leadership, finance, revenue operations, and other stakeholders as needed
* Attend affiliate industry events, conferences, and meetups — representing GHL and building direct relationships with existing and prospective affiliate partners.

**What You’ll Bring:**


* Willingness and ability to travel for events, affiliate meetups, and in\-person team sessions.
* Proficiency with CRM (HighLevel or similar), call intelligence tools (Olive AI, Gong, Chorus, or equivalent), and communication/outreach platforms highly preferred.
* Direct experience working inside a SaaS affiliate or partner program is highly preferred.
* Strong English written and verbal communication.
* Dallas\-based or willing to travel to Dallas frequently. Frequent in\-office presence expected.

**Experience/Education/Certifications Required:**


* 4–6 years of experience in affiliate program management, channel partner enablement, sales enablement, or a directly adjacent role.

OverviewApplication**About NewtonX**


NewtonX is a B2B insights company trusted by the world's most innovative companies to make high\-stakes decisions with confidence. We combine a verified network of business professionals with AI\-powered research tools to deliver research intelligence faster, more precise, and more defensible than traditional methods.  

  

Our clients include Google, Microsoft, TikTok, DoorDash, Stripe, and Coinbase. Our research has been cited by Fortune, Forbes, TechCrunch, Adweek, and the Wall Street Journal.  

  

NewtonX has raised $47M from investors including Two Sigma Ventures, Third Prime, XFund, and Citi Ventures.

**About the Role**
------------------


This role reports directly to the executive leadership team and aims to answer the question: how can the NewtonX commercial organization bring our offerings and innovations to more clients to grow revenue?


You will own the strategy, operating process, and education that sit underneath our entire product portfolio and revenue, including recent innovations like synthetic personas and AI\-moderated research. That means leading the high\-impact initiatives that grow bookings and drive efficiency, designing and owning how our sales process actually runs day to day, rolling out new products and offerings to the field, and building the training that gets new hires productive fast and makes tenured sellers sharper.


Your remit is the full commercial organization, across every line of business we sell (\>60 people). You will be handed large, ambiguous problems, expected to structure them, form a point of view, and then personally drive the answer through to implementation with the sales teams. You will oversee a small but growing team.

**Location:** Hybrid (New York City) or remote

**In this role you will**
-------------------------

### **1\. Lead strategic initiatives to grow revenue and efficiency**

* Identify where bookings growth and productivity gains are available across the commercial org, size the opportunity, and build the plan to capture it
* Help iterate and scale GTM approach for our product innovations, e.g., synthetic simulations, digital market scan, AI data labeling.
* Partner with sales leadership across Enterprise and Intermediaries teams to shape our strategy and translate it into what reps actually do, then drive the recommendation through to adoption in the field for 60\+ people in the commercial org
* Independently scope and run high\-impact projects, e.g., pricing and packaging, segmentation and coverage, territory and account planning, win/loss analysis, capacity and quota modeling

### **2\. Own the sales operating process**

* Design, document, and continuously improve the end\-to\-end sales process: qualification standards, stage definitions, deal desk and approvals, proposal and pricing workflow, handoffs to delivery
* Serve as the connective tissue between sales, delivery, finance, marketing, and product on anything that touches how we sell
* Identity automation opportunities to run a more efficient sales org and enable the team to cover more ground
* Own the operating cadence of the sales org (pipeline reviews, forecast calls, QBRs) and the standards for pipeline hygiene and forecast accuracy that make them useful
* Define what the business needs from our reporting infrastructure, partner with the teams who build it, and own adoption and compliance once it ships

### **3\. Lead onboarding, training, and sales education**

* Build and run onboarding for new commercial hires, with a clear ramp plan and measurable milestones
* Create the ongoing education program for the sales org: methodology, discovery, negotiation, competitive positioning, and research fluency
* Own product and offering rollouts to the field — the enablement, messaging, collateral, and certification that make a launch land commercially
* Build the playbooks, battlecards, and reusable assets that make good practice repeatable rather than tribal

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* The commercial org hits its bookings targets, and you can point to the specific initiatives that moved the number
* New products and offerings launch with the field ready to sell them on day one, allowing us to reach fast product market fit
* Sales process is documented, followed, and demonstrably reduces friction and cycle time
* Recommendations get implemented and stick, rather than sitting in a deck
* New commercial hires ramp measurably faster than they do today

**What you have**
-----------------

* **3\+ years of management consulting experience** at a top\-tier firm, ideally with exposure to commercial, growth, or go\-to\-market work
* **5\-10 years of total professional experience;** sales or GTM experience is a plus
* **An analytical operator.** You work through large, ambiguous problems independently and see them all the way from strategic ideation to execution. Problem solving is your M.O.
* **An implementer, not just an advisor.** You are energized by getting a recommendation adopted by a real sales team, and you are comfortable doing the unglamorous work that takes
* **An exceptional communicator.** You write clearly and succinctly, and you can hold a room of sellers as credibly as a room of executives
* **Strong commercial instincts.** You understand how B2B sales organizations make money and where they leak it. Sales experience is a plus, as is GTM strategy or revenue operations experience
* **Comfort with data.** You can build the model, pressure\-test the numbers, and translate the analysis into a decision
* **A collaborator and emerging leader.** You work well across internal teams and are ready to manage and mentor others
* **Resilient and adaptable.** You work efficiently with minimal direction and under pressure, and

You are a technically fluent, customer\-obsessed PM who gets energized by removing friction from developer workflows. You bring systems thinking to SDK and tracking decisions, hold a high bar for integration correctness and reliability, and are energized by the challenge of reducing time\-to\-value for the teams and customers who depend on you.

jobs.title: Product Owner - Contact Center
jobs.description:
**Join the People Helping People**
==================================

Velera is the nation’s premier payments credit union service organization (CUSO) and an integrated fintech solutions provider. The company serves more than 4,000 financial institutions throughout North America, operating with velocity to help our clients keep pace with the rapid momentum of change and fuel growth in the new era of financial services. Our purpose: We accelerate partners’ success through innovative financial technology solutions and inspired service.


**The Opportunity**

The Product Owner oversees the product backlog of existing and future features; fully driving all associated SDLC activities, specifically for the Contact Center \- desktop IVR/IVA. This high impact role is the primary person responsible for identifying, quantifying and communicating the product vision associated with their subject matter and ensuring that the voice of the customer is captured in relation to development through technology teams. The incumbent develops product release forecasts, product alignment, and resource forecasts. By using an Agile approach, they understand and communicate market research, competitive analysis, and partner to create comprehensive product direction that ensures strategic plans are focused on the highest value yield for VELERA stakeholders and member owners. This position also involves developing and communicating product roadmaps to technology teams.


The ideal candidate will be a subject\-matter expert in their domain, a thought leader with a deep understanding of their product suite, someone skilled in synthesizing information and adept at facilitation and presentation.


**Day in the Life**

* Work with Product Managers, key stakeholders and leadership to communicate and deliver the product vision in alignment to the product strategic direction. Understand and drive business value with the delivery team.
* Creating and clearly communicating Product Backlog items, incorporate feature requests into the product roadmap and conduct road mapping sessions for use in the tactical implementation of the roadmap. Accountable for maximizing the value of the Product resulting from the work of the team
* Creates, maintains, prioritizes, and sequences the product backlog based on the business value or ROI to maximize value. Determines and schedules user stories into sprints, develops the product burn down and release forecast plan. Accountable for effective Product Backlog Management
* Interview end users, member\-owners and stakeholders to define and refine business needs through requirements gathering and analysis to define the product backlog and feasibility. Represents the needs of stakeholders to the technology teams.
* Develop and define acceptance criteria from epics and features granular enough for delivery teams to understand, size and deliver and set the highest standard of quality in the product delivery.
* Participates in planning, daily stand\-up meetings, reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, demos and other Agile related meetings.
* Engage with Product leadership, Stakeholders, and Senior Leadership to communicate and promote transparency of the product roadmaps and forecasts, direction and changes; ensure project align to short\-term and long\-term product development strategy and objectives. Effectively prioritize and resolve project issues; provide insight and direction during complex product development projects.
* Ensure projects are completed within established time and budget schedules, and steers the project to ensure delivery of business value. Ensure assigned projects follow VELERA project management standards, utilizing Agile, Waterfall and other methodologies as required.
* Assist Product Management Leaders in analyzing the business processes for inefficiencies and make recommendations for solutions or improvements.
* Contribute to refinement of Agile Methodology and other methodologies based on results and feedback to continuously improvement product and process outcomes.
* Interface with cross functional groups to communicate and ensure successful project deliverables and manage expectations responsibly. Strong verbal and written communication skills that non\-technical end users can understand.
* Mentor and lead team members and work collaboratively; participates proactively and constantly in team activities with a focus on building a trusting and safe environment in partnership with the Scrum Master.
* Partners with the Scrum Master in coaching the development team in self\-organization and cross\-functionality to build higher levels of team maturity in order to deliver high value products at a pace that is sustainable and comfortable for the team and organization. Job Title: Account Manager


Compensation Range: $80,000\-90,000 Base \+ Commission (OTE $140,000\-150,000\)


Location: This role can be remote anywhere in the US.


Become one of the changemakers. At Quid, you won’t just be joining a team but contributing to a culture of innovation, where every challenge becomes an opportunity to learn and grow. When you join our team, you’re not just stepping into a job—you’re embracing a future where we lead the game with the unmatched advantage of foresight.


Position Overview


As an Account Manager at Quid, you will own the success, retention, and growth of a portfolio of customers. You will manage the full post\-sale customer lifecycle—from onboarding and adoption through renewal, contract execution, and expansion—while serving as the customer’s primary relationship owner and internal advocate.


This role blends strategic account management, customer success, and program management. You will help customers achieve measurable value from Quid, monitor product adoption and account health, coordinate complex customer initiatives, and manage renewals from early planning through signature. The ideal candidate is a proactive, strategic, and execution\-oriented Account Manager with the technical aptitude to understand customer workflows, identify barriers to adoption, and coordinate the right resources to solve them.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Success and Adoption

* Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s priorities, use cases, desired outcomes, and measures of success.
* Create and manage customer success and adoption plans with clear goals, milestones, owners, risks, and next steps.

* Recommend training, configuration, workflows, or additional capabilities that improve adoption and customer value.
* Conduct strategic business reviews that connect Quid usage and outcomes to the customer’s broader priorities.


Relationship and Program Management

* Build strong relationships across users, champions, program owners, technical stakeholders, procurement teams, and executive sponsors.
* Serve as the central point of coordination for customer initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and internal teams.
* Establish clear objectives, responsibilities, timelines, dependencies, and follow\-up actions.
* Maintain momentum between meetings and hold internal and external stakeholders accountable for commitments.
* Act as the voice of the customer and share actionable feedback with Product, Engineering, Support, Education, and leadership.


Technical and Product Fluency

* Develop a strong working knowledge of Quid’s platform, product configuration, data sources, workflows, integrations, usage reporting, and AI capabilities.
* Help determine whether customer challenges stem from product limitations, configuration, adoption, enablement, or business processes.
* Translate technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for business stakeholders.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, and customer technical teams to resolve challenges and improve the customer experience.


Renewals and Contract Execution

* Own renewal strategy and execution for an assigned book of business, including retention, upsell, and cross\-sell goals.
* Begin renewal planning early by confirming stakeholders, timelines, budgets, decision criteria, procurement requirements, and potential risks.
* Manage renewals through pricing, proposal development, contract preparation, procurement, legal, security and AI reviews, negotiation, signature, and internal handoff.
* Maintain accurate renewal and expansion forecasts, clearly documenting risk, expected outcomes, last steps, next steps, and required support.


Growth and Account Planning

* Identify expansion opportunities based on customer outcomes, emerging business needs, additional use cases, and opportunities across departments or business units.
* Develop account plans covering customer goals, stakeholders, adoption, risks, renewal strategy, and growth opportunities.
* Multi\-thread customer relationships to reduce reliance on a single contact and strengthen the overall partnership.
* Lead commercial conversations and negotiations in partnership with the appropriate internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate customer, opportunity, contract, and activity information in Quid’s systems of record.


How Success Will Be Measured

* Gross and net revenue retention
* Renewal and expansion performance
* Timely and successful contract execution
* Product adoption and customer engagement
* Customer health and risk mitigation
* Achievement of documented customer outcomes
* Forecast accuracy and account\-plan execution
* Strength and breadth of customer relationships

* Five to seven years of experience in account management, customer success, client services, or another customer\-facing commercial role, preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
* Demonstrated history of exceptional performance, with consistent renewal, retention, and growth results that have placed you among the top 5–10% of performers in your current and previous roles.
* Proven success retaining and growing a book of business while helping customers achieve measurable outcomes.
* Experience owning renewals and managing commercial and contractual processes through negotiation and signature.
* Strong program\-management skills, including the ability to coordinate stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive initiatives through completion.
* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand product configuration, usage data, workflows, and integrations.
* Ability to interpret customer\-health and adoption signals and translate them into clear actions.

Mozilla Corporation is the non\-profit\-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy\-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.



The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non\-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute **open\-source** software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.


**About this team and role:**

**What you’ll get:**

jobs.description:
**About BizzyCar**

  

BizzyCar is a B2B SaaS company transforming the automotive care experience for consumers, dealerships, and manufacturers. Our mission is to simplify car repairs, enabling consumers to resolve issues like recalls without leaving home or work. Through our automated platform, we streamline the process from manufacturers to dealers to customers, significantly reducing notification times and making repair scheduling seamless. Dealers benefit from increased repair revenue and strengthened customer relationships, while OEMs avoid costly fines.

  

We are solving a $22B industry challenge, with over 70 million cars on the road having unresolved recalls. BizzyCar is a fast\-paced, results\-driven company with an experienced leadership team skilled in building high\-value businesses. Employees enjoy competitive pay, equity opportunities, and medical benefits. While we’re a dispersed team, we prioritize collaboration and meet quarterly to maintain our strong culture.

 **About the role**

  

We're hiring a National Enterprise Account Manager to own the full lifecycle of our largest, most strategic national accounts. This role blends the relationship\-driven, retention\-focused mindset of a Customer Success Manager with the revenue\-driven, growth\-oriented instincts of an Account Executive. You'll be the primary point of contact for enterprise clients — responsible for keeping them happy, keeping them renewed, and identifying every opportunity to expand the partnership.


You’ll report directly to our Chief Development Officer while working closely with leads across the organization (Customer Success, Sales, etc.). This role is ideal for someone who thrives on building long\-term relationships while still being comfortable closing deals.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Steady growth in net\-new rooftop signing, reflecting strong independent prospecting and sales execution
* High renewal rates and low churn across your account portfolio
* Consistent, predictable expansion revenue growth quarter over quarter
* Strong stakeholder relationships that make you the "go\-to" partner within each account
* Clear, proactive account plans that anticipate risk and surface growth opportunity before it's obvious

 **What you'll do**

* **Account Management \& Retention**
* Serve as the primary relationship owner for a portfolio of national enterprise accounts
* Build trusted, multi\-threaded relationships with key stakeholders and decision\-makers within each account
* Proactively monitor account health, usage, and satisfaction to identify risk early and resolve issues before they escalate
* Own the renewal process end\-to\-end, negotiating terms and ensuring on\-time, on\-value renewals
* Act as an internal advocate for your accounts, coordinating with Support, Product, and Operations to ensure client needs are met

**Growth \& New Business**

* Identify and execute expansion opportunities within existing accounts (upsell, cross\-sell, additional locations/divisions/business units)
* Sell into net\-new divisions, subsidiaries, or business lines within existing national accounts
* Build and execute strategic account plans with clear growth targets for each account in your portfolio
* Independently identify and sign new rooftops, owning the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, then transitioning seamlessly into ongoing account management
* Deliver on renewal, retention, and expansion revenue targets (quota\-carrying)

**Strategic Ownership**

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


Rippling is seeking a vibrant Enterprise Customer Success Manager (internally titled: Technical Account Manager) to join our rapidly scaling team. As a core part of our Customer Success organization, you'll serve as an emerging strategic technical advisor for our largest and most complex customers. This transitional role requires exceptional technical troubleshooting and cross\-functional coordination to drive rapid resolution for critical customer milestones and issues. More than a relationship manager, you will be a single point of contact for solving complex challenges, acting as a critical liaison between customers and our internal product and engineering teams. This role is for a self\-starter who thrives on solving intricate problems and is committed to delivering an impeccable customer experience.

 **Please note**: We are not currently able to consider or hire any candidates located in the greater San Francisco Bay Area or New York City Metropolitan Area.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Act as a trusted technical and strategic advisor** by becoming a subject matter expert across Rippling’s entire platform, including complex and regulated fields like payroll, benefits administration, and HR.
* **Provide proactive technical consultation** to help customers optimize their workflows, implement best practices, and increase adoption of new features.
* **Serve as a primary escalation point for critical customer issues**, working cross\-functionally with internal Support, Product, and Engineering teams to drive rapid resolution and provide comprehensive root\-cause analyses.
* **Build long\-term relationships** by owning a book of about 20 clients, guiding them through key milestones such as open enrollment and year\-end payroll filing.
* **Identify and qualify add\-on opportunities** and support renewal negotiations in partnership with your Account Manager counterparts.
* **Master the Rippling product suite** and the nuances of how our offerings work together.
* **Work directly with customers** to understand their core business needs and advise on the most effective Rippling solutions.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 4\+ years of experience in a technical, customer\-facing role supporting a dedicated book of business of 10\-30 accounts at a B2B SaaS company (e.g., Technical Account Manager, Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, etc.).
* Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of enterprise accounts and adapt to changing responsibilities.
* Proven subject matter expertise in one or more of the following: B2B SaaS, HR, Payroll, Benefits Administration, or IT.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and technical troubleshooting skills.
* Stellar written and verbal communication skills with a track record of building strong customer relationships.
* Hands\-on experience resolving complex customer escalations.
* Passion for training both customers and internal teams.

***Bonus points for:***

* Experience at a technology\-focused PEO or HRIS company.
* Experience with a multi\-product platform.

--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

  

This role will receive a competitive salary \+ variable pay \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

100,000 \- 125,000 USD per year (US Tier 2\)


90,000 \- 115,000 USD per year (US Tier 3\)

* strong relationships with large national and regional cybersecurity VAR’s and System Integrators.
* Excellent strategic planning and analytical skills, capable of developing and executing complex sales strategies.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse teams and partners.
* Leadership and team development experience, with the ability to mentor and guide regional sales teams towards achieving sales objectives.
* A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, International Business, Sales, or a related field, with a preference for advanced degrees or professional certifications relevant to global businesses.

We are people focused and strongly believe that talent empowers us to continue our dynasty of disruption and growth in the future. Our Mission is to drive the transition to a totally trusted digital world for all people and organizations. Visit our website www.exclusive\-networks.com.


We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to the recruitment and hiring of individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences, as we believe this strengthens our ability to develop superior solutions, make informed decisions, and better serve our valued customers. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, disability status, or any similar characteristic. Employment decisions are made solely on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. Please click here to review our Diversity and Inclusion Policy for further information.


We care about your data: please click here to read our Recruitment Data Protection Policy prior to applying, and therefore sharing your data with us.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better\-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.


We manage the medical imaging pathway end\-to\-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.


We're looking for a Revenue Operations Specialist to join our Revenue Operations team at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year\-over\-year.


Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.


**WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE IN THIS ROLE:**
---------------------------------------


We're seeking a detail\-obsessed, systems\-minded **Revenue Operations Specialist** to join our Revenue Operations team. You'll sit at the intersection of RevOps, business operations, and systems architecture — owning the CRM infrastructure, communications tooling, and data workflows that keep our commercial organization running smoothly. You'll work closely with commercial leadership to make sure the systems behind onboarding, pipeline management, and partner communications are clean, scalable, and trustworthy.


As a scale\-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:


* Administer and continuously improve our CRM: pipeline architecture, custom properties, deal object design, and workflow automation that support the broader business.
* Own the health of our communications infrastructure, including SLA monitoring, call\-routing logic, and shared inbox configuration.
* Design and build onboarding workflows for new partners, from intake through CRM ingestion, ensuring clean data and flagging gaps early.
* Support sales enablement by ensuring reps and leaders have accurate CRM data, reporting, and tools to sell effectively and move deals forward with confidence.
* Build and maintain reporting and dashboards that give commercial and operations leaders a clear, real\-time view of pipeline, performance, and SLA adherence.
* Analyze data across our core systems to surface trends in partner behavior, inbound volume, and channel performance.
* Support renewal negotiations and vendor evaluations for core RevOps tooling by modeling cost, usage, and capacity trade\-offs.
* Document processes and data models so that institutional knowledge scales with the team, not just with you.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Sales, Operations, Product, and Data/Engineering to close gaps between systems and real\-world workflows.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual, repetitive operational work using native tooling and AI rather than one\-off scripts or point solutions.
* Assist with new market launches, helping stand up the CRM structure, reporting, and communications workflows needed to bring a new region or market online.

**WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE:**
--------------------------------------


You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth role, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:


* You have 2\-4 years of hands\-on experience administering a CRM (HubSpot strongly preferred) — building pipelines, custom properties, and automation workflows.
* You're comfortable working across multiple systems (CRM, support/ticketing, telephony) and understand how data should flow between them.
* You have a track record of building reporting and dashboards that people actually use to make decisions.
* You're comfortable in spreadsheets and with structured data — cleaning, joining, and analyzing datasets to find the story in the numbers.
* You default to native, low\-maintenance tooling over custom infrastructure, and you'd rather fix a workflow than route around it.
* You write clear documentation and can explain a technical process to a non\-technical stakeholder.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity, work iteratively with real data rather than waiting for a perfect staging environment, and take ownership of problems end\-to\-end.

**AI REQUIREMENTS**
-------------------


At Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. We'll assess this in the way that matters for this role, using the tier below. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to reach for the best tool and get more done as a result.


Tier 2 — For this role, you're expected to be AI\-Amplified. AI is part of your daily workflow for drafting, analysis, and research, and you know how to check its output and use it responsibly with sensitive data. (most commercial, marketing, finance, people, and G\&A roles)


*One assessment principle across all tiers: we're testing judgment and adaptability, not whether you've memorized today's tools. Tools change quarterly; the ability to learn and apply them is what compounds.*

-------------------------


We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. jobs.description:
CONNEXIO Health is a growing healthcare commercialization partner that helps medical device, diagnostic, and pharmaceutical manufacturers bring solutions to market through experienced virtual sales, education, and support teams. With more than 26 years of experience building remote commercial programs, we combine people, process, and technology to help our clients reach healthcare professionals and improve product adoption.


We are seeking a motivated Virtual Account Manager to educate healthcare professionals, support product utilization, and build lasting relationships with healthcare providers, prescribers, and customers across acute and post\-acute care settings. The Account Manager will support a diverse portfolio of healthcare products, including wound care, medical devices, dental products, infant formula, and other healthcare solution**s**, by providing product education, identifying customer needs, and delivering consultative support.


This remote role is ideal for a consultative sales professional who is comfortable engaging healthcare professionals virtually, managing a sales pipeline, identifying opportunities for growth, and delivering a high\-quality customer experience. The successful candidate will build trusted relationships with key stakeholders, understand clinical and customer needs, and effectively communicate the value and appropriate use of products across a variety of healthcare environments.


At CONNEXIO Health, you will join a flexible, virtual work environment with a comprehensive benefits package and the opportunity to support healthcare solutions that matter.


Compensation and employment details will be discussed during the interview process and may vary based on experience, qualifications, location, and client needs.


**About the Role**


The Virtual Account Manager will serve as a remote sales and education resource for healthcare professionals across a variety of healthcare products, including wound care, medical devices, dental products, and infant formula.


The position is a *6\-12\-month temporary project,* and continuation beyond the pilot period will depend on the program's success and ongoing business needs. In this role, you will help prescribers understand product use, identify appropriate patient opportunities, support adoption, and maintain productive customer relationships. You will be responsible for meeting activity and sales goals while documenting interactions accurately and following established client and program expectations


**What You'll Do**


* Execute inbound and outbound sales activities using phone, video, email, text, live chat, and other approved communication channels.
* Build and maintain relationships with prescribers, customers, and key contacts in acute and post\-acute care environments.
* Qualify leads, manage follow\-up activity, overcome objections, and close opportunities within an efficient sales cycle.
* Support prescription activity and product utilization by providing timely, professional education and follow\-up.
* Collaborate with management to execute business plans, meet sales and volume targets, and continuously improve program performance.
* Maintain an active pipeline of prospects and customers, including scheduled follow\-up calls, campaign outreach, and inbound inquiries.
* Meet defined activity expectations, such as education sessions, calls, decision\-maker contacts, opportunities opened, and sales closed.
* Document all customer activity accurately in the CRM, including contact details, notes, opportunities, next steps, and scheduled actions.
* Conduct virtual education sessions through video with healthcare professionals on product use, disease\-state context, patient selection, and best practices for patient adoption.
* Adapt communication and solutions to customer needs while staying aligned with product instructions for use and program requirements.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.


**What We're Looking For**


* Proven success in pharmaceutical, medical device, healthcare, or other sales environments.
* Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales quotas and activity goals.
* Strong consultative selling skills, including rapport building, needs discovery, feature\-and\-benefit communication, objection handling, and closing.
* Excellent written, verbal, telephone, and presentation skills, with a professional and customer\-focused communication style.
* Ability to educate healthcare professionals clearly and confidently in a virtual setting.
* Experience using a CRM platform to manage customer records, document activity, track opportunities, and schedule follow\-up.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow\-through.
* Dependable, punctual, self\-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
* Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to respond professionally to changing customer, client, and program needs.
* Ability to work collaboratively with teammates, managers, customers, and business partners.
* Comfortable working in a goal\-driven environment with defined call strategies, activity expectations, and performance metrics.


**Preferred Experience**


* Four\-year Technical or Business Degree or equivalent combination of education plus experience.
* Prefer two or more years of experience in wound care, a clinical setting, or healthcare education.
* Experience supporting prescribers or healthcare professionals in acute or post\-acute care settings.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills.

This is a remote role within a fast\-paced virtual workforce. The successful candidate must have a professional, distraction\-free workspace and reliable hard\-wired internet access. Because customer and client needs may vary, flexibility in scheduling may be required.

### **Company Overview:**


Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. We are redefining how individuals understand, measure, and improve their health by moving beyond the limitations of traditional care and enabling comprehensive, continuous insight into human biology. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture\-backed by Redpoint and other leading venture firms. Over half a million members have joined Function to take control of their health.  

  

Through comprehensive lab testing, MRI and CT imaging, longitudinal data, and guidance from AI and clinical teams, Function gives members a complete and continuous view of their health — and the clarity to act on it. Through acquisitions across imaging, mobile phlebotomy, and supplement tracking and optimization, Function is building an integrated health platform that spans the full path from testing to health clarity to daily action.  

  

Function recently announced a $298M Series B and is entering its next chapter of growth. As we scale, the quality and durability of our People systems, data, and insights will directly shape our ability to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast\-paced environments, can confidently make real\-time decisions, has experience making operational calls quickly, and is energized by supporting both team performance and individual development.

In addition to holding yourself and Sr. MSAs accountable to proactive, real\-time support to ensure member support excellence.

Own the monthly scheduling process end\-to\-end, keeping schedules accurate as changes occur, in partnership with WFM.

jobs.title: CALL CENTER SPECIALIST - IC
jobs.description:
**JOB PURPOSE:**

  

The Call Center Specialist \- IC is responsible for managing a high volume of inbound and outbound calls in a timely and professional manner. This role involves providing exceptional customer service, scheduling appointments, answering inquiries, and assisting patients and their families with accurate information regarding services provided by the healthcare organization. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills, empathy, and the ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
  

  

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Handle incoming and outgoing calls efficiently while maintaining a professional and courteous demeanor.
* Schedule patient appointments accurately using the organization's electronic medical record (EMR) system.
* Respond to patient inquiries regarding services, appointment availability, billing, and other general information.
* Assist patients in rescheduling or canceling appointments while adhering to organizational guidelines.
* Verify and update patient demographic and insurance information during calls.
* Educate patients on healthcare services, office policies, and available resources.
* Document all patient interactions and maintain accurate call records in the appropriate systems.
* Document patient complaints and escalate complex issues to the appropriate department or supervisor.
* Collaborate with clinical staff, administrative teams, and other departments to ensure a seamless patient experience.
* Follow HIPAA regulations to maintain patient confidentiality and data security.
* Achieve performance goals, including call quality, response time, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Outreach to inquiring callers to keep them informed about their issues/request’s status or resolution.
* Adhere to company and department policies and procedures.
Adheres to all applicable compliance requirements and the Code of Conduct.  
* 

**Weekly Hours:** 40


**Days:** Monday to Friday


**Hours:** 9:00AM \- 6:00PM ET


**Location:** Full time Remote  



  

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

**Education:** Associate degree preferred, or equivalent relevant call center years of experience preferred.  



  

**Experience:** One to two (1\-2\) years of experience in customer service, quality, and/or auditing.  



  

**Language:** Must be bilingual in English and one of the following languages: Spanish, Russian, Chinese, Bengali, Korean, Albanian, or a similar language.  



  

**Additional Requirements:**

* The consultant is required to provide valid government\-issued identification as proof of age to verify that they are at least 18 years of age.
* Able to pass a typing test with at least 40 WPM.
* Consultant acknowledges that they have an alternative means of working in the event of a power and/or internet service outage, ensuring they are able to fulfill their job responsibilities without interruption.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment and meet assigned deadlines.
* Excellent organizational skills, accuracy, and attention to detail.
* Ability to operate both independently and collaboratively as required.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
* Maintain and utilize the necessary equipment, including but not limited to a computer, monitor, headset, and any other tools required to perform the agreed\-upon services.
* Ensure access to a reliable and high\-speed Wi\-Fi connection suitable for conducting business operations efficiently.
Successfully complete all mandatory training programs as required by the Organization.  
* 

  

**Physical Requirements**

Individuals must be able to sustain certain physical requirements essential to the job. This includes, but is not limited to:


* **Standing** – Duration of up to 6 hours a day.
* **Sitting/Stationary positions** – Sedentary position in duration of up to 6\-8 hours a day for consecutive hours/periods.
* **Lifting/Push/Pull** – Up to 50 pounds of equipment, baggage, supplies, and other items used in the scope of the job using OSHA guidelines, etc.
* **Bending/Squatting** – Have to be able to safely bend or squat to perform the essential functions under the scope of the job.
* **Stairs/Steps/Walking/Climbing** – Must be able to safely maneuver stairs, climb up/down, and walk to access work areas.
* **Agility/Fine Motor Skills** \- Must demonstrate agility and fine motor skills to operate and activate equipment, devices, instruments, and tools to complete essential job functions (ie. typing, use of supplies, equipment, etc.)
* **Sight/Visual Requirements** – Must be able to visually read documentation, papers, orders, signs, etc., and type/write documentation, etc. with accuracy.
* **Audio Hearing and Motor Skills (language) Requirements** – Must be able to listen attentively and document information from patients, community members, co\-workers, clients, providers, etc., and intake information through audio processing with accuracy. In addition, they must be able to speak comfortably and clearly with language motor skills for customers to understand the individual.
* **Cognitive Ability** – Must be able to demonstrate good decision\-making, reasonableness, cognitive ability, rational processing, and analysis to satisfy essential functions of the job.

jobs.description:
**Advanced Specialist, Implementation Specialist**

**About Pearson**

At Pearson, we’re committed to a world that’s always learning and to our talented team who makes it all possible.


**Role summary**

The Advanced Specialist, Implementation Specialist role drives end\-to\-end item and test development for large\-scale K–12 statewide assessment programs. This role serves as a primary client\-facing leader for content development; translates standards and blueprints into high\-quality item/test specifications; and coordinates cross\-functional work with Psychometrics, Content, Publishing Services, Program Delivery, and Finance. The Senior TDM provides thought leadership on assessment design, ensures operational excellence across paper and online modalities, and helps deliver successful outcomes for programs.


**Key responsibilities**

**Assessment leadership and client consulting**

* Provide expert guidance on assessment design, content development, and evidence\-based practices for statewide assessments, including summative, interim, and other assessment types.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for client\-facing content development requirements and educator committee meetings.

**Blueprinting, item/test specifications, and development**

* Translate standards and blueprints into actionable item and test specifications; secure client approvals and maintain documentation.
* Partner with Psychometrics on blueprint setup, test construction, data reviews, and standard setting inputs.
* Configure item bank metadata and test maps and oversee form assembly for paper and online administrations.

**Scope, financial management and schedules**

* Create, monitor and update labor and non\-salary forecasts for programs; participate in forecast and finance reconciliation meetings.
* Lead scope discussions with content development vendors; initiate SOWs and coordinate escalations as needed.
* Maintain and approve content development schedules; manage change control and document updates in agreed tools.

**Risk and issue management**

* Identify and log project\-specific risks; develop mitigation and contingency plans.
* Troubleshoot item/test development issues; lead sustainable corrective actions to protect quality and timelines.

**Communication and customer experience**

* Create and execute communication plans for consistent, transparent updates to customers.
* Facilitate customer review meetings on milestones and deliverables; establish and track customer satisfaction measures.
* Define escalation pathways and ensure timely resolution with clear, documented communication.

**Team leadership and collaboration**

* Coordinate staffing with Content leadership; provide performance feedback and coaching to team members and vendor partners.
* Foster a positive, cohesive team environment; model strong negotiation and cross\-functional collaboration.

**AI Strategy and Management**

* Leverage AI\-powered tools to support the development, review, and enhancement of assessment content, ensuring outputs meet quality and accessibility standards and comply with program\-specific security and privacy requirements.
* Collaborate with team members to integrate AI\-generated assets into assessment workflows, providing feedback and editorial oversight, and documenting provenance and approvals per established processes.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies relevant to educational content creation and assessment; share practical guidance with the team and surface tool recommendations for consideration.

**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* 5\+ years of experience in the educational testing and assessment industry, including client\-facing work and cross\-functional team leadership.
* Demonstrated expertise in item and test development for statewide K–12 assessments; experience across paper and online modalities.
* Knowledge of psychometric principles relevant to development.
* Experience with statewide assessments; classroom teaching experience valued.
* Proficiency with project and financial planning.
* Strong vendor management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and time management skills
* Adaptability with enterprise systems and tools.
* Ability to travel throughout the year, with increased travel during summer months.

**AI\-Related** **Qualifications**

* Demonstrated excellence in AI\-supported content development to leverage AI effectively in asset creation within a managed, compliant workflow.
* Experience or familiarity with prompting, refining, and evaluating AI\-generated content for educational assessments, including applying accessibility and bias checks.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new AI tools and methodologies as they evolve.

**Location \-** Remote (US)

jobs.title: ServiceNow Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Description:

NetImpact Strategies is seeking a ServiceNow Implementation Specialist to configure and implement approved ServiceNow capabilities for a Federal Agency. This role translates validated requirements and architecture into maintainable platform configuration, automation, integrations, catalog/workflow capabilities, and controlled production deployments while providing late\-window engineering depth. **Work schedule:** Monday\-Friday, representative late implementation shift supporting the end of the 1:30 p.m.\-10:00 p.m. Eastern service window; planned after\-hours activities and rotating on\-call support as required.

  

This position requires U.S. citizenship and a post\-award Government background investigation.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Configure and implement approved ServiceNow capabilities from validated requirements and CTA\-approved designs, favoring out\-of\-the\-box features and reusable components over avoidable customization.
* Configure forms, tables, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, ACLs, Script Includes, Flow Designer flows/subflows/actions, catalog items, notifications, and approved portal/workspace components.
* Implement capabilities across TO\-relevant ServiceNow areas such as ITSM, ITOM/Discovery, CMDB/CSDM, IntegrationHub, SPM, Performance Analytics, App Engine, and other approved products as assigned.
* Build and configure integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub spokes/actions, MID Servers, service accounts, and approved authentication/certificate patterns; coordinate end\-to\-end testing and operational handoff.
* Support CMDB/configuration\-data implementation and data\-quality validation, including reconciliation with connected systems and approved governance standards.
* Prepare and execute controlled promotions to TEST and PROD using approved update\-set/application\-repository and CI/CD practices; maintain deployment plans, rollback steps, release notes, and configuration evidence.
* Execute unit/functional checks and partner with the Tester on ATF, integration, regression, performance, and UAT validation before release.
* Provide late\-window deployment and implementation support, including troubleshooting, post\-production validation, and handoff to the operations team.
* Support technical\-debt reduction and approved restoration of customized capabilities toward out\-of\-the\-box behavior where doing so improves maintainability and upgradeability.
* Create implementation guides, configuration documentation, demonstrations, knowledge articles, and transition materials; support user training and knowledge transfer as needed.


Qualifications:
**Required Qualifications and Certifications**
----------------------------------------------

* Three or more years of hands\-on ServiceNow implementation/configuration experience in enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated expertise in at least two ServiceNow capability areas such as ITSM, ITOM/Discovery, CMDB/CSDM, IntegrationHub, SPM, Performance Analytics, App Engine, or SecOps.
* Hands\-on ability with Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, ACLs, Script Includes, Flow Designer, catalog/workflow configuration, REST/SOAP APIs, and ServiceNow data/configuration concepts.
* Experience with controlled release promotion, update sets/application repositories, CI/CD, automated testing, and release documentation.
* ServiceNow CSA plus one or more relevant CIS credentials strongly preferred or required where mandated by the applicable labor category.
* Strong communication and requirements\-translation skills, with demonstrated ability to work with architects, developers, analysts, operations staff, and customer stakeholders.
* Ability to support the assigned late implementation window and planned after\-hours/on\-call events.
* S. citizenship and ability to satisfy High Risk IT background\-investigation and sensitive\-information requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications and Certifications**
-----------------------------------------------

* Federal consulting or financial\-regulatory experience.
* App Engine Studio, UI Builder/Workspace, IntegrationHub, CMDB Health, or ATF experience.
* Experience implementing ServiceNow capabilities in a shared multi\-vendor platform with formal architecture/security governance.

This approach reflects our commitment to adhering to legal requirements and promoting equitable pay standards across all regions where we operate. The posted salary range for this role is $90,000\-110,000\. The posted salary range is not an exact indication of the actual compensation offered and is instead a range of what NetImpact, in good faith, could compensate at the lowest and most high end of the salary market. In general, NetImpact may not pay the top of the salary range. * Pawsitively pawesome – Pet Insurance (because our little critters are part of our families, too!)

jobs.description:
**About Us:**



Pacvue is the leading Commerce Media OS, powering over $12B in advertising spend across 100\+ global retail media networks including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Instacart, Criteo, and CitrusAd. Powered by industry\-leading AI and real\-time data, Pacvue enables over 70,000 brands and agencies to maximize advertising performance, drive incrementality, and expand reach across the commerce universe from a single mission control. As of 2025, Pacvue powers 12% of total retail media ad spend worldwide excluding China. Combined with Helium 10’s SMB solutions, Pacvue delivers the industry’s most comprehensive platform for businesses of all sizes.



At Pacvue and Helium 10, great careers don’t just happen — they’re built. Here, you’ll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that’s redefining the future of commerce.


**About the Role:**



We are seeking an experienced Display Media Account Manager to develop and execute digital media strategies on behalf of clients. As a Display Media Account Manager, you will be responsible for driving superior business results through strong relationship building, developing an in\-depth knowledge of the client’s business goals and objectives, understanding the categories in which they compete to strategically grow share, while providing solid reporting and analytics to demonstrate success against joint business plans. This role will be focused on Amazon DSP, with additional training responsibilities which are intended to educate our clients on DSP best practices, teach them how to build and manage an effective DSP strategy, and demonstrate how to integrate complex DSP campaigns into a cohesive, full\-funnel advertising program.



We are looking for a self\-starter with a proven track record of building relationships and taking full ownership of client inputs to deliver results. The ideal candidate will deliver an excellent client experience and execute at both a strategic and tactical level to deliver growth for our clients across various retail media platforms, with a heavy focus on Amazon DSP. This includes activities such as creating and managing display media strategies for various retailers, providing annual and ongoing budget recommendations to help clients achieve their business objectives, highlighting other operational KPIs or opportunities that impact advertising effectiveness, and delivering regular reporting on advertising effectiveness. This position requires a candidate who can easily dive deep into a data set, develop tactical strategies, and present their action plan to gain alignment with senior leaders.


**Responsibilities:**


* Fully own the client relationship by building solid rapport, demonstrating transparency, and delivering results against joint business objectives
* Develop strategic growth plans, gain client alignment, and fully execute against the aligned upon approach
* Measure efficacy of the strategy through regular reporting against core retail media KPIs and ad\-hoc audits to identify areas for refinement
* Highlight incremental sales opportunities to clients through participation in retailer programs, additional promotional opportunities, and recommendations to improve operational KPIs
* Develop annual budget recommendations and properly allocate across campaigns to align with high level business objectives
* Develop an annual marketing calendar incorporating key drive periods (including relevant macro and micro seasons), new product launches, and clients’ national media calendars
* Leverage Pacvue technology to manage budget allocation, communicate with client on trends and pacing, and deliver results within client budget thresholds
* Prepare weekly and monthly retail media performance reports, analyze category trends, measure advertising and total sales, identify account trends, and perform competitive benchmarking across the client’s product portfolio
* Maximize retailer share, revenue, and profitability for clients while integrating client’s internal objectives such as driving innovation or key items or product lines
* Create strategic retail media plans for new product launches, including recommendations for retail readiness across core KPIs
* Act as Amazon DSP expert within broader Pacvue team, with potential to train and educate internal teams on DSP best practices
* Responsible for reporting, analysis, and communication with Pacvue and client management teams


**Skills \& Qualifications:**


* 3\-5\+ years’ experience working in eCommerce advertising, marketing, or sales
* 3\-5\+ years’ previous client\-facing account management experience
* An in\-depth knowledge of display media advertising, with prior Amazon DSP experience
* Demonstrate understanding of how retail media, sales, and operations work together to successfully drive an eCommerce business
* Proven track record in relationship building and account management
* Proven success in driving results and implementing ideas in a fast\-paced environment
* Works efficiently and is always looking to streamline processes and workflows
* Excellent organizational and communication skills
* Strong analytical skills
* Moderate Excel and PowerPoint skills are a must
* Previous product management, project management, financial analysis, negotiation and/or marketing experience is a plus


**Benefits:**


* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays and Floating Holidays
* Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, HSA with employer contribution, Life Insurance and Pet Insurance
* 401k with Employer Match
* Take up to 2 Days of Paid Time Off to Volunteer with a 501c Organization
* Paid Parental Leave
* Company\-subsidized membership to Wellhub and Peloton
* Fertility and family\-building information platform through Carrot
