jobs.title: Ecommerce Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Growing, fast\-paced family business seeking a strong, professional, experienced candidate to handle a segment of our Ecommerce sales. Responsibilities include:

**Relationship Management**

* Serve as main point of contact and implement appropriate sales tactics/communication based on best practices for any given retailer's ecosystem.
* Understand requirements, assess strengths/weaknesses/opportunities and maintain knowledge of current processes (for loading product, participating in sales/promotion, updating content, etc) to draw the best sales performance from the channel.
* Maintain consistent and open communication with buyers (buyers, assistants, content team, etc.) and clients, eliciting information and ideas to better position the brand and/or products onsite. Evaluate and apply best practices gleaned.
* Provide strategic guidance and direction, gleaned from other accounts we manage, experience and best practices. Provide holistic advice to grow/scale businesses in a health/future focused manner.
* Manage/run/negotiate allowance/terms discussions.
* Operational performance (shipping, fulfillment, EDI, carriers, etc.) must be managed, especially when there are shipping related issues (physically or electronically). Strategically manage the relationship to protect the business. Appropriately communicate status/changes/issues, etc.

**Product \& Catalog Management**

* Coordinate the load of all product internally with data team based on retailer requirements and processes, timing submissions with retailer timelines/lag time.
* Manage and maintain that all applicable product is submitted to the retailer, loaded in their system, and live on site. Acute attention to detail is necessary.

**Marketing, Promotions \& Advertising**

* Promotions \- Identify with buying teams all available events/promotions/sales and execute within client parameters and growth goals.
* Advertising \- If there is an advertising arm for a given retailer, understand impact and coordinate with advertising internally to run/leverage/execute campaigns based on product related details. Be hands on in advertising focus and understanding with internal team to assist daily campaign management.

**Monthly Items**

* Buyer Touch\-base \- If not organically happening, reach out to buying teams to connect on the business. Aim to understand items in the retailer sales analysis listed below (but not limited to).
* Sales Analysis \- to understand the health of the business, we must know what is happening both internally and externally, giving us context into how our performance truly is in the environment. How well do the below two analyses match? Does one change the other or are they in harmony?

Inside Sales Analysis \- Analyze sell\-in report for the retailer, per commodity/division to understand the business more intimately.

Retailer Sales Analysis \- Engage with the retailer to provide insights as to what they are seeing at the category level.

* Advertising \- Recap performance (if applicable) for analysis.
* Projects/Items Needed \- Status update of needed items, projects we are working on, new batches being loaded, etc. Is there anything we need to check in on? Is there anything we are holding up?

**Required Experience**

* **Proven experience in managing Ecommerce platforms and driving online sales**
* Excellent Microsoft Office skillset, especially Excel. To include knowledge of vlookup, pivot tables, formatting, etc.
* **Experience working inside .com retailer portals, including but not limited to Amazon Vendor Central, Amazon Seller Central, Wayfair, Overstock/BBB, Target.com, Target\+, Walmart.com, Kohls.com, Home Depot, Lowes**
* **Understanding of 1P vs 3P retailer relationships and pricing strategies necessary**
* Experience creating content/copy utilizing SEO/keywords for new product listings and updating existing products.

new_jobs.title: Patient Navigator
new_jobs.description:
Involves providing non\-clinical support, guidance and assistance for patients and families as they navigate through complex healthcare environments. Primary goals are to increase patient satisfaction, and to optimize care and outcomes. Acts as a communication liaison to understand the patient's non\-clinical individual needs, expectations, and concerns. Guides the patient and family to a broad range of services, amenities, and information to promote healing and ensure satisfaction with the patient care experience.


**DEPARTMENT DESCRIPTION:**

The Behavioral Emergency Response Team (BERT) is UCSF Benioff Children's Hospitals' pediatric behavioral health crisis service, providing rapid assessment, crisis intervention, risk evaluation, and disposition planning for children and adolescents experiencing behavioral health emergencies in the Emergency Department and on inpatient units. BERT partners closely with Emergency Medicine, inpatient medical teams, nursing, security, and Psychiatry to determine the appropriate level of care, including inpatient psychiatric hospitalization when clinically indicated. BERT operates as part of the broader Behavioral Health Crisis Services program, alongside the Crisis Response Bridge Clinic, Psychiatry Consultation\-Liaison, and Code CARE, together providing a continuum of crisis assessment, stabilization, and follow\-up care. Services are trauma\-informed, culturally responsive, and grounded in principles of equity and recovery.


  
**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum of 2\+ years of relevant experience
* Strong interpersonal and customer service skills. Ability to communicate and resolve issues effectively with a diverse population of patients, staff and physicians.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills. Ability to develop solutions and recommend changes and follow through with implementation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Windows\-based software including Microsoft word, Excel, Outlook. Knowledge of computer systems and software used in functional area.
* Ability to work calmly and effectively under time pressure in a fast\-paced, high\-acuity pediatric behavioral health environment.
* Comfort and persistence with high\-volume telephone and fax\-based coordination with external hospitals and receiving facilities
* Ability to accurately review clinical documentation (labs, H\&P, medication lists) for completeness prior to transmission to a receiving facility
* Understanding of HIPAA and patient privacy requirements as they relate to transmitting clinical information between facilities.
* Ability to work collaboratively as part of an interdisciplinary crisis team, including BERT clinicians, nursing, and medical teams; skill in building and maintaining working relationships with external community providers and programs.
  

**PREFERRED:**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
* Bi\-lingual
* Knowledge of the pediatric behavioral health continuum of care, including inpatient psychiatric admission criteria, IOP/PHP, residential treatment, and outpatient therapy and psychiatry resources, along with the regional landscape of receiving facilities and community providers. Knowledge of medical terminology sufficient to review labs and clinical documentation.
* Prior experience with inpatient psychiatric placement, bed\-finding, or hospital\-to\-hospital transfer coordination.
  

**LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS:**

* Bi\-lingual

  
**About UCSF**  

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate\-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10\-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.  

  

**Pride Values**  

UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .  

  

In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here .  

  

Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide.  

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**  

The University of California is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected status under state or federal law.  

  

**Salary Information**  

The final salary and offer components are subject to additional approvals based on UC policy.  

  

Your placement within the salary range is dependent on a number of factors including your work experience and internal equity within this position classification at UCSF. For positions that are represented by a labor union, placement within the salary range will be guided by the rules in the collective bargaining agreement.  

  

To learn more about the benefits of working at UCSF, including total compensation, please visit: https://ucnet.universityofcalifornia.edu/compensation\-and\-benefits/index.html

**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



Anthropic’s Safeguards Enforcement team detects and mitigates misuse of Claude, and much of that work depends on people: a growing human review workforce made up of full\-time staff, contractors, vendors and BPO partners. As that workforce scales across a widening range of harm areas, the programs that bring people in, give them the right access, and roll them off cleanly have to keep pace.



As Program Manager for Safeguards Workforce Operations, you’ll own those programs end to end. You’ll run onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning and access provisioning for every worker type we use, working hands\-on with the requests themselves while you build the processes that make them repeatable. You’ll partner with Enforcement leads to turn shifting priorities into capacity plans, and carry those plans through with our vendor partners. Because this role supports every Safeguards Enforcement program, you’ll also connect the dots across Anthropic, working with IT, People Operations, Security, Contingent Workforce, Human Data Operations and other teams running scaled human review to streamline practices and keep standards consistent.



This is a role for someone who likes fixing broken things at speed. The landscape moves quickly, priorities change often, and the work is an even mix of direct execution and program building.


**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Own the workforce lifecycle for contractor, vendor and BPO reviewers: onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning and access provisioning
* Triage and execute inbound requests for new or changing vendor, BPO and contractor capacity
* Turn ad hoc or broken processes into scalable ones, with clear owners, service levels and a system of record
* Partner with IT and Security on access governance: least\-privilege provisioning, timely revocation and regular access reviews
* Build and maintain capacity plans with Enforcement leads, translating review demand into workforce needs and adjusting as priorities shift
* Work with Safeguards vendor management to hold partners accountable to capacity and onboarding commitments
* Align practices with Human Data Operations and other teams running scaled human review, and help them streamline their own workflows
* Help define the long\-term workforce strategy for Safeguards Enforcement

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------


* Have personally run onboarding, offboarding, access and device provisioning for contractor, vendor or BPO workforces — doing the work, not only overseeing it
* Have operated scaled human review programs with vendors or BPOs, such as trust \& safety, content moderation or data annotation operations
* Have taken a broken or ad hoc process, made it scalable, and brought other teams along in adopting it
* Understand the fundamentals of capacity planning: how volume, handle time, quality targets, ramp and attrition turn into workforce needs
* Exercise sound judgment on access and permissions, and know when to bring in IT or Security
* Move quickly and stay effective when priorities change and information is incomplete
* Build alignment through direct partnership with the teams you depend on

**Preferred qualifications**

* Owned a vendor or BPO relationship directly, including service levels and business reviews
* Built formal capacity models for review or operations workforces
* Supported workforces across more than one enforcement or harm area
* Hands\-on experience with device management and identity and access tooling
* Worked through a period of hypergrowth where programs had to mature alongside the organization

new_jobs.title: Program Manager Evaluation & Learning
new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------



The Program Manager of Evaluation \& Learning is a core member of CCSCC's Organizational Effectiveness team, responsible for leading CCSCC's outcomes measurement and continuous improvement work across all CCSCC programs.



This role builds and maintains the systems, tools, and culture that allow the agency to understand whether programs are producing desired outcomes, communicate results to funders and the Board, and use data to improve decision\-making.



The Program Manager partners closely with program leadership, IT/CIS staff, and accreditation or compliance leads to ensure that data collection, measurement, and reporting are embedded in daily operations.



This is a strategic and hands\-on role responsible for developing evaluation frameworks, creating reporting infrastructure, analyzing data, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Outcomes Measurement \& Evaluation Strategy**


* Lead the design and ongoing refinement of an agency\-wide outcomes measurement framework, including logic models and theories of change.
* Collaborate with internal teams to create, implement, review, and use theories of change, program models, journey maps, and other strategy and evaluation tools.
* Define meaningful, measurable outcomes and process indicators.
* Collaborate with outside partners when appropriate, including research institutions and evaluation partners.
* Design, implement, and oversee evaluation plans for individual programs, including data collection methodologies, measurement protocols, sampling, and analysis methods.
* Co\-design and lead evaluation of the Vision 2030 Strategic Plan and other strategic initiatives.
* Establish and measure baseline KPIs and monitor progress across the organization.
* Conduct research and analysis to identify and implement best practices in evaluation and outcomes measurement.

### **Training \& Capacity Building**


* Train program leadership to run reports, analyze data, assess outcomes, and develop meaningful narratives.
* Design and facilitate training sessions on evaluation and learning topics, including logic models, measurement frameworks, data interpretation, and visualization.
* Create and deliver evaluation and learning onboarding training for program leadership staff.
* Foster a culture where data informs program design and continuous quality improvement.

### **Data Systems, Analysis \& Reporting**


* Analyze program activity, outcome, and impact data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities.
* Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports for staff, executive leadership, the Board, and funders.
* Lead creation and validation of agency\-wide reports, including accreditation and annual reporting requirements.
* Translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives for non\-technical audiences.
* Partner with IT/CIS and program teams to ensure data systems support consistent and reliable reporting.
* Identify and resolve data quality issues, workflow gaps, and integration needs.
* Provide technical support and guidance related to data collection and management tools.
* Maintain documentation of data definitions, workflows, and reporting processes.

### **Cross\-Program Collaboration \& Community Engagement**


* Partner with compliance and quality assurance staff to understand reporting and outcome requirements.
* Support standardization of measurement practices across program areas while accommodating program\-specific needs.
* Lead referral tracking and process\-mapping efforts that intersect with outcomes measurement.
* Coordinate with accreditation leads to ensure measurement practices meet external standards.
* Develop research protocols and engagement strategies that involve community members, donors, and funders.
* Conduct literature reviews and research to inform program development and organizational strategy.
* Represent CCSCC in meetings and presentations with internal and external stakeholders.
* Support agency\-wide strategic planning through data and evaluation expertise.

### **Staff Supervision \& Development**


* Supervise, coach, and develop Data Analyst(s), interns, and other assigned staff.
* Manage hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management activities.
* Provide ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
* Conduct regular supervision and team meetings.

### **Financial Management \& Fund Development**


* Manage assigned Evaluation \& Learning budgets and resources.
* Collaborate with program and development leaders to identify funding opportunities.
* Support grants and contracts through timely completion of deliverables and reporting.

### **Funder \& External Reporting**


* Prepare outcome and impact data for grant reports, site visits, and public\-facing communications.
* Support program leadership in creating compelling, data\-informed narratives.
* Ensure evaluation methods and reporting comply with funder and accreditation requirements.

### **Policy Development \& Implementation**


* Develop and improve policies and procedures that support high\-quality service delivery.
* Collaborate with agency leadership on communications and strategic planning initiatives.
* Inform community partners about gaps, barriers, and opportunities identified through evaluation efforts.

**Qualifications**
------------------


### **Required**


* Bachelor's degree in Public Health, Social Work, Public Policy, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* 3 to 5\+ years of experience in program evaluation, data analysis, or outcomes measurement.
* Experience developing logic models, theories of change, and evaluation frameworks.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis skills.
* Experience with Power BI, SQL, reporting tools, or business intelligence platforms.
* Experience leveraging AI\-assisted technologies to support reporting, analysis

The Office of the Chief Commercial Officer is a small team that works directly with our CCO, go\-to\-market leadership, and company leadership on Anthropic’s highest\-priority commercial initiatives. Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.  

  

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.  

  

Our capabilities include programs, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.  

We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

 **Job Description**  

The purpose of this position is to lead individual, multi\-disciplined real estate project solutions for clients, with direct accountability for project delivery.

**Responsibilities:**

We have an exciting full\-time opportunity for an **Admissions \& Program Operations Coordinator** at El Chante, our licensed 20\-bed residential substance use treatment program serving adult men in Oakland, Alameda County.

**ABOUT THE COMPANY:**


Sierra Circuits is a Silicon Valley\-based leader in printed circuit board manufacturing and assembly, specializing in high\-quality, quick\-turn and complex prototypes. With over 35 years of experience, Sierra provides a seamless, end\-to\-end PCB solution—from design and fabrication to assembly and testing—all under one roof at its state\-of\-the\-art facilities in Sunnyvale, California. Sierra Circuits is committed to supporting engineers and designers through extensive educational resources. The company offers free online tools such as the Stackup Designer, Impedance Calculator, Material Selector, and BOM and DFM Checkers, along with technical blogs, webinars, design guides, and its SierraConnect community forum. Sierra Circuit serves all industries including aerospace, defense, medical, automotive, and telecommunications, building PCBs to the highest industry standards, and keeping innovation at the forefront of everything we do.

 **SUMMARY OF JOB FUNCTION:**


The "Quality Manager” is responsible for overseeing all aspects of quality control within a printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturing facility, ensuring that all production processes adhere to strict quality standards, implementing continuous improvement initiatives, and maintaining compliance with industry regulations, by leading a team of quality inspectors and engineers while collaborating closely with other departments to deliver high\-quality PCBs consistently. **RESPONSIBILITIES AND ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* **Quality Management System (QMS) Oversight:** Develop, implement, and maintain a robust QMS system aligned with industry standards, including documentation, procedures, and quality metrics to monitor and improve PCB production processes.
* **Quality Control Inspections:** Lead a team of quality inspectors to conduct thorough inspections at various stages of PCB manufacturing, including raw materials, in\-process checks, and final product testing, identifying and addressing quality issues promptly.

* **Compliance Assurance:** Adhere to all relevant industry standards and regulatory requirements related to PCB manufacturing, including environmental regulations and customer specifications.
* **Root Cause Analysis:** Conduct root cause analysis for quality issues, identify corrective actions, and implement preventative measures to prevent future occurrences.

* **Recertifications**: Schedule / handle recertifications such as ISO, AS9100\.

* **Collaboration with Cross\-Functional Teams:** Work closely with engineering, production, and customer service teams to address quality concerns, identify design for manufacturability (DFM) issues, and ensure smooth production flow.
* **Reporting and Analysis:** Generate comprehensive quality reports, analyze key performance indicators (KPIs), and present findings to management to inform strategic decision\-making.

* Identifying and addressing challenges, making timely decisions, and finding solutions to complex issues.

* Overseeing headcount planning, conducting interviews, employee timecards, and budgets, and collaborating with cross\-functional departments and managers.

new_jobs.title: GCP Technical Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III), you will support Public Sector customers with cloud adoption, operational planning, technical issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination. Working alongside senior team members, you will help maintain account health and coordinate activities across customer and delivery partner teams. You will contribute to reliable, secure cloud outcomes in complex public\-sector environments. This remote role is available to candidates who can work from within the continental United States.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/21/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III) on the AI \& Engineering team, you will be responsible for:
  

* Coordinate technical activities across assigned customer workstreams and track customer issues, risks, dependencies, action items, and upcoming milestones.
* Collaborate with client Support, Product Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and customer escalations.
* Support customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, and operational readiness activities.
* Prepare materials for technical reviews, quarterly business reviews, and customer meetings; document customer needs and communicate product feedback to client teams.
* Recommend Google Cloud practices that improve adoption, reliability, security, and performance; escalate complex technical or customer issues to the Senior Technical Account Manager.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

At Deloitte, AI \& Engineering brings together engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated, sector\-focused solutions across software, data, artificial intelligence, networks, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. Our teams help clients modernize technology and data platforms, improve mission\-critical operations, and create business value through scalable engineering solutions. We tailor our delivery approach to each client's priorities, operating environment, and transformation goals.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree or 12\+ years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, software development, or technical consulting.
* 4\+ years of experience supporting customers with Google Cloud implementations, cloud transformation programs, technical support, customer launches, release management, escalations, or technical consulting.
* 1\+ years of experience designing, developing, supporting, or operating microservices, distributed systems, and application programming interfaces (APIs) using software development practices.
* Must currently hold a Google Cloud Professional certification in at least one of the following: Professional Cloud Architect; Professional Cloud Database Engineer; Professional Cloud Developer; Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer; Professional Cloud Network Engineer; Professional Cloud Security Engineer; Professional Data Engineer; Professional Machine Learning Engineer; or Professional Security Operations Engineer.
* Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  

**Preferred:**  

* Experience supporting public\-sector customers in Google Cloud environments.
* Experience coordinating customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, or operational readiness activities.
* Experience preparing materials for technical reviews or quarterly business reviews.

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,000 to $170,000\.  

  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager, Mid-Market
new_jobs.description:
**About Hyperbound**
--------------------


Deals are messy. Multiple stakeholders, hours of calls, and endless emails. At Hyperbound, we're building the AI Agent that will help sales teams untangle that mess.


Hyperbound is the Revenue Activation Platform: an agentic OS for sales that connects what happens to what should happen next.  

  

We came out of YC S23 and went viral with Voice Agents that reps could call to put their skills to the test. Today, we’re building AI that understands sales conversations, coaches in real time, reasons across deals, and takes action to move them forward.


We are trusted by companies like LinkedIn, Amazon, Bloomberg, Supabase, Monday.com, Notion, and Vanta. We raised a $15M Series A in October 2025, grew ARR 5× over the past year, and are growing nearly 20% month over month.

**About the role**
------------------


You'll own a book of 25 to 40 mid\-market customers ($20k to $100k\+ ARR) and be their day\-to\-day owner at Hyperbound. Your job is to get them live, get their reps using the product.

**What we need from you**
-------------------------

* **Technical depth**: You can debug, trace and reproduce a bug. You go to product or engineering when a problem is below the UI, not because you didn't want to look.
* **Relationship instinct**: You know the key people at every account, they know you, and they message you before they message anyone else. You understand what each customer is trying to fix and you build the plan around that.
* **Ownership**: When something goes wrong, you name the problem, and start solving it. You only pull in more people if required.
* **Conviction**: You push back. When a customer wants to skip the rollout plan, run the wrong cadence, or launch to the whole sales org on day one, you tell them why it won't work and sell them on the approach that will. Customers respect solutions that are sold to them, not handed over. You own the implementation and the outcome, not just the setup.

**Highly preferred**
--------------------

* Background in sales enablement, revenue enablement, or GTM ops. You've rolled out a tool or a methodology to a sales team before and know what it takes to get reps to actually use it.
* Experience implementing or administering Hyperbound or a similar sales coaching platform.

**What your regular Thursday looks like:**
------------------------------------------

* **Implementation**: Own the project plan from kickoff to first live cohort. Rollout design, integrations setup, SSO and SCIM, admin training, launch date.
* **Adoption**: Regular check\-ins, usage reviews, feature demos, and behaviour\-change plays that get reps practising and managers coaching.
* **First\-line technical support**: Discovery on the call, reproduce the issue, file a clean ticket. Solve what can be solved in the UI or a playbook yourself.
* **Voice of the customer**: Own feedback from your accounts and make sure it reaches the product.
* **Health monitoring**: Watch active users, caller counts, and implementation milestones so you act on a slipping account weeks before the renewal conversation, not during it.
* **Commercial signals**: Spot expansion and renewal risk, log it, and hand it to the account manager who owns pricing and paper.
* **Responsiveness**: Fast on Slack, tickets, and email.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* A tag\-team job. You go to customer meetings alone. Bringing a second person is the exception.
* A sales job. Retention comes first. Expansion signals get logged and handed over, not chased. A commercial role. You don't price, negotiate, or own renewal paper. You will be paired with an expansion Account manager who will take care of that.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Comfortable with the technical side: reading logs, reproducing bugs, working through configuration, and explaining a technical issue clearly to both a customer and an engineer. You don't need to be an engineer.
* You broadly understand how a sales team runs: quotas, onboarding, coaching cadences.
* You remove blockers yourself rather than routing customers to another team.
* You can run around 40 accounts and treat them differently on purpose.

**Interview Plan**
------------------

* 30 min call with James, Recruiter
* 30 min call with Keshav, Product Lead
* Take home exercise (1\-3 hours)
* Take home exercise review call (45 min)
* Final interview with Co Founders and team

**Compensation and Benefits**

* $130K\-$160k OTE
* Series A equity
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* Free lunch and dinner in the office
* Commuter benefits


We move fast, from first conversation to offer in 1\-2 weeks

new_jobs.title: Tech Implementation Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**About Bizzaly**

Bizzaly helps small businesses make technology and AI work for them, without the jargon. Our clients include local small businesses across the Bay Area. Many are experienced professionals who are great at their work but overwhelmed by software, subscriptions, and the pace of change in AI. We assess their technology, recommend the right tools, and set everything up so it simply works.

**The role** We're looking for a patient, practical tech professional to handle the hands\-on side of our client work. Our team runs client relationships, business analysis, and training. You'll be the person who makes the recommended changes happen. This is a flexible, project\-based role with room to grow as Bizzaly grows.

**What you'll do**

* Set up and configure business tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, password managers, cloud storage, and backups
* Migrate email, files, and accounts from old systems to new ones
* Connect business apps so they share information (accounting, project management, scheduling, CRM)
* Set up AI tools and help configure simple automations
* Walk clients through their new setup in plain, friendly language
* Document what you set up so our team and clients can refer back to it
* Flag anything outside our scope, such as networks, servers, or hardware, so we can refer it to a partner

**What we're looking for**

* 3\+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, or small\-business technology setup
* Hands\-on experience with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 administration
* Strong security habits, including careful handling of client access and data
* Willingness to learn about new software and tools that small businesses use
* Patience and warmth with non\-technical people. This matters as much as technical skill.
* Reliability and clear communication about timelines
* Ability to travel to client offices in the South Bay occasionally

**Nice to have**

* Experience with small\-business software such as QuickBooks, Gusto, or industry tools (Revit, Bluebeam, real estate CRMs, construction software)
* Experience with automation tools like Zapier or Make
* Comfort using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT

**Why work with us**

* Flexible schedule that fits around other work, retirement, or family
* Meaningful work helping local business owners
* A small, supportive team where your input shapes how we work
* Opportunity to grow into a larger role

Pay: From $40\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sunnyvale, CA 94087

new_jobs.title: Customer Operations Specialist, Payments
new_jobs.description:
**Customer Operations Specialist, Payments**
--------------------------------------------

**Role in one line:** Resolve the customer problems that cross payments, disputes, cancellations, audits, and insurance operations before they become repeat calls or unresolved risk.


A payment does not reconcile. A customer raises a dispute. A cancellation notice conflicts with the account record. An audit creates a question nobody can answer from one screen. You establish the real state, speak with the customer, and carry the issue to a documented resolution.


Harper's systems can surface records and prepare routine service work. This role handles the customer problems that still require judgment, persistence, and direct communication across payments and insurance operations.

**Why now**
-----------


Harper serves a growing base of small businesses across many carriers, payment paths, and policy workflows. Routine requests belong with Customer Service. This specialist owns the harder cases that cross systems or require reconciliation across finance, insurance, and service records.


You own payments and disputes, plus the related cancellations, audits, insurance questions, phone work, and complex service problems that often arrive with them. The job is broad because the customer's problem rarely respects one system boundary.

**What you own**
----------------

* **Resolve payment questions.** Trace the payment question through the available records and identify the current state, amount, owner, and next action.
* **Work disputes end to end.** Establish the issue, gather the source records, explain the current state, coordinate the required review, and record the final outcome.
* **Handle cancellation complexity.** Read the full event chain, including notices, effective cancellations, reinstatements, and rescissions, before telling a customer what is true.
* **Support audits.** Help customers understand the audit request, identify the records needed, and route licensed or specialized questions to the correct owner.
* **Answer general insurance questions within authority.** Explain process and recorded facts clearly. Escalate coverage advice and licensed decisions rather than guessing.
* **Talk to people.** Use the phone when a live conversation will resolve confusion faster than another automated message.
* **Reconcile across systems.** Compare the customer record, payment record, policy record, communications, and external confirmation before closing a case.
* **Own the next action.** Keep one named owner, one current state, and one promised update point until the issue is complete.
* **Find the repeated cause.** Flag patterns that should become a permanent product, process, training, or finance fix.

**What resolved means**
-----------------------

* Cases preserve the customer's question, the amount or policy involved, the records checked, the owner, and the next action.
* Payment conclusions name the evidence and the account or transaction they belong to.
* Disputes end with a recorded resolution, customer notification, and any required financial or policy correction.
* Cancellation answers reflect the latest event in the chain, not the loudest notice.
* Repeat contacts decline because the underlying issue was resolved and explained clearly.

**Who thrives here**
--------------------

* You have worked in payments, disputes, cancellations, audits, insurance service, or another high\-volume problem\-solving environment.
* You can read several systems without losing the customer's question.
* You are calm and direct with people who are frustrated or confused.
* You document facts carefully and distinguish a missing record from a missing real\-world action.
* You know when to keep investigating and when to escalate.
* You are comfortable with phone work throughout the day.
* You are based in Atlanta or San Francisco, or ready to relocate to one of those offices.

**Who should not apply**
------------------------

* You want a back\-office role with no customer conversations.
* You close cases when you transfer them.
* You infer payment, cancellation, or coverage from one status field.
* You avoid difficult conversations or detailed reconciliation.
* You need a remote or hybrid default.

**Benefits**
------------


Harper offers health, dental, and vision insurance. Office\-specific benefits will be set by working location.

**How to apply**
----------------


Send your resume and a short example of a customer problem that crossed several systems or teams. Explain how you established the real state, what you told the customer, and how you proved the issue was resolved.


Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

**Who we are:**



Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.



Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.



Visit gomotive.com to learn more.


### **About the Role:**

  


At Motive, our Operations team ensures the entire organization runs smoothly, scalably, and strategically. We are seeking a Business Operations Manager to join our team and focus on the Service organization, which includes the Implementation, Installation, and Customer Education business units. This role is crucial for overseeing all internal processes and systems to ensure a smooth and efficient customer experience and to drive overall business objectives and growth.



You will act as the central nervous system for the Services organization, optimizing workflows and managing operational processes across these critical teams. Your ability to think strategically, adapt quickly, and manage resources effectively will be essential for success. This role will bring a data\-driven perspective to operational process management, resource allocation, and performance monitoring.



You will collaborate closely with various teams, including Sales, Support, and Product. Your mandate is to ensure the new customer experience is smooth, builds trust, and is as efficient as possible for our customers and our business.

  

### **What You'll Do:**


* Pinpoint drivers of services performance and lead initiatives to improve the new customer experience and team efficiency
* Partner with cross functional teams to scope and execute strategic projects to reduce workflow friction and inefficiencies for the Services organization
* Manage weekly and monthly business processes, escalating deviations from goals and expectations
* Be the connective tissue between Services and the rest of the business
* Ad\-hoc reporting requests through Salesforce and other platforms
* Become a trusted advisor for sales leadership, offering an operational lens on how to tackle business problems at scale

### **What We're Looking For:**


* 3\+ years of Field Sales/Revenue Operations experience, at a high\-growth SaaS company in the Mid\-Market or Enterprise segments
* Exceptional spreadsheet and data management skills to quickly structure analyses, answer key business questions, and drive decision making
* Experience in building Salesforce reports and dashboards, knowledge in how SFDC applications integrate with each other, and ability to enable sales on SFDC best practices and related tools
* Experience partnering with Sales Leadership on initiatives such as weekly forecasting, territory alignment, ROE, QBRs and other related projects
* Experience identifying and leveraging AI\-driven tools and solutions to enhance sales operations efficiency and effectiveness.
* Demonstrated ability to be a self\-starter \- you will take the initiative to own projects and can operate well with little guidance
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize workload and manage multiple concurrent projects in a rapidly changing, hyper\-growth environment
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
 ***Pay Transparency***

new_jobs.title: Creative Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.


At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.


This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------



Leads the systems, governance, planning, and insights that enable the creative organization to operate effectively at scale. Owns intake, prioritization, capacity and resource planning, workflow governance, reporting, process design, and operational health. Partners with creative leadership to align resources with business priorities, improve how work moves through the organization, and build scalable practices that increase speed, visibility, accountability, and creative impact. **The Main Responsibilities**

* Drive consistent use of work\-management tools, intake systems, dashboards, and processes while clarifying requirements and reducing friction across creative teams, stakeholders, agencies, PMO, and partner functions.
* Build dashboards and reporting on demand, project mix, throughput, cycle time, workload, utilization, velocity, and bottlenecks, giving leaders clear visibility into capacity, operating health, and tradeoffs.

* Lead improvements that increase velocity, reduce rework, and strengthen stakeholder experience; communicate changes, drive adoption, and establish scalable practices for planned and reactive work.
* Configure tools to support the operating model and provide team and leadership visibility; identify opportunities for automation, templates, improved reporting, and workflow simplification.
* Partner with technology and operations teams to improve adoption, data quality, and system effectiveness, and set standards for tracking work, resources, timelines, and project metadata.
* Advise creative leadership on structure, resource planning, workload forecasts, agency and contractor strategy, future operating models, business cases, staffing recommendations, and capability planning.
* Identify recurring demand patterns requiring new roles, process or scope changes, or alternative partner models, and clarify how organizational design choices affect capacity, velocity, quality, and business impact.

* 7\+ years in creative or marketing operations, PMO, resource management, agency operations, or related operational leadership.

Provide comprehensive programmatic, strategic, and technical support to the Chief Data Officer (CDO), Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer (CAIO), and broader CDAIO teams. The role spans policy development, governance, data/AI strategy execution, workforce training, and multi\-center coordination to advance NASA’s Data Strategy and AI maturity.


**Functional Responsibilities:**


Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:


Policy, Governance, and Compliance


* Lead development, coordination, and implementation of data and AI policies, including governance standards, metadata and classification frameworks, interoperability models, and compliance enforcement mechanisms.
* Conduct policy gap assessments, manage exception processes, monitor compliance, and support consensus\-building across NASA centers and external partners.


AI and Data Risk Management


* Develop and maintain AI risk assessment methodologies aligned with NIST AI RMF, including bias testing, safety validation, and ongoing performance monitoring for deployed models.
* Identify risks, create risk statements, mitigation plans, and impact analyses.


Strategic Planning \& Inter\-Organizational Coordination


* Facilitate inter\-organizational planning and coordination to meet federal requirements and support NASA’s Data Strategy, Data Action Plan goals, and enterprise milestones.
* Provide project and program management support aligned with IT, data, and AI domain knowledge, applying cost/schedule/performance metrics.


Training, Workforce Development \& Media Support


* Develop and coordinate training materials, briefings, and workforce development strategies to improve NASA\-wide proficiency in AI and data competencies.
* Assess workforce skill gaps and produce tailored curricula and career progression maps for data/AI roles.


Data Management \& Technical Architecture


* Implement enterprise\-level data management practices such as ontologies, taxonomies, knowledge graphs, metadata standards, and interoperability frameworks.
* Promote responsible, ethical, secure, and transparent adoption of AI capabilities.


Stakeholder Engagement \& Working Groups


* Facilitate and support agency\-wide boards, working groups, and governance bodies such as ITSB, EDWG, AISB, and AISWG.


General Support Services


* Provide strategic advisory, content development, governance support, communications coordination, and continuous service improvement across CDAIO initiatives.


Remote, hybrid, and onsite positions, the employee bears travel costs to the nearest NASA Center for badging and the issuance of NASA IT equipment.


For a Remote or Hybrid position, the employee must have a reliable internet connection and be able to VPN into the NASA network to conduct work.


**Education and Experience:**


Minimum Education: BA BA/BS Data Science, Information Management, Business Administration, or a related field.


Minimum Experience: 8 years


**Minimum Qualifications:**


* 8\+ years of project management experience.
* 6\+ years of experience in data governance, data management, or a related field, preferably within a federal or large organizational setting.
* Provide expert strategic vision and management services informed by industry best practices to guide efficient and effective data management and AI adoption.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Knowledge of AI and data governance and risk frameworks.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to provide IT clarification as it relates to AI.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Proficient in M365
* Jira
* Microsoft Purview
* Collibra, Informatica, etc.
* Strategy Management
* Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) Certification (desired, not required)
* ITIL Certification (desired, not required)
* Microsoft Project (desired, not required)
* Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, OneNote, OneDrive), SharePoint, and Box.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* PMP certification (or equivalent).

**This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours.**  

  

**Who We Are**  

Marketbridge partners with leading B2B brands to create unified Go\-to\-Market® systems that connect strategy, AI, creativity, activation and measurement. With a team of 350\+ across North America and Europe, Marketbridge supports clients worldwide, ranging from Fortune 1000 enterprises to venture\-backed, high\-growth companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, industrial and consumer sectors. For more information, please visit www.marketbridge.com and follow www.linkedin.com/company/marketbridge/. **Who We're Looking For**


We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Project Coordinator to join our Workflow and Project Management team. This role is ideal for an energetic problem\-solver and strong communicator who thrives in a fast\-paced advertising or marketing agency environment.


As a Project Coordinator, you will support the planning and delivery of integrated marketing projects, working closely with teams across Client Success, Strategy and Media, Creative, and Marketing Technology and Operations. You will help keep projects organized, timelines on track, and stakeholders informed while ensuring teams have the information and resources needed to produce high\-quality work.


The successful candidate is detail\-oriented, dependable, and comfortable managing multiple projects and shifting priorities. You anticipate needs, follow through on commitments, and approach challenges with curiosity and a solutions\-oriented mindset. You are eager to learn new technologies, strengthen your project management capabilities, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our processes. Experience supporting B2B marketing programs is an asset.

 **Responsibilities**

**Project Coordination**

* Coordinate the planning, scheduling, resourcing, and execution of a variety of integrated marketing initiatives.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, task assignments, status reports, meeting notes, and other project documentation.
* Monitor project progress, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables to help ensure work is completed on time, within scope, and in alignment with the approved brief.
* Anticipate potential project issues and roadblocks, communicate concerns promptly, and partner with project leads to support timely resolution.
* Assist with the preparation of project estimates and track project hours, budgets, and scope against approved plans.
* Work with Client Success and strategy teams to ensure project briefs are complete, requirements are clearly defined, and timelines are achievable.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to ensure they have the direction, information, and resources needed to complete their work successfully.
* Help manage changes to project scope, schedules, or deliverables and ensure updates are clearly documented and communicated.
* Support project closeout activities, including confirming deliverables, organizing final files, and documenting key learnings.

**Workflow Management**

* Support established project management processes and help ensure they are followed consistently across assigned projects.
* Maintain project information, documentation, and workflows within the appropriate systems and tools.
* Identify potential process gaps or inefficiencies and recommend opportunities to improve how work is planned and delivered.
* Help coordinate resources and priorities across teams, escalating scheduling conflicts or capacity concerns as needed.

**Communication and Collaboration**

* Communicate project goals, priorities, responsibilities, deadlines, and status updates clearly and consistently to internal stakeholders.
* Facilitate or support project meetings, including preparing agendas, documenting decisions, and tracking follow\-up actions.
* Build positive and collaborative working relationships across teams and functions.
* Escalate risks, delays, and competing priorities to the appropriate project or account lead in a timely manner.

 **Qualifications**

* At least 1 year of related project coordination, project management, account management, or marketing operations experience, preferably within an advertising or marketing agency.
* A post\-secondary degree in business, marketing, communications, project management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands, adapt to changing requirements, and remain composed in a deadline\-driven environment.
* Experience coordinating multiple projects and collaborating with cross\-functional teams within established timelines and budgets.
* Familiarity with integrated marketing programs, including creative, digital, media, and marketing automation deliverables.
* Experience using project management or workflow platforms (ie: Asana, Workbook, ClickUp, Scoro, etc.)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across different teams and levels of the organization.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills, with strong attention to detail.
* A collaborative, solutions\-oriented approach and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Familiarity with project briefs, timelines, budgets, resource schedules, milestones, risks, and deliverables.
* A demonstrated commitment to accountability, follow\-through, and continuous learning.
* Experience supporting B2B marketing programs is an asset.

Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and global brands in redefining how they go to market.

new_jobs.title: Odoo Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
We are an Official Odoo Partner and Odoo Accounting Expert Partner, providing ERP implementation, migration, customization, and support services to clients across Manufacturing, Retail, Construction, Utilities, Services, and Outdoor Recreation. We've been an exclusive Odoo implementation and customization partner since 2015, and we're growing fast. We're looking for a Project Manager who can run multiple concurrent ERP engagements with minimal oversight, protect project margin, and keep clients confident and informed from kickoff through go\-live.

**What You'll Do**

● Own the full project lifecycle for multiple concurrent Odoo implementation, migration and service engagements — from kickoff through go\-live and stabilization

● Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, managing day\-to\-day communication, status updates, and expectations

● Identify scope expansion the moment it appears, communicate write up details of tasks and client needs and communicate that to our developer team and oversee the work to ensure that it meets the client needs.

● Coordinate with developers and technical staff to translate business requirements into actionable, tasks — without directing technical implementation decisions yourself

● Track hours, budget, and milestones against the Statement of Work; flag at\-risk timelines and margin issues early

● Facilitate discovery, design confirmation, UAT, and Go\-Live Acceptance Checklist sign\-off with clients

● Distinguish between billable enhancements and no\-charge defects, and hold that line consistently with clients

● Designate and formally introduce a secondary PM for each assigned client to ensure continuous coverage

● Provide clear, professional written documentation of every scope decision, timeline change, and client agreement

● Escalate unresolved issues or at\-risk relationships to executive leadership with a clear recommendation, not just a status report

**What You Bring**

● 3\+ years of Odoo project management experience in ERP implementation, migrations and service work.

● A current Odoo Certification preferred but not required, Direct experience managing Odoo projects required. Unfortunately experience with another major ERP platform such as NetSuite, SAP, Dynamics, Epicor is not a substitute for Odoo ERP experience.

● Proven ability to manage scope discipline — recognizing scope creep, pricing it, and getting client sign\-off without damaging the relationship

● Strong working knowledge of core ERP business processes: sales, inventory, accounting, manufacturing, and CRM workflows

● Excellent spoken English along with excellent written and verbal communication skills is required

● Highly organized, self\-directed, and comfortable managing multiple client engagements simultaneously in a remote environment

● Experience with formal Go\-Live acceptance, UAT coordination, and change order/SOW documentation processes

● PMP, CSM, or other formal project management certification a plus, but not required

**Required**

● Background in a Odoo software consultancy or implementation partner (rather than an internal in\-house PM role)

● Familiarity with Odoo data migration projects and legacy system transitions

● Experience managing projects in Odoo ERP platforms

● You must reside inside the USA and speak fluent english

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you currently reside inside the USA and are you able to work USA based business hours?

Experience:

* Odoo: 3 years (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

License/Certification:

* Odoo Certification (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Implementation Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Latent Health**
-----------------------


Latent Health is redefining how healthcare systems unlock the power of clinical data. Through our AI\-powered platform, we streamline clinical workflows, reduce clinician burden, and improve health system efficiency. We partner with leading hospitals and health systems to deliver fast, reliable, and high\-impact implementations that transform patient care.

**Role Overview**
=================


The **Implementation Project Manager** is responsible for leading end\-to\-end onboarding and deployment projects for health systems adopting Latent’s platform. You’ll drive timelines, coordination, communication, and successful activation across clinical, IT, integration, and operational stakeholders.


This role requires exceptional organization, customer\-facing presence, and the ability to operate in the dynamic environment of a high\-growth healthcare SaaS startup. You will ensure customers go live efficiently, achieve measurable value quickly, and are set up for long\-term success.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Project Leadership \& Customer Delivery**

* Lead full\-cycle implementation projects – from kickoff through go\-live and stabilization – across a portfolio of health system customers.
* Build and manage detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, and risk logs.
* Facilitate cross\-functional meetings with customer IT, clinical operations, and technical teams (e.g., data integration, SSO, EHR workflows).
* Serve as the primary project point of contact, ensuring exceptional communication and alignment across all parties.

### **Technical Coordination**

* Coordinate collection and validation of required technical inputs (integration specifications, data feeds, configuration requirements).
* Partner with Latent engineering, product, and clinical teams to ensure smooth handoffs and timely execution.
* Understand and translate technical requirements to non\-technical stakeholders (and vice versa).
* Monitor progress of integrations (e.g., Epic, Cerner, Meditech) and escalate blockers proactively.

### **Operational Excellence**

* Own project documentation, including requirements tracking, decisions, status updates, risk mitigation plans, and post\-go\-live handoff materials.
* Build repeatable processes and contribute to the evolution of Latent’s implementation playbooks and best practices.
* Track and report project KPIs (e.g., activation timelines, milestone adherence, customer readiness).
* Ensure clean transition to Support teams post\-implementation.

### **Customer Relationship \& Change Management**

* Build trusted relationships with clinical and operational leaders at customer sites.
* Guide customers through workflow adoption, training readiness, and change\-management planning.
* Ensure customer stakeholders understand project expectations, responsibilities, and timelines.
* Drive customer accountability to keep projects on track and on time.

**Qualifications**
==================

### **Required**

* 3\-7 years of project management experience in healthcare, SaaS implementations, or health IT.
* Strong understanding of healthcare environments – clinical operations, IT workflows, data integrations.
* Proven ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication, meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to drive accountability and navigate competing priorities.
* Experience with project management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, Smartsheet, Monday.com).
* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

### **Preferred**

* Experience implementing solutions with EHR systems (Epic, Cerner, Meditech).
* PMP, CSM, or other project management certification.
* Background in clinical workflow optimization or healthcare operations.
* Prior experience in Series A\-C SaaS or health\-tech companies.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**
===================================

* Customers consistently launch on time, on budget, and with high satisfaction.
* Clear, proactive communication minimizes surprises and escalations.
* Implementation cycles shorten over time due to improved processes and customer readiness.
* Cross\-functional teams view you as a trusted coordinator and problem\-solver.
* Customers transition seamlessly to Customer Success with strong early adoption signals.

**Why Latent Health**
=====================

* Mission\-driven team transforming healthcare through cutting\-edge AI.
* Fast\-growing environment with opportunities for career growth.
* Deep collaboration across clinical, technical, and product teams.
* A chance to make a real impact on clinician workflows and patient outcomes.

  

Compensation Range: $115K \- $175K

new_jobs.title: Bilingual Account Manager (Spanish)
new_jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote, based in MST or PST  
**Compensation:** $5,000/month base with a target total earnings of $6,500–$7,500/month, and uncapped variable compensation.

Metabolic Supply Group (MSG) is building a marketplace that connects healthcare providers with pharmacy partners and gives clinics a simpler way to source the products they need. We bring pharmacy relationships, ordering support, and dedicated account management together so providers can spend more time running their practices and caring for patients.

We’re growing quickly, and the people joining us now will help shape how we serve clinics and scale the business. You’ll work closely with the team, take ownership of meaningful relationships, and see the direct impact of your work on our customers and our growth.

**About the Role**

You’ll own an assigned portfolio of clinic accounts and be their primary contact for ongoing support and growth. Through proactive outreach and consistent follow\-through, you’ll help clinics become regular ordering partners, deepen existing relationships, and re\-engage inactive accounts.

You’ll work closely with sales, pharmacy operations, and administrative support to keep accounts moving, from the initial handoff through ongoing ordering and issue resolution. This role combines relationship management, commercial responsibility, and hands\-on coordination.

Professional fluency in English and Spanish is required. Based in the Mountain or Pacific time zone is preferred, complementing the geographic reach of our accounts.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Own your clinic relationships.** Build relationships with providers, practice managers, and clinic staff, developing a clear understanding of each account’s needs, ordering patterns, and growth opportunities.
* **Drive repeat orders and profitable growth.** Proactively engage clinics, identify opportunities to expand their use of approved products and services, and follow through on those opportunities.
* **Activate and re\-engage accounts.** Help newly assigned clinics begin ordering and reconnect with dormant or declining accounts to understand barriers and recover business.
* **Support the ordering experience.** Assist with order placement, answer account questions, and keep clinics informed about open requests and next steps.
* **Coordinate issues through resolution.** Work with pharmacy operations and pharmacy partners to address fulfillment and service concerns while remaining accountable for clinic communication and follow\-through.
* **Manage clear account handoffs.** Partner with sales to ensure newly assigned accounts have complete information, clear ownership, and a smooth transition into ongoing account management.
* **Communicate approved offerings.** Share product information, pricing, and promotions; follow established pricing and margin guidelines; and escalate questions that require additional expertise or approval.
* **Maintain accurate account information.** Document contacts, account activity, ordering history, follow\-ups, and outstanding issues in company systems.
* **Coordinate account support.** Use shared communication channels, collaborate with administrative support, and help clinics adopt portal\-based ordering.
* **Provide visibility into your portfolio.** Share account performance, growth opportunities, retention risks, and issues requiring attention.

**What You Bring**

* Professional fluency in English and Spanish, written and spoken.
* Two or more years of account management, customer success, or client relationship experience preferred.
* Healthcare experience strongly preferred, particularly in clinics or healthcare technology. Experience working with pharmacies or providers a plus.
* Ability to build strong relationships, identify growth opportunities, and retain accounts.
* Clear communication, strong organization, and reliable follow\-through.
* Comfort using CRM systems and digital tools to manage account activity.
* Independent judgment and ownership of account performance, including revenue and profitable growth.

**What Success Looks Like**

Your clinics know who to contact and trust you to follow through. Newly assigned and inactive accounts become consistent ordering partners. Your portfolio grows profitably, account risks are identified early, and clinic issues receive timely attention.

We’ll evaluate success through repeat ordering, account activation and reactivation, retention, portfolio revenue and profit, responsiveness, and accurate account documentation.

**Commission Structure**

The role offers a base of $5,000 per month, with target total earnings of $6,500–$7,500 per month through base and performance\-based variable compensation. Variable earnings are uncapped, giving you the opportunity to increase your compensation as you grow your assigned portfolio.

Pay: From $5,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.description:
Overview:

This role is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end administration, governance, and strategic evolution of the company’s Management Equity Program (MEP). The Lead Equity Program Manager serves as the central owner of equity compensation operations, partnering with senior leadership, private equity sponsors, and external vendors to ensure accuracy, compliance, and clear communication of equity value. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and is critical to scaling equity programs in a private equity environment.


Responsibilities:
**Equity Program Administration (30%)**

* Own full lifecycle of equity programs including grant planning, allocation modeling, issuance, and ongoing administration.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with private equity sponsor expectations.
* Drive timely, error\-free execution of all grant\-related activities.

**Vendor Management \& System Oversight (15%)**

* Serve as primary relationship owner for Equity Shift.
* Oversee system configuration, data integrity, reporting outputs, and service delivery.
* Establish and monitor SLAs and performance standards.

**Equity Agreements \& Governance (15%)**

* Lead development, tracking, and governance of all equity documentation.
* Maintain centralized repository with strong version control and audit readiness.
* Ensure consistency across grant documentation and amendments.

**Legal \& Compliance Coordination (10%)**

* Partner with external legal counsel on plan interpretation and documentation.
* Ensure compliance with plan rules, regulatory requirements, and equity practices.
* Support executive compensation governance, including documentation, approvals, and audit readiness.

**Executive \& Sponsor Engagement (15%)**

* Translate complex equity and executive compensation concepts (e.g., vesting, MOIC, pay mix) into clear, actionable insights.
* Partner with executives and sponsors on equity strategy and executive compensation decisions.
* Develop executive\-ready materials, including scenario analysis, grant recommendations, and value narratives.

**Executive Compensation \& Long\-Term Incentive Strategy (15%)**

* Support design and evolution of executive compensation programs, including equity and performance\-based LTI.
* Lead executive compensation modeling (e.g., dilution, MOIC outcomes, grant sizing, payout scenarios).
* Prepare Compensation Committee and Board materials, including analysis, benchmarking, and presentations.

**Key Deliverables**

* 100% accurate and timely issuance of equity grants.
* Centralized governance framework and documentation repository.
* Standardized reporting (grant status, vesting, scenarios).
* Improved vendor performance and SLA adherence.
* Executive\-ready communication materials explaining equity value.
* Executive compensation modeling and scenario analysis supporting grant design and decision\-making.
* Board\-ready materials clearly articulating equity value and performance alignment.
* Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
* Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
* Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, HR, Business, or related field required.
* Advanced degree or certification (e.g., CCP) preferred.

**Experience**

* 8\+ years in compensation, with significant focus on equity/long\-term incentive programs.
* Experience in private equity\-backed or publicly traded environments strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing equity vendors and legal coordination.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**

 **Required**

* Deep expertise in equity compensation structures and administration.
* Strong analytical capability (modeling, scenario analysis).
* Ability to translate complex financial concepts into plain English.
* High attention to detail and documentation discipline.
* Strong stakeholder management with senior executives.

**Preferred**

 **Cognitive/Mental Requirements**

* Analyze and interpret complex financial and legal data.
* Solve problems and make decisions in ambiguous environments.
* Communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Maintain high attention to detail and accuracy.

**Working Conditions and Physical Requirements**

* Remote work environment with standard office requirements.
* Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

### **About You**


You are a technically fluent, customer\-obsessed PM who gets energized by removing friction from developer workflows. You have a strong instinct for what makes integrations feel fast and safe, and you know how to balance developer needs with long\-term product maintainability. You bring systems thinking to SDK and tracking decisions, hold a high bar for integration correctness and reliability, and are energized by the challenge of reducing time\-to\-value for the teams and customers who depend on you.

  

### **About Us**

Constructor is the next\-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in\-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.


Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.


We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

### **About the Position**


As the PM for Customer Developer Experience \+ Customer Data Integrations, you will own the end\-to\-end integration journey for Constructor's customers and SIs — from first setup through long\-term adoption. Your north star is time\-to\-value: making it fast, correct, and reliable for any team to integrate with Constructor and start getting results.


You will span two tightly connected surfaces:


* CDX — SDKs, UI libraries, integration patterns, docs, and the extensibility model that lets customers build on Constructor without accumulating hidden complexity.
* CDI — tracking/instrumentation, data attributes, event validation tooling, and the reliability \+ correctness of the data flows that power Constructor's AI.

Contact center experience is a requirement for this role, banking experience is a plus. Candidates must be local to the Sacramento, CA area.
  
  

**Job Title:** Contact Center MSR II
  
**Status:** Non\-exempt
  
**Reports to:** Sup \- Contact Center
  
**Department:** Member Service Contact Center
  
**Job Code:** 1104
  
**Pay Range:** $22\.50 \- $25\.00/HR
  
**Location:** Remote in Sacramento, CA area
  
  

**WHO WE ARE:**  

Golden 1 Credit Union is among the top credit unions in the country. As a member\-owned, not\-for\-profit cooperative, Golden 1 is guided by the credit union philosophy of “people helping people.” We are committed to empowering our members and uplifting our communities as we create a more equitable and financially inclusive California. We welcome all who embrace our Core Values.
  
  

**WHO YOU ARE:**  

You are a member\-focused financial services professional who thrives in a fast\-paced contact center environment and is passionate about delivering exceptional service. You take ownership of member interactions, build lasting relationships, and are committed to upholding compliance standards while living Golden 1's Core Values.
  
  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**  

* Demonstrates advanced Credit Union knowledge, ability to resolve complex issues and escalations with minimum guidance.
* Learn and retain an exceptional working knowledge of products and services.
* Meet and achieve established performance standards commensurate to grade level, with phone efficiency and quality in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrates understanding of member needs, concerns and frustrations and respond by demonstrating care, concern and an appropriate sense of urgency.
* Demonstrate a thorough understanding of state and federal laws and regulations related to credit union compliance including bank secrecy and anti\-money laundering laws appropriate to the position.
* Demonstrate superior product knowledge recommending products/services to meet the member’s needs.
* Identify, investigate, and resolve basic and complex member concerns, as well as process and complete member transactions in a timely and efficient manner.
* Identify and report fraudulent activity to prevent potential loss to Credit Union.
* Update member and Credit Union account information efficiently and accurately.
* Educate member on products in an effort to retain and enhance member loyalty.
* Maintains ownership with the majority of their calls, requiring minimal guidance from Support.
* Ability to de\-escalate situations, looking from several points of view and applying good judgement and critical thinking to resolve the situation.
* Assist members with Online/Mobile Banking complex issues and Mobile Wallet set\-up.
* Ability to open Sub shares.
* Complete Regulatory Training Modules as required.
* Model Golden 1 core values.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**QUALIFICIATIONS AND PREFERENCES:**  

* H.S. Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required
* Some college preferred
* 1\+ years customer service experience in a contact center environment required
* 2\+ years financial services experience required
* Member relationship building experience preferred


**WHY JOIN US:**  

Golden 1 Credit Union provides its employees a market\-competitive and internally equitable total rewards compensation package through a variety of programs. These programs are designed to attract, motivate, and retain employees that drive and support the achievement of Our Mission, Vision, and Strategic Goals. The Credit Union is committed a total rewards philosophy built on; a comprehensive compensation package, well\-being and work\-life balance, career development and growth, rewards and recognition, and a commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion. We believe in fostering a workplace where every employee is recognized, valued, and motivated to contribute their best.
